name: A.C.T.H
indications:
Stress and Anxiety:
Helps in managing stress-related symptoms, including overwhelming feelings of pressure, anxiety, and irritability.
Supporting relaxation and mental clarity.
Fatigue:
Supports energy and helps reduce exhaustion.
It further helps improve memory and concentration by alleviating mental fatigue.
Hormonal Imbalances:
Supports adrenal function, helping to regulate cortisol levels.
Mood Disorders:
Assists in managing symptoms of depression and mood swings.
Digestive ailment:
Helpful for managing digestive disturbances associated with stress, such as indigestion and bloating.
Sleep:
Aids in improving sleep quality affected by anxiety or hormonal imbalances.
Inflammatory Conditions:
Help reduces joint pain, swelling, and overall discomfort due to inflammatory diseases.

name: ABEL MOSCHUS
indications:
Anxiety and Nervous Disorders:
Alleviates feelings of anxiety, nervousness, and emotional instability and fatigue.
Helpful for conditions like hysteria, nervous attacks, and fainting spells.
Digestive Issues:
Aids in relieving symptoms of indigestion, flatulence, and loss of appetite.
Acts as a carminative to reduce bloating and discomfort.
Respiratory Conditions:
Beneficial for asthma and coughs associated with intense anxiety and fear.
Helps alleviate tightness in the chest and difficulty breathing.
Reproductive Health:
Supports sexual health by addressing issues such as premature ejaculation and irregular menstrual flow.
Acts as an aphrodisiac, helping improve sexual desire in cases of diminished libido.
Skin Conditions:
Helpful in skin irritations and eruptions exacerbated by emotional stress.
General Weakness:
Addresses symptoms of nervous debility and fatigue associated with emotional strain.
Difficulty falling asleep or staying asleep due to an overactive mind or anxiety.

name: ABIES CANADENSIS
indications:
Digestive Disorders:
Increased Appetite: Characterized by a strong craving for food, particularly meat and coarse foods, often leading to overeating.
Gastric Distress: Includes gnawing, hungry faint feelings at the epigastrium, burning sensations in the stomach, and distension.
Constipation: Associated with burning pain in the rectum.
Liver and Gallbladder Issues:
Symptoms may include asensation of the liver being small and hard, along with feelings of fullness and discomfort in the upper abdomen.
Respiratory Distress:
Labored breathing and sensations of tightness in the chest may occur, often accompanied by increased heart action.
Uterine Displacement:
Helpful for women experiencing uterine displacement, with symptoms such as soreness at the fundus of the uterus that improves with pressure.
Sensation of womb as soft and feeble, as if will abort.
Nervous System:
Patients may experience light-headedness, a tipsy feeling, and irritability. Cold sensations and clammy skin are also common.

name: ABIES NIGRA
indications:
Digestive Disorders:
Indigestion: Alleviates symptoms such as bloating, heaviness in the stomach as if constriction above the pit of the stomach, and discomfort after meals.
Constipation: Effective in treating constipation and associated abdominal pain.
Gastric Disturbances:
Helps manage heartburn, a sensation of fullness, and irregular appetite patterns.
Reduces feelings of compression in the stomach and promotes regular bowel movements.
Respiratory Issues:
Provides relief from sensations of heaviness in the chest and choking sensations.
Beneficial for individuals experiencing coughs or breathing difficulties.
Sleep Disorders:
Decreases restlessness and improves sleep quality, particularly in individuals suffering from insomnia.
General Weakness:
Addresses feelings of fatigue and weakness commonly experienced by older adults.

name: Abroma Augusta
indications:
Menstrual Disorders:
Regulates menstrual cycles and alleviates associated symptoms like pain and discomfort.
Helpful in treating amenorrhea (absence of menstruation) and dysmenorrhea (painful menstruation).
Helps in Menstrual flow which is scanty or profuse along with pain in the abdomen and profuse watery vaginal discharge.
Nervous Complaints:
Supports relaxation and mental clarity.
Helps alleviate nervous tension, anxiety, absentmindedness, irritability and mood swings.
Mental fatigue, with a tendency to feel mentally sluggish or overwhelmed.
Sleep Disorders:
Aids in improving sleep quality by calming the mind and reducing insomnia.
Diabetes Management:
Supports blood sugar regulation and alleviates diabetes-related ailments.
Addresses urinary issues associated with diabetes, such as increased urgency along with excessive thirst.
Digestive Issues:
Relieves conditions like flatulence, constipation, and abnormal appetite.
Respiratory Conditions:
Helps soothe coughs and pressing chest pain and other respiratory infections by calming the airways.
Skin Conditions:
Exhibits anti-inflammatory properties that can assist in treating skin irritations, dry skin, boils along with burning sensation of skin.

name: ABROMA RADIX
latin: Abroma radix ( root of Abroma augusta)
indications:
Female Reproductive Health:
Menstrual Disorders: helps in menstrual cycles by regulate hormones and alleviates symptoms associated with irregular periods, including pain and discomfort.
Helps manage excessive vaginal discharge and treats heavy or scanty menstrual flow.
Mental Symptoms o Associated with symptoms similar to Abroma augusta.

name: ABROTANUM - DL
indications:
Digestive Disorders:
Helps with indigestion with bloating, distended, and discomfort in the stomach after meals.
Effective for diarrhea, loose watery stools.
Especially when associated with rheumatic symptoms.
Provides relief from constipation with associated abdominal cramps and discomfort.
Rheumatic and Musculoskeletal Issues:
Effective in managing rheumatic pain, particularly when symptoms alternate with gastrointestinal disturbances.
Addresses weakness and coldness in the lower extremities, muscle aches, stiff, swollen and lame joints.
Swelling & Edema:
Alleviates swelling, particularly in the lower limbs, due to fluid retention or poor circulation.
Respiratory Conditions:
Helps alleviate coughs and provides relief from a pressing sensation in the chest, particularly after respiratory illnesses.
Skin Conditions:
Helpful in treating skin ailments characterized by itching and eruptions. Purplish skin after suppressed eruptions.
Nervous System:
Reduces feelings of nervous exhaustion, irritability, and tension. Helps in anxiousness and feeling of depressed and sadness.
General Weakness:
Supports recovery from weakness and fatigue following influenza, hectic fever or other acute illnesses.
Particularly helpful for children suffering from marasmus, characterized by emaciation of the lower body despite agood appetite.

name: ABRUS PRECATORIUS
indications:
Eye Complaints:
Helpful in managing purulent conjunctivitis and granular ophthalmia.
Addresses inflammation of the cornea i.e., keratitis.
Respiratory Issues:
Provides relief from a persistent cough, chest pain and congestion.
Helps alleviate tightness in the chest and shortness of breath, especially in cases of infections or respiratory distress.
Skin Conditions:
Supports in treating ulcers, lupus, and other skin ailments. Reduces skin irritations, rashes, and eruptions associated with such infections
Fever:
Reduces fever and helps manage associated symptoms such as chills, sweating along with high pulse.
Musculoskeletal Pain:
Reduces pain and discomfort in the joints and muscles.

name: ABSINTHIUM
indications:
Epileptiform Seizures and Convulsions:
Helpful in the cases of epileptiform seizures.
Nervous tremors precede attacks, with sudden and severe giddiness.
Attacks occur in rapid succession, leading to loss of consciousness and foaming at the mouth.
Nervous Excitement and Sleeplessness
Helps in extreme nervous excitement and restlessness, especially in children.
Beneficial in cases of persistent wakefulness and frightful visions.
Delirium and Hallucinations
Treats symptoms of delirium with hallucinations, frightful visions, and loss of memory.
Patients may experience kleptomania, confusion, and a tendency to withdraw from social interaction.
Cerebral Irritation and Hysteria
Addresses cerebral irritation and spasms, including hysterical and infantile convulsions.
Beneficial in chorea and opisthotonos (severe muscle spasms).
Headaches and Vertigo
Helps with dizziness and a tendency to fall backward.
Provides relief from dull occipital headaches and general mental confusion.
Facial and Oral Symptoms
Spasmodic facial twitching and foolish expressions.
Jaw fixation, tongue biting, and swelling sensations in the tongue.
Digestive Disturbances
Relieves nausea, retching, bloating, and wind colic.
Effective in cases of belching and eructation.
Urinary Symptoms
Constant desire to urinate, with a very strong odor and deep yellow color.
Female Health Issues
Addresses premature menopause with associated nervous symptoms.
Helps in cases of darting pain in the right ovary and reproductive weakness.
Cardiovascular Symptoms
Sensation of weight on the chest and loud heart action.
Irregular heartbeat with sensations of palpitations heard in the back.

name: ACALYPHA INDICA
indications:
Respiratory Ailments:
Beneficial in cases of incipient phthisis (early-stage tuberculosis) marked by a hard, racking cough.
Manages haemoptysis (blood-streaked cough), with bright red expectoration in the morning and dark clots in the afternoon.
Provides relief from persistent chest pain and dullness.
Haemorrhagic Disorders
Aids in controlling various types of haemorrhages, which tend to worsen in the morning.
Addresses arterial bleeding without significant fever.
Helps manage rectal bleeding linked to chronic bowel disorders.
Digestive Complaints
Relieves intense burning sensations in the stomach and intestines.
Treats spluttering diarrhoea accompanied by excessive, noisy flatulence.
Alleviates abdominal discomfort caused by rumbling, distention, and gripping pain.
Skin & Liver Disorders
Beneficial for jaundice and liver-related skin discoloration.
Aids in treating itching and furuncle-like eruptions.
General Weakness & Chronic Fatigue
Helps combat progressive emaciation and exhaustion, particularly in those who feel very weak in the morning but regain strength as the day progresses.

name: ACER NEGUNDO
indications:
Hemorrhoids and Fissures:
Relieves painful piles and bleeding hemorrhoids.
Addresses fissures with accompanying soreness and itching.
Digestive Disorders:
Aids in managing bowel movement associated with rectal discomfort.
Provides relief from tenesmus (painful straining during bowel movements.
Skin and Mucosal Conditions:
Treats pruritus (itching) around the anal region.
Reduces inflammation of mucous membranes.

name: ACETANILIDUM
indications:
Cyanosis
Aids in cases where there is bluish discoloration of the skin due to poor oxygen supply.
Commonly used when cyanosis is accompanied by cold extremities and weakness.
Fever & Febrile Conditions
Helps in managing high fever with spasm & weakness.
Beneficial for cases where fever is accompanied by excessive drowsiness or collapse-like states.
Headache & Neuralgia
Severe headaches, especially those associated with nervous emotions or eyestrain.
Helps in cases of optic neuralgia and atrophy of retinal vessels.
Sensation of head as if enlarged and occupied the entire room.
Circulatory Disorders
Helpful in conditions where there is poor blood circulation, leading to pallor or cyanosis.
Weakness with blue mucous membrane and edema due to circulatory inefficiencies.

name: ACHYRANTHES ASPERA
indications:
Diarrhoea and Dysentery
Helps in acute watery diarrhoea, often yellowish and mixed with mucus.
It is associated excessive thirst, stomach pain, nausea, and vomiting.
Menorrhagia
Excessive menstrual bleeding, often linked to uterine weakness.
Diuretic Action
Supports kidney function by promoting urine flow.
Effects of Snake and Dog Bites
Useful in cases of venomous bites and their after-effects.
Skin Conditions
Helps with boils, carbuncles, foul swelling, and poisonous ulcers.
Red spots on the skin with a burning sensation all over the body.
Pulse Abnormalities
Characterized by a weak, thready pulse.

name: ACIDUM ACETYLSALICYLICUM
indications:
1. Fever & Pain o:
Aids in reducing high fever and associated body aches.
o:
Helps relieve fever-related fatigue and discomfort.
2. Inflammation & Swelling:
Useful in managing inflammation in joints and tissues.
Reduces pain and swelling in rheumatic conditions.
3. Arthritis Complaints:
Helps manage pain, stiffness, and inflammation in arthritis.
Alleviates joint discomfort and promotes ease of movement.
4. Childbirth Pain:
Traditionally used to ease the pain associated with childbearing.
Helpful in managing labor-related discomfort and muscular strain.

name: ACIDUM ASCORBICUM
indications:
Mental Fogginess & Forgetfulness
Acidum ascorbicum is indicated for individuals suffering from clouded thoughts, difficulty concentrating, and lapses in memory. Often helpful in people who appear inattentive, forget appointments, and misplace items frequently.
Periodic Absences & Dizziness
Useful in cases of sudden moments of blankness or disconnection, often accompanied by a sense of vertigo or unsteadiness.
Irritability & Argumentative Disposition
Helpful in managing states of quick temper, over-sensitivity to criticism, and a tendency to argue or take offense easily.
Dull Frontal Headaches
Aids in relieving  frontal headaches that are aggravated by light (photophobia) and accompanied by blurred vision. Particularly worse in the afternoon or after mental strain.
Mental and Physical Prostration
For extreme fatigue that affects both mind and body, especially worse in the afternoon and during tasks that require focus. May feel as though "thinking is too hard."
Early Cold Symptoms
Acidum ascorbicum acts well in the prodromal stages of a cold, especially with postnasal drip, sore or constricted throat, and a hoarse or croaky voice. Conditions worsen with talking but improve with warm fluids.

name: Acidum Benzoicum
indications:
Uric Acid and Gouty Conditions:
Acidum benzoicum is particularly effective for conditions related to excess uric acid, which can lead to gout.
The remedy is noted for its impact on metabolic disorders, with symptoms including highly colored, offensive urine and signs of gouty arthritis.
Renal Insufficiency:
This remedy is useful for addressing issues with kidney function, including reduced efficiency or profuse urine production and overall metabolic disturbances.
It helps manage symptoms associated with impaired renal function and renal or bladder calculi.
Depression:
Acidum benzoicum can help with mental health concerns such as depression and a tendency to focus on negative past experiences.
It also addresses issues with writing difficulties, such as omitting words.
Headache:
This remedy is effective for managing headaches with a throbbing sensation, particularly in the temporal arteries.
It also helps with vertigo, falling sideways and associated scalp tightness.
Nasal inflammation:
Acidum benzoicum is indicated for nasal symptoms including itching of the nasal septum and pain in the nasal bones.
It is useful for alleviating discomfort and inflammation in the nasal area- blisters, redness of cheeks.
Stomach and Abdominal discomfort:
Useful for stomach issues like a sensation of heaviness and lump, and abdominal pain, including cutting pain around the navel and stitching in the liver area.
Rectal and Stool discomfort:
Acidum benzoicum addresses rectal discomfort including stitches, constriction, and itching around the anus.
It also manages stool issues such as frothy, offensive, light-colored stools.
Offensive urine:
This remedy helps with urinary symptoms like offensive urine with a repulsive odor and variable color.
It is also used for conditions such as enuresis, dribbling urine, and bladder catarrh from suppressed gonorrhea.
Cough and Hoarseness:
Acidum benzoicum is effective for respiratory issues including hoarseness, especially in the morning, and asthmatic coughs that worsen at night or when lying on the right side.
It also helps with chest tenderness and expectoration of green mucus.
Joint pain and swelling:
Useful for joint pain and swelling, including issues like ganglion cysts, bunions, and rheumatic gout.
It also helps with pain and swelling in tendons and joints.
Fever:
Acidum benzoicum addresses fever symptoms such as coldness in extremities and general chilliness.

name: ACIDUM BORACICUM
indications:
Emotional Sadness
Useful in people who feel emotionally low and depressed. Often seen sighing or crying without reason, and may appear dull or indifferent to surroundings.
Digestive Headache
Acidum boracicum helps with headaches linked to digestion. May also be used when there is dizziness and constant buzzing or noise in the ears.
Eye Swelling
Relieves severe swelling around the eyes that causes them to close. Helpful in conjunctivitis (eye inflammation) with strong sensitivity to light.
Dryness of Mouth & Throat
Indicated when there is an unusual amount of cold saliva. The tongue may feel dry, coated, and hard to move. Dryness and discomfort in the throat are also common.
Nausea & Vomiting
Useful in nausea and a heavy feeling in the stomach, which improves after walking in fresh air. Helps when vomiting includes thick, alkaline mucus or greenish material.
Urinary Issues
Acidum boracicum supports conditions where there is pain near the ureters, with frequent and urgent need to urinate. Especially helpful when urine output increases significantly or contains albumen.
Female Health – Menopause
Helps relieve sudden hot flushes in menopausal women. Also indicated when the vaginal area feels cold, almost as if packed with ice.
Skin Eruptions
Treats skin eruptions like impetigo figurata, especially when they begin on the right thigh and spread to the left. Also used for burning skin, red patches (erythema), and swelling of the skin.
General Weakness & Nerve Sensations
Indicated in collapse or extreme weakness, with coldness and below-normal body temperature. Helpful when there is tingling or crawling sensation (formication) starting in the hands and feet and later affecting the face.

name: ACIDUM BUTYRICUM
indications:
Nervousness & Anxiety
Addresses constant fearfulness and nervous mental state.
Helps in managing anxiety about trivial matters, and impulsive suicidal thoughts.
Headache
Useful for dull, cloudy headaches that worsen with rapid movement or exertion.
Helps in easing apprehensive headache, especially when triggered by physical activity like climbing stairs.
Digestive Trouble
Manages poor appetite with excessive gas formation.
Addresses stomach cramps, particularly around the pit of the stomach, worsening at night.
Useful in regulating irregular bowel movements accompanied by pain and straining.
Back Pain & Fatigue
Helpful in relieving dull, tired sensations in the lower back.
Beneficial for pain extending to ankles and legs, especially up the back of the leg.
Supports those experiencing pain in the back and limbs.
Sleep Disturbance
Addresses pronounced insomnia and trouble falling asleep.
Helps manage disturbing dreams with serious or heavy emotional themes.
Excessive Sweating & Skin Issues
Useful for managing perspiration that occurs with slight exertion.
Helps in reducing offensive sweat, particularly of the feet.
Supports nail health, especially where fingernails are tend to crumble.

name: ACIDUM CARBOLICUM
indications:
Mental & Nervous Complaints
Addresses mental sluggishness and disinclination to work or study.
Aids in managing stupor and nervous exhaustion.
Helpful for headaches that feel like a tight band, and orbital neuralgia.
Respiratory Conditions
Supports recovery from spasmodic coughs, especially in destructive states.
Useful in scarlet fever and diphtheria with fetid odor and tissue destruction.
Aids in managing difficulty in swallowing and offensive breath with throat infections.
Digestive Issues
Helps in managing fermentative dyspepsia, belching, nausea, and vomiting.
Useful for flatulent distension of the abdomen and a burning sensation in the esophagus.
Addresses desire for stimulants and loss of appetite due to gastric upset.
Bowel Complaints
Beneficial in putrid diarrhea, thin black stools, and bloody discharges resembling intestinal scrapings.
Aids in relieving constipation with extremely offensive breath and great straining.
Urinary Problems
Helps manage dark, almost black urine and irritation of the bladder, especially in elderly men.
Useful in diabetic individuals with urinary complications.
Female Reproductive Health
Addresses offensive vaginal discharges, painful ovary, and post-partum infections.
Supports in cases of leucorrhoea in children and erosions of the cervix.
Aids in relieving backache and dragging pelvic pain.
Joint & Muscular Complaints
Helpful in managing arthritis with gnawing bone pain and leg cramps during walking.
Supports joint mobility in destructive joint affections.
Skin Conditions
Useful for itching vesicles, ulcers, and burns that tend to ulcerate.
Addresses skin affections accompanied by foul-smelling discharges.

name: ACIDUM CHROMICUM
indications:
Throat & Nasal Complaints
Helps in managing diphtheria and sore throat with tough mucus and hawking.
Addresses post-nasal tumors and ozæna with ulceration and scabs in the nose.
Useful for corrosive nasal pain and offensive nasal smell.
Offensive Discharges
Aids in relieving bloody, foul-smelling vaginal discharge after childbirth.
Beneficial for conditions with symptoms that come and go suddenly and return periodically.
Digestive & Rectal Issues
Supports relief from watery, frequent stools accompanied by nausea and vertigo.
Helps in managing internal bleeding hemorrhoids and weakness in the lower back.
Limb & Joint Discomfort
Useful for uneasiness in limbs and pain in shoulder blades, neck, knees, and balls of the feet.
Addresses drawing pain in soles during walking.

name: ACIDUM CHRYSOPHANICUM
indications:
Skin Conditions
Aids in managing psoriasis and ringworm, both internally and through topical application.
Helps in reducing thick, scabby eruptions with oozing discharge.
Beneficial for skin affections with a tendency to form crusts and foul discharges.
Eye Disorders
Useful for blepharitis, conjunctivitis, and keratitis—especially of the phlyctenular type.
Addresses intense photophobia, conjunctival inflammation, and visual hypersensitivity.
Supports recovery in cases with retinal asthenopia or optical hyperesthesia.
Ear Conditions
Helps in treating suppurative otitis media with thick scabbing and pus formation.
Aids in healing eczema and scabby conditions behind the ears and on surrounding facial skin.

name: ACIDUM CITRICUM
indications:
Mental and Emotional State
Addresses aversion to family and household responsibilities.
Helpful in indolence, and emotional withdrawal.
Frightened easily, especially in familiar surroundings.
General Conditions
Aids in managing anaemia and malnutrition.
Supports recovery in cancerous affections and chronic joint inflammation.
Helps control bleeding tendencies and general weakness.
Head and Face
Redness of the face during epileptic attacks.
Mouth and Gums
Useful for cancer of the tongue.
Helps in treating scorbutic (bleeding and spongy) gums.
Digestive System
Relieves diarrhea triggered by consuming lemonade.
Reproductive Health
Helps control excessive menstrual bleeding.

name: ACIDUM GALLICUM
indications:
Phthisis
Acidum gallicum is supportive in checking morbid secretions, particularly beneficial in cases of tuberculosis.
Hemorrhages
It helps in managing passive hemorrhages, especially when the pulse is feeble, capillaries are relaxed, and the skin is cold.
Acidum gallicum is beneficial for conditions like blood in the urine (hæmaturia) and poor blood clotting (hæmophilia).
Itching of Skin
This medicine is helpful for relieving general skin itching and irritation, especially in urticaria.
Pyrosis (Heartburn)
It provides relief for burning sensations in the stomach caused by digestive issues like heartburn.
Mental Confusion & Restlessness
Wild delirium at night, with excessive restlessness. The patient may jump out of bed, sweat profusely, and feel afraid to be alone.
Rude and abusive towards others.
Headache
Pain in the back of the head and neck. There is also a thick, stringy discharge from the nose and photophobia (sensitivity to light), with a burning sensation in the eyelids.
Respiratory Issues
Pain in the lungs and pulmonary hemorrhage.
Excessive expectoration and mucus in the throat in the morning, along with a dry cough at night.
Renal Colic
Pain in the kidneys with distress extending along the ureters to the bladder. The patient may experience dull, heavy pain in the bladder, especially over the pubis.
Urine thick with cream-colored mucus.
Rectal Issues
Copious stools, with a constricted feeling in the anus. The patient may feel faint after stool, with chronic mucous discharges.

name: ACIDUM HIPPURICUM
indications:
Eye and Naso-Pharyngeal Symptoms
Acidum hippuricum is beneficial in conditions affecting the eyes and naso-pharynx, with a particular focus on inflammation and soreness in the right eye. It is helpful in treating swollen and inflamed eyelids and muscular soreness around the eye and throat areas.
Throat Conditions
It relieves asore, raw, dry throat with difficulty swallowing. A foul odor and gummy exudate can be alleviated. Acidum hippuricum helps reduce the thickness and infiltration of tissues around the throat.
Stomach & Liver Disturbances
It addresses issues like acid rising in the stomach, with a lump feeling in the pit of the stomach. It also provides relief for soreness and pressure over the liver, particularly on the right side.
Female Reproductive Health
It is beneficial for extended menstrual flow, lasting up to three weeks, which provides complete relief from muscular and joint pains during menstruation.
Muscular and Joint Pain
Acidum hippuricum treats for backaches radiating to the hips, pain in the shoulders and extremities, and sore, swollen joints. It also addresses shooting pain in the posterior thigh and down the right leg, as well as a tired, grating sensation in the joints.
Skin Conditions
It helps alleviate itching and burning sensations on the skin, especially with the appearance of papules resembling goose flesh, particularly on the chest.

name: ACIDUM HYDROCYANICUM
indications:
Unconsciousness & Delirium
Unconsciousness with extreme states of wild delirium, often fearful of imaginary troubles, such as horses, wagons, and collapsing buildings.
Sudden spasmodic convulsions, often leading to paralysis. This includes hysterical and epileptic seizures, as well as cataleptic states.
Headache & Facial Spasm
Intense, stupefying headaches that feel like the brain is on fire, often accompanied by a flushed face and dilated pupils.
Rigid clenching of the jaws, frothing at the mouth, and pale, bluish lips.
Cough and Respiratory Collapse
A dry, spasmodic, suffocating cough, often accompanied by noisy and agitated breathing. Asthma-like symptoms and contraction of the throat are common.
Marked cyanosis (bluish discoloration) and venous congestion of the lungs, often leading to marked difficulty breathing, as well as paralysis of the lungs.
Hydrocyanic acid can be indicated in severe cases of whooping cough or pulmonary collapse, where the lung function is severely impaired.
Irregular Pulse & Violent Palpitations
A weak and irregular pulse, often accompanied by violent palpitation and torturing chest pain. These symptoms may resemble conditions like angina pectoris.
The extremities may feel cold to the touch, often associated with the collapse of the circulatory system.
Gastralgia
A great sinking sensation in the pit of the stomach, worsened when the stomach is empty.
A pulsating pain in the precordial region (around the heart), with the sensation that drinks rumble through the throat and stomach.
Drowsiness
Irresistible drowsiness, along with vivid, incoherent dreams. There may also be excessive yawning accompanied by shivering.

name: ACIDUM HYDROFLUORICUM
indications:
Chronic Diseases & Ulcerations
Especially indicated for chronic conditions with a history of syphilis or mercury exposure, particularly in older individuals or those showing prematurely aged symptoms.
Particularly helpful in conditions involving weak, distended blood vessels, such as varicose veins, and the "hob-nailed liver" seen in alcoholics.
Teeth & Bone Issues
Fluoricum acidum is beneficial in addressing the early decay of teeth, often linked with aging or degenerative processes.
Particularly useful in addressing caries of bones, including caries of the mastoid, ossicles, and upper jaw bones.
Skin Ulcers
& Alopecia:
For cases of alopecia (hair loss) and skin caries, with a sensation of pressure on the sides of the head from within outward.
Helps with bone growths like exostosis, and it is beneficial for treating syphilitic ulcers or red-edged ulcers, particularly in cases with a tendency for skin to feel warm.
Indigestion
There is a sensation of heaviness and weight in the stomach, particularly before meals, often relieved by tight clothing.
Sour belching and aversion to coffee are common, alongside acraving for fancy or highly seasoned foods and cold water.
Diarrhea is often triggered by warm drinks, but tight clothing around the abdomen offers some relief.
Urinary and Sexual Symptoms
The urine may be scanty and dark, though in cases of dropsy (fluid retention), there is often amarked increase in the frequency and amount of urine passed.
Increased sexual passion and nocturnal erections, with swelling of the scrotum.
Dyspnea
Fluoricum acidum is useful for respiratory symptoms, including chest oppression and great difficulty in breathing (dyspnea). It is also helpful in cases of hydrothorax (fluid accumulation in the chest).
Inflammation of Joints
Inflammation of the joints, especially in the fingers, and a sensation as if a splinter is lodged under the nail. The nails may become brittle or crumble, and long bones may suffer from caries or necrosis.
Pain in the coccyx (tailbone) and ulcers over the tibia are often present in individuals who could benefit from this medicine.
Varicose Ulcers & Fluid Retention
Fluoricum acidum is useful for varicose veins, nævi (moles), and ulcers with red edges. It also helps in treating syphilitic rupia and ulcerations, particularly those that worsen with warmth.
Intense itching, especially in the orifices and in spots, worsened by warmth. The skin may feel as if burning vapor is emitted from the pores.
Helps reduce dropsy of the limbs in old or feeble individuals and assists in improving circulation and toning of the capillary and venous system.

name: ACIDUM LACTICUM
indications:
1. Nausea and Vomiting:
Commonly used for nausea, especially in pale, anemic women.
Includes hot, acrid belching, better after eating, and burning gas from the stomach to the throat causing profuse secretion of tenacious mucus.
Relieves excessive salivation, water-brash, and dry, parched tongue with a tendency toward copious salivation.
2. Burning Sensations:
Characterized by intense thirst and voracious hunger.
Hot gas rising from the stomach to the throat, with an exacerbation from smoking.
3. Fullness or Lump Sensation:
Feels like a puffball or obstruction, with constant swallowing efforts.
A sensation of tightness or constriction low in the throat.
4. Breast Pain:
Particularly with the enlargement of axillary glands, the pain radiates to the hand.
5. Rheumatic Pain:
Affects joints and shoulders, wrists, and knees, often associated with much weakness.
Trembling of the whole body while walking.
The extremities often feel cold.
6. Urinary Issues:
Frequent urination, with large quantities passed.
Urine is often sweet, indicative of sugar-like presence.

name: ACIDUM NITROMURIATICUM
indications:
Oxaluria & Skin Disorders
Acts as a useful medicine for oxaluria (excessive oxalate in urine), helping to relieve associated discomfort.
Relieves skin conditions resembling psoriasis, providing relief from distressing skin symptoms.
Liver Conditions
Supports the treatment of bilious conditions, such as torpid liver, hepatitis, and early cirrhosis.
Particularly aids in hepatic torpor and gastric catarrh, especially in hot, damp climates, aggravated by meat-eating and alcohol consumption.
Digestive Issues & Mouth Symptoms
Relieves sour eructations (belching), with an empty, hungry feeling in the stomach that is not alleviated by eating.
Addresses salivation and metallic taste, especially at night, with frequent drooling.
Aids in treating small, superficial ulcers or cankers in the mouth and tongue.
Constipation & Bowel Concerns
Eases constipation, particularly with ineffectual urging and constricted anus.

Eye Disorders and Asthenopia:
Supports
eye affections marked by dryness, dim vision, photophobia, and burning on rising.
Relieves
pressure, tickling, and foreign body sensations under the eyelid.

improving vision with effort; useful in asthenopia and post-trauma visual complaints (e.g., amblyopia from a blow).
Nasal Dryness and Ear Roaring:
Manages
painful dryness, increased nasal mucus, sneezing with fluent discharge, and motion of alae nasi.
Relieves
roaring in ears and tearing or gurgling sensations in the auditory canal.
Dry Mouth and Throat Fullness:
Relieves
dryness in mouth and throat on waking, with scraping and burning down the gullet.

sensation of a foreign body in the throat that triggers repeated swallowing.

cases with fullness in the throat and nausea.
Borborygmi and Abdominal Pain:
Aids in
relieving frequent eructations, nausea, and taste disturbances—clammy, insipid, or bitter.
Manages
increased abdominal borborygmi, pressure in pubic area, and pinching or violent abdominal pain.
Pappy Stool and Rectal Issues:
Supports
relief from soft, mucous, or pap-like stools, often associated with gas and abdominal churning.
Manages
constipation or delayed stools with rectal pressure.
Relieves
diarrhea marked by mucous discharge, often preceded by chills and cramping.
Burning in Urethra and Renal Soreness:
Manages
burning in urethra and passage of drops of urine post-micturition.
Supports
conditions with increased urination and urea output.
Relieves
soreness in right kidney region (on pressure).
Painful Penis and Glandular Issues:
Aids in
shooting pains in the spermatic cord and root of the penis.
Relieves
itching in the pubic region and supports cases of hydrocele.
borborygmi manages glandular affections and inner drawing sensations.
Musculoskeletal and Joint Pain:
Relieves
rheumatic, tearing, darting pains in shoulders, elbows, knees, wrists, and ankles.
Aids in
swelling of joints and stiffness in movement, especially in hips and knees.

heaviness, pressure, and fatigue in limbs with weakness and a tendency to stumble.

recovery in panaritium (felons) and neuralgic pain involving both upper and lower extremities.
Back and Pelvis Pain with Heaviness:
Relieves
darting lumbar and sacral pains, especially during breathing.
Supports
rheumatic pain near the pelvis and heaviness in the lumbar spine.
General Lassitude and Disturbed Sleep:

cases with lassitude, heaviness, and physical dullness even after minor exertion.
Manages
neuralgias, swelling of extremity joints, and coldness with tendency to perspire.
Relieves
disturbed, unrefreshing sleep with vivid, sometimes painful dreams, sleepiness during the day, and yawning from stomach emptiness.

name: AMMONIUM ACETICUM
indications:
Fever and Sweating Disorders:
Ammonium aceticum
a ids in managing fevers with a characteristic bathed-in-sweat presentation.
Relieves
hot, flushed skin and increased warmth, particularly in the face.
Supports
cases where profuse perspiration accompanies febrile states, offering natural cooling and detoxifying effects.
Diabetic Condition:
Manages
profuse flow of urine, especially when accompanied by systemic disturbances.
Supports
urinary output in patients showing signs of sugar in the urine, indicating potential use in diabetic conditions.
Scraping in Throat:
Relieves
scraping sensation in the throat, which may appear during febrile or inflammatory conditions.
Supports
warmth and circulatory activity in the abdominal region, aiding in mild digestive discomfort.
Headache and Heaviness:
Helps in
reducing heaviness in the head often associated with general systemic sluggishness or inflammatory states.

name: AMMONIUM BENZOICUM
indications:
Albuminuria and Renal Complaints:
Supports
cases of albuminuria, especially with bloated face, swollen eyelids, and heavy, dull mental state.
Relieves
soreness in the right kidney region, especially when leaning back against acushioned surface.
Aids in
reducing scanty, smoky-looking, strong-smelling urine.
Helps in
dropsical tendencies with facial puffiness and renal involvement.
Eructations and Gastric Weakness:
Manages
eructation of food with or without acidity, indicating sluggish digestion.
Relieves
sensations of gastric weakness and supports warmth and activity in the stomach.
Glandular and Oral Affections:
Helps in
right-sided swelling under the tongue resembling ranula, indicating sublingual gland involvement.
Soreness of Eye and Eyelid Puffiness:
Relieves
soreness and sensation of swelling in the lacrimal puncta and saccus lacrimalis.
Manages
eyelid puffiness and heaviness often associated with renal insufficiency or general toxicity.
Excessive Mucous Accumulation:
Ammonium benzoicum
a ids in reducing excessive mucus accumulation in the larynx, with frequent hawking and spitting.
Rheumatic and Sacral Pain:
Supports
in relieving sacral back pain, particularly when associated with urgency to stool.
Useful in
rheumatic-gouty constitutions with urinary or joint complaints.

name: AMMONIUM BROMIDUM
indications:
Spasmodic Cough and Tickling:
Aids in
managing almost continuous coughing episodes, better when lying down at night.
Relieves
tickling and irritation in trachea and bronchial tubes with heat and burning in the throat.
Helps in
sudden, spasmodic cough that may cause strangulation or wake the patient at 3 a.m.
Supports
relief from cough triggered by rising from bed in the morning, or from sensation of mucus in throat.
Manages
whooping-cough with persistent irritation and dryness.
Headache and Neuralgia:
Relieves
pressing headache around the sides of the head and near the left eye, as if a nail were driven in.
Manages
sensation of a tight band around the head, especially above the ears.
Aids in
right-sided headaches worsened by coughing and neuralgic pains radiating around the eyes.
Supports
ciliary neuralgia with shooting pain and pressure symptoms.
Ophthalmic and Swollen Eyelid:
Helps in
managing scrofulous ophthalmia, red and sore eyes in the morning with sticky white mucus in corners.
Relieves
burning, sandy sensation in eyes, especially in the right eye.
Aids in
pterygium and swollen, drooping lids that are difficult to raise.
Manages
hemiopia and blurred vision with a sensation as if the eyes were bathed in hot water.
Soreness and Pharyngeal Irritation:
Supports
relief from soreness, mottling, and stinging in the throat, with white sticky mucus streaked with blood.
Relieves
painful throat preparation before swallowing, although the act itself is not painful.
Manages
heat in the throat, especially on the right side, and a scalded feeling in the fauces and tongue.
Helps in
throat irritation and cough that improves with sneezing.
Nasal Congestion and Coryza-Related Complaints:
Aids in
coryza with sneezing in cold environments or while raising arms.
Manages
thin nasal discharge initially, becoming thick later, mainly from the right nostril.
Relieves
nasal congestion and sneezing when entering warm rooms.
Ovarian Pain:
Supports
assistment of ovarian conditions, especially dull, constant pain with hard swelling in the left ovary.
Burning and Sudden Urgency of Stool:
Relieves
burning of the mouth and tongue in the morning as if scalded.
Helps in
sudden urgent loose stools and transient return of old hemorrhoids.
Manages
pulling sensation over the right kidney, improved by pressure but leaving discomfort.
Aids in
belching that relieves faintness and gastric distress.
Mental Discouragement:
Manages
mental fatigue, timidity, and discouragement with lack of self-confidence.
Supports
focus issues such as frequent miswriting of words and numbers while working.
Relieves
fear of death associated with gastric symptoms.
Sleep and Fatigue:
Aids in
general malaise and exhaustion worse while lying down.
Supports
sleep disturbed by early morning cough or chest pain.
Irregular Heart Action:
Manages
irregular heart action following physical exertion, especially in the evening.
Musculoskeletal Pain and Restlessness:
Relieves
interval-based leg pain, worsened by movement.
Ammonium bromidum
a ids in nervous restlessness and general fatigue after physical exertion.
Supports
burning or chilly sensations in the nape of neck and back of chest.

name: AMMONIUM CARBONICUM
indications:
Bronchitis and Weak Circulation:
Aids in
managing chronic bronchitis, emphysema, and winter catarrh with thick, bloody expectoration.
Relieves
early morning cough (around 3 a.m.) with dyspnea, palpitation, and burning in the chest.
Supports
asthenic pneumonia and pulmonary edema with stertorous, labored breathing and bubbling sounds.
Helpful for
oppression in breathing, especially when ascending stairs or entering warm rooms.
Manages
weakness of the heart in fat patients with wheezing and suffocative sensations.
Frequent Menses and Menstrual Pain:
Relieves
profuse, early, and frequent menses that are dark, clotted, and exhausting.
Supports
colicky menstrual pain with difficult stool, fatigue, and chilliness.
Aids in
itching, swelling, and burning of pudendum with acrid, watery leucorrhoea.
Helpful for
menstrual-related boils, cracked lips, and anal itching.
Flatulent and Bleeding Piles:
Manages
flatulent dyspepsia with heartburn, nausea, and chilliness.
Relieves
pain at the pit of the stomach, early satiety, and strong appetite.
Supports
bleeding piles, worse during menses, and hard, knotty stool with itching at the anus.
Aids in
flatulent hernia and abdominal noise and discomfort.
Mental Sadness and Forgetfulness:
Relieves
sadness, forgetfulness, and gloomy moods, especially in stormy weather.
Supports
mental agitation from noise and talking, along with an aversion to cleanliness and despair.
Helpful for
timidity and irrational weeping.
Nasal Obstruction and Enlarged Tonsils:
Aids in
managing nasal obstruction at night, with sharp, burning nasal discharge.
Supports
ozæna and bloody mucus from the nose with tip congestion.
Relieves
enlarged tonsils, burning in throat, and diphtheria with nasal stoppage.
Helpful for
sore, cracked corners of the mouth, vesicles on tongue, and metallic taste.
Fetid Urine and Seminal Emissions:
Manages
frequent desire to urinate, involuntary urination at night, and fetid, turbid urine.
Supports
uremia with white, sandy, or bloody urine.
Aids in
itching and pain of the scrotum and spermatic cords; erections without desire.
Relieves
seminal emissions and tenesmus of the bladder.
Cardiovascular Weakness and Palpitation:
Relieves
fear-induced palpitations with trembling, cold sweat, and breathlessness.
Supports
weak heart conditions, especially when waking with suffocation and anxiety.
Skin Eruptions and Toxic States:
Aids in
malignant scarlatina with somnolence, swollen glands, and dark red sore throat.
Supports
eruptions from defective vitality, miliary rashes, and violent itching with burning vesicles.
Relieves
eczema in flexures, genital regions, and anus.
Helpful in
erysipelas in elderly individuals with brain symptoms.
Sleepiness and Exhaustion:
Manages
excessive daytime drowsiness and sleep disturbed by strangling.
Relieves
profound prostration from trifling exertions with heaviness in all organs.
Musculoskeletal Pain and Limb Swollen:
Supports
tearing joint pains better from heat of bed; deep periosteal pain in fingers.
Aids in
painful, swollen big toe, cramps in calves and soles, and painful heels.
Relieves
panaritium, felons in early stage, and limb stiffness needing constant stretching.

name: AMMONIUM CAUSTICUM
indications:
Severe Throat and Esophageal Inflammation:
Relieves
burning and dryness of the oesophagus with intense difficulty swallowing.
Ammonium causticum
s upports cases of retracted, swollen uvula and enlarged tonsils covered in white membrane.
Aids in
managing elongation and inflammation of the uvula with ulcerative tendencies.
Useful in
contraction of the oesophagus causing swallowing distress.
Gastrointestinal Irritation and Vomiting:
Manages
violent vomiting of mucus and blood with intense thirst and tenderness over the epigastric region.
Relieves
painful borborygmi and abdominal distension.
Aids in
ejection of stomach contents through nose and mouth, with burning sensation along the oesophagus.
Supports
cases with copious bloody stools and rectal tenesmus.
Bronchitis and Voice Disturbances:
Aids in
bronchitis with profuse and blood-stained expectoration.
Relieves
deep, weak or completely lost voice (aphonia).
Supports
in severe breathing difficulties with gasping for breath.
Alkaline Urine and Kidney Affections:
Manages
nephritis with red, alkaline urine and presence of albuminuria and hyaline casts.
Nervous Weakness and Muscular Prostration:

great trembling and exhaustion on slightest exertion.

in conditions with muscular contractions, inability to maintain an upright posture, and deep fatigue.
Aids in
cases of convulsive twitching, particularly in the right arm.
Swelling and Excessive Salivation:

destruction of mucous membranes of lips and nose, swollen gums, and lips.

profuse bloody salivation and burning at the root of tongue and throat.
Useful in
swelling and blackened coating of the lower lip.

Supports
bleeding from all orifices, often leading to faintness and collapse.
Manages
febrile states with initial dryness and heat of the skin, followed by profuse perspiration.
Relieves
shivering and evening fevers with rapidly accelerating pulse.
Timidity and Disturbed Sleep:
Manages
timidity and extreme mental confusion.
Aids in
disturbed sleep due to mental agitation.
Profuse Menses:
Relieves
profuse menstruation occurring fifteen days too early.

name: AMMONIUM IODATUM
indications:
Respiratory and Pulmonary Conditions:
Supports cases of laryngitis and bronchitis where Iodine alone is insufficient.

Relieves oedema of the lungs marked by excessive fluid accumulation and respiratory distress.
Head and Neurological Symptoms:
Ammonium iodatum manages dull headaches especially in young individuals with heavy, stupid facial expressions.
Supports conditions of vertigo associated with Menière’s disease.

name: AMMONIUM MURIATICUM
indications:
Dry Hacking Cough and Mucous Membrane Affections:
Aids in profuse acrid, hot watery nasal discharge that corrodes the lips.
Ammonium muriaticum manages frequent sneezing with itching and soreness inside the nostrils.
Supports loss of smell and obstructed, stuffy nasal passages with constant, unavailing efforts to blow them out.
Relieves swollen, throbbing tonsils and sore spots behind the uvula, symptoms often eased by eating.
Manages internal and external swelling of the throat with viscid phlegm that cannot be easily expectorated.
Aids in hoarseness and burning sensations in the larynx.
Relieves dry, hacking, scraping cough worse when lying on the back or right side.
Supports loose cough in the afternoon with profuse expectoration and mucus rattling in the chest.
Manages burning and oppressive sensations at small localized spots in the chest.
Melancholy and Apprehension:
Aids in melancholy and apprehension linked to internal grief.
Relieves the desire to cry that cannot be fulfilled, often due to sorrowful causes.
Fullness and Hairloss:
Manages sensation of fullness and compression in the head, which is worse in the mornings.

Supports misty vision and optical illusions indicative of incipient cataracts.

Relieves regurgitation of food with bitter waterbrash.
Aids in nausea and gnawing epigastric pain immediately after eating.
Manages splenic stitches, especially in the morning, often with difficult breathing.
Relieves abdominal pain around the navel, especially during pregnancy.
Supports chronic congestion of the liver and excessive fatty deposits around the abdomen.
Manages flatulence and a strained sensation in the groin.
Genitourinary and Female Distress:
Aids in menstruation that is too early, too profuse, dark, and clotted, with flow increasing at night.

Manages diarrhea with greenish mucous stools and navel pain during menses.
Supports leucorrhea resembling egg white or brown slimy discharge after urination.

Aids in stinging and burning sensations in the perineum during and after stool passage.
Supports hemorrhoids following suppressed leucorrhea.
Musculoskeletal Pain:
Relieves icy coldness between the shoulders that is not relieved by warmth and followed by itching.
Manages bruised pain in the coccyx when sitting.
Aids in backache described as a vise-like pressure, worse on sitting.
Supports ulcerative and shooting pains in fingertips and heels.
Relieves contraction of the hamstring tendons.
Manages sciatica worse on sitting and better when lying down.
Supports neuralgic pain in amputated limbs.
Relieves offensive, sweaty feet and foot pain associated with menses.
Skin Itching and Blisters:
Ammonium muriaticum manages intense itching generally in the evenings.
Aids in blisters appearing on various parts with burning sensations, better by cold applications.
Fever and Chilliness:
Relieves chilliness in the evenings after lying down and upon awakening, often without thirst.
Manages heat sensations in palms and soles.
Supports low-grade, subacute fevers related to unhealthy climates.

name: AMMONIUM NITRICUM
indications:
Eye Disorders
o:
Manages vision disturbances such as yellow color before the eyes, and wavering or trembling of objects.
o:
Ammonium nitricum relieves weakness of eyes while reading, aiding in visual clarity and reducing strain.

o:
Relieves pain in the chest extending to the left scapula, which may be linked to thoracic or musculoskeletal causes.
o:
Aids in easing discomfort during breathing or movement.
Circulatory Inefficiency
o:
Manages symptoms of diminished body temperature and slow pulse, which may reflect reduced circulatory efficiency or lowered energy levels.
Polyuria
o:
Ammonium nitricum aids in managing increased urination, helping relieve urinary tract irritation or support kidney function.

name: AMMONIUM PHOSPHORICUM
indications:
Gouty Diathesis and Joint Nodosities:
Especially indicated in chronic gouty patients.
Manages nodosities on the joints of fingers and backs of hands.
Helpful in cases with shoulder-joint pain and general joint discomfort.
Respiratory Affections with Mucopurulent Expectoration:
Indicated in deep, rough cough with greenish expectoration, commonly found in chronic bronchitis or gouty bronchial irritation.
Ammonium phosphoricum beneficial when there is tightness around the chest, adding to the respiratory distress.
Motor Weakness and Unsteady Gait:
Patient presents with heaviness of the limbs, often accompanied by an unsteady, tottering gait, indicating muscular or neurological involvement.
Shows marked sensitivity to cold, particularly from slight drafts of air, leading to chilliness and discomfort.
Facial Paralysis and Neuralgic Affections:
Indicated in cases of facial paralysis, particularly when associated with gouty background or constitutional coldness.
Coryza with Profuse Morning Discharge:
Morning sneezing, with copious nasal discharge and lachrymation, marks its action on the mucous membranes of the upper respiratory tract.
Symptoms are worse in the morning and suggestive of catarrhal states influenced by uric acid excess.
Uric Acid Disturbance:
Urine shows rose-colored sediment, indicating uric acid crystallization.

name: AMMONIUM PICRICUM
indications:
Occipital Headache and Neuralgia:
Strongly indicated in periodic neuralgia and headache, especially over the right occiput, extending to the ear, orbit, jaw, and temples.
Headache often begins in the morning, with heaviness, vertigo on rising, and worsens on getting up.
Pain may spread across the sides of the head to the eyes, followed by nausea and vomiting of sour bilious matter in the afternoon.
Face appears darkly flushed during attacks.
Post-Traumatic Occipital Disturbance:
Useful in head injury cases, particularly those involving the back of the head or occipital region.
Symptoms include a “wild feeling” in the occiput, trembling, palpitations, and a sense of alarm or fright, especially after sudden movements, such as turning in bed or stooping.
Spinal Congestion and Pressure Sensations:
Commended for its role in congestion of the brain and spinal cord.
Indicated in spinal paresis and heaviness or pressure sensations that begin in the occiput and travel down the spine or vice versa.
Comparable to Picric acid, which shares this spinal modality.
Vertigo and Menstrual Connection:
Vertigo especially noticed on rising, often related to menstrual irregularities, and frequently paired with occipital heaviness.
Ammonium picricum may be helpful in women with bilious constitution, who suffer periodically from these symptoms every six to eight days.
Mental Dullness and Exhaustion:
Patient presents with obtuse mind, aversion to mental work, and general mental fatigue, especially during or after headache episodes.
Cardiac Sensitivity and Palpitations:
Palpitations with trembling, intermissions, and a sense of panic, especially linked to nervous conditions or head symptoms.
Heart symptoms may accompany head injuries, vertigo, or emotional disturbance.

name: AMMONIUM VALERIANICUM
indications:
Nervous Irritability and Emotional Disturbance:
Especially suited to nervous and hysterical individuals, with pronounced emotional excitability.
Marked nervous erethism, often underlying all complaints, whether physical or mental.
Neuralgic Headaches and Insomnia:
Indicated in neuralgia of the head, especially when connected with nervous excitement or mental strain.
Useful in insomnia due to nervous overactivity or mental restlessness, as seen in hysterical patients.
Cardiac Irritation and Functional Palpitations:
Ammonium valerianicum acts on the heart, especially in functional disorders such as tachycardia without organic disease.
May relieve cardiac pain linked to nervous tension or anxiety.

name: AMOORA ROHITUKA
indications:
Fever and General Debility
Used in chronic fever, often with headache, aching pains, and burning sensation in the hands and feet.
Helps with general debility and weakness associated with fever.
Liver and Spleen Enlargement
Indicated for enlargement of the liver and spleen.
Relieves nausea and vomiting associated with these conditions.
Weak Memory
Memory becomes dull and disordered, with difficulty concentrating and making decisions.
Often leads to mistakes in spelling, confusion regarding places, and a difficulty fixing the mind on any task.
The patient can become easily angered and irritable.
Headache
Heat in the vertex and giddiness.
Pain in the temples accompanied by heat, which is relieved by cold air and cold applications.
Flushes of heat on the face, with a burning sensation, including in the eyes.
Digestive Complaints
Insipid taste in the mouth, along with a bad and bitter taste in the morning.
Burning sensation in the stomach, particularly when the liver or spleen is affected.

name: AMYGDALUS AMARA
indications:
Respiratory Constriction and Convulsive Breathing:
Marked spasmodic breathing, with short, convulsive inspirations and an overwhelming fear of suffocation.
Useful in asthmatic states, diphtheric constriction, and laryngo-pharyngeal burning with inability to swallow.
Indicated in cough with soreness of the chest, pain extending down to the stomach, and deep stitches under the left nipple that make exhalation difficult.
Coma, Convulsions, and Nervous Spasms:
Beneficial in epilepsy, tetanus, and opisthotonos.
Associated with jerking, hesitating speech, as in stammered phrases: “What’s—the mat—matter with me?”
Suitable in syncope, coma, and collapse states marked by surface coldness, clamminess, and pallor or cyanosis.
Swallowing Difficulty and Throat Symptoms:
Characterized by burning heat in the laryngo-pharynx, and dark red discoloration of the palate and fauces.
Swallowing is impossible due to intense irritation or spasmodic restriction.
Lancinating pain through the tonsils, making the medicine especially relevant in toxic or inflammatory throat conditions.
Digestive Distress and Vomiting:
Indicated in vomiting of undigested food and bile, especially in acute neurological or toxic states.
Amygdalæ amara suited to gastric disturbance secondary to nervous system overload.
Neurological and Head Symptoms:
Noted for dullness of the left half of the head.
Heaviness in the forehead, and head drawn backward, especially in convulsive states.
Eyes appear excessively brilliant, but lack mental responsiveness.
Skin Reactions and Urticaria:
Beneficial in cases of urticaria arising suddenly, especially with cold, clammy surface and signs of systemic collapse.

name: AMYGDALUS PERSICA
indications:
Persistent Nausea and Vomiting:
Especially beneficial in constant nausea and vomiting, regardless of cause or modality.
Valuable in morning sickness during pregnancy, where even water may be rejected.
Indicated when no form of food is tolerated, particularly in infants and children suffering from gastric irritation.
Gastric and Intestinal Irritation:
Helps in gastric inflammation, marked by a red, elongated, pointed tongue, especially at the tip and edges.
Indicated in intestinal upset with nausea and inability to retain food or fluids.
Useful in digestive sensitivity in children, particularly during acute infections or teething.
Urinary Bleeding and Irritation:
Indicated in hæmaturia and hæmorrhage from the bladder, often accompanied by ischuria (difficulty or suppression of urine).
Acts on urinary tract mucosa in cases of bleeding due to irritation or inflammation.
Loss of Smell and Taste:
Associated with sensory impairment, including loss of smell (anosmia) and loss of taste, especially when linked to gastric conditions.
Eye Irritation:
Indicated in general irritation of the eyes, which may accompany systemic digestive or urinary complaints.

name: AMYL NITROSUM
indications:
Climacteric Flushings and Vascular Surges:
Especially suited for flushes of heat at the menopausal (climacteric) period, often accompanied by anxiety, palpitations, and profuse sweating.
Heat and redness surge over the face and head, followed by cold clammy skin or sweating, reflecting superficial arterial hyperemia.
Aids in throbbing sensations throughout the entire body, particularly during or after influenza or febrile illness.
Cardiac Distress and Precordial Anxiety:
Amylenum nitrosum is indicated in tumultuous, fluttering heart action, even from slight excitement, with constriction and pressure around the heart.
Helps in palpitations with precordial anxiety, particularly during climacteric episodes, or after emotional disturbances.
Useful in dilated superficial vessels, including veins of the hands and visible arterial throbbing.
Head Congestion and Mental Restlessness:
Marked by surging of blood to the head, as though it might burst through the skin, accompanied by flushing and ear hyperemia.
Patient may feel intense anxiety, as if “something dreadful might happen,” needing fresh air immediately.
Beneficial in climacteric headaches and mental unease linked to vascular congestion.
Sudden Constriction and Oppression:
Patient feels tightness in the throat, as though the collar is too tight, and may complain of oppression in the chest.
Indicated in spasmodic or suffocative cough, dyspnea, and a sensation of fullness in the chest.
Neurological and Reflex Disturbances:
Offers temporary relief in epileptic convulsions, where sudden vascular changes are involved.
Also useful in hiccough, yawning, and reflex responses from autonomic instability.
Postpartum and Female Support:
Amylenum nitrosum aids in after-pains and postpartum hemorrhage associated with flushing of the face and vascular excitability.
Particularly beneficial in addressing vascular symptoms at menopause, such as palpitations, headaches, and sweats.
General Restlessness and Extremity Symptoms:
Patient may experience constant stretching for hours, with visible dilation of veins in the hands.
Pulsations can be felt in the fingertips, and limbs may exhibit signs of vascular overload or tension.

name: ANACARDIUM OCCIDENTALE
indications:
Intolerable Itching and Vesicular Eruptions:
Indicated in almost unbearable itching, often associated with vesicular eruptions, especially on the face.
Aids in umbilicated vesicles, similar in appearance to small-pox lesions.
Skin symptoms include blisters, ulcers, and swelling, often caused by or resembling poisoning reactions.
Erysipelas and Directional Skin Inflammation:
Especially suited for erysipelas that spreads from right to left, in contrast to Rhus toxicodendron, which covers the opposite direction.
Also addresses erysipelatous swelling and redness due to toxic exposure.
Warts, Corns, and Skin Growths:
Anacardium occidentale aids in assisting corns, hard excrescences, and warts, especially when thick and resistant.
Beneficial in cases of ringworm, obstinate ulcers, and other chronic skin affections.
Mental Weakness and Memory Impairment:
Produces aweakness of memory and intellect, similar to Anacardium orientale.
Indicated in cases of general mental dullness, imbecility, or post-toxic cognitive decline.
Paralytic Conditions:
Associated with a general paralytic state, often accompanying or following skin eruptions or systemic toxicity.
May be indicated in motor weakness linked to neurological deterioration.
Painfully Swollen Tongue:
Characterized by painful swelling of the tongue.

name: ANACARDIUM ORIENTALE
indications:
Mental Deterioration and Dual Consciousness:
Indicated in fixed ideas and hallucinations, where the patient feels possessed by two wills or personalities.
Profound hypochondriasis, melancholy, and a tendency toward violent outbursts and swearing.
Aids in brain-fag, impaired memory, absent-mindedness, and suspicion of others.
Helps those with lack of self-confidence, aversion to work, and absence of moral restraint.
Anacardium orientale relieves fear of examinations in students, along with anxiety while walking, as if being pursued.
Clairaudient states, where patient hears distant or dead voices, often accompany mental decline.
Nervous Dyspepsia Relieved by Eating:
Characterized by a classic empty sensation in the stomach, where eating temporarily relieves all discomfort.
Aids in weak digestion, bloating, distention, nausea, vomiting, and eructations.
Patient has a habit of swallowing food or drinks hastily, often with a sensation of choking during meals.
Plug Sensations in Rectum, Chest, and Organs:
Sensation of a dull plug in rectum, bladder, eyes, chest, or abdomen, contributing to feelings of internal obstruction.
Rectum appears powerless, with ineffectual urging and spasmodic anal constriction, even for soft stool.
