Relieves swelling of glands, especially at the nape of the neck.
General Debility and Sweating
Alleviates weakness caused by perspiration, particularly during or after sleep.
Indicated in physical irritability, internal sensitivity, and restlessness with general fatigue.

name: ANTIMONIUM SULPHURATUM AUREUM
indications:
Respiratory Conditions and Mucous Accumulation:
Aids in hard, dry coughs with no expectoration, or mucous sputum mixed with blood and sweetish taste.
Manages passive congestion in the upper lobe of the left lung with difficult breathing.
Supports in bronchial and laryngeal catarrh, with tough mucus and fullness in the chest.
Relieves respiratory oppression and hard, full breathing due to mucous accumulation.
Itching of Extremities and Acne:
Relieves pustular acne, especially on the face and scrotum.
Supports itching of hands, feet, and genital areas, often accompanying skin eruptions.
Antimonium sulphuratum aureum
manages acne in sluggish constitutions, particularly with digestive or respiratory involvement.
Iris Prolapse and Nosebleed:
Aids in incipient amaurosis and spots on the cornea.
Supports rare but notable cases of iris prolapse through the cornea.
Relieves epistaxis (nosebleed)
on washing and increased mucus discharge from nose and throat.
Burning of Throat and Bad Taste:
Manages burning and roughness in the fauces, especially in the morning.
Relieves pasty mouth and bad taste on waking.
Aids in offensive mucus from the throat and sensation of a plug stuck in the pharynx.
Digestive Issues and Irregular Stool Consistency:
Supports gastric pressure and fullness, particularly in the umbilical region.
Relieves constipation with hard stools passed with effort.
Aids in sudden urging, followed by solid then pasty yellow stool, often followed by colic and abdominal rumbling.
Dark Urine with Scrotal Eruptions:
Manages increased, dark red urine.
Relieves itching pustular eruptions on the scrotum.
General Malaise and Mental Confusion:
Aids in general lassitude, malaise, and nausea with mental and physical fatigue.
Supports in heaviness of head, especially on sudden waking during the night.
Antimonium sulphuratum aureum
relieves confusion on waking, often accompanied by slight sweating and worsening of general symptoms.
Sleep Disturbances:
Manages deep, unrefreshing sleep, often followed by sudden waking after midnight.
Aids in dream-filled sleep with worsening of symptoms upon waking.

name: ANTIMONIUM TARTARICUM
indications:
Respiratory ailments with mucus accumulation:
Antimonium tartaricum is indicated for conditions where mucus accumulates in the chest but is not easily expectorated.
Symptoms include arattling cough, difficult breathing, and a feeling of suffocation, which improves when sitting up.
It is also used for bronchial congestion and emphysema in older adults.
Nausea, vomiting, and colic:
This addresses severe nausea and vomiting, especially after eating, with associated faintness and prostration.
It helps in treating colic with significant flatulence and abdominal pressure.
Conditions such as cholera morbus and digestive upset following alcohol consumption are also treated with this remedy.
Urinary tract problems:
Antimonium tartaricum helps with painful urination, burning sensations, and symptoms of urinary tract inflammation.
It is used for conditions like stricture, bloody urine, and bladder infections, as well as for urinary symptoms accompanying diseases like Bilharziasis.
Extreme fatigue and weakness:
It is suitable for cases of severe weakness, trembling, and faintness affecting the entire body.
It is useful for individuals who experience significant drowsiness, especially in conjunction with other symptoms.
Neurological and cognitive impairments:
Antimonium tartaricum is used for vertigo, delirium, and supor. Symptoms may include aband-like headache, despondency, and a general sensation of heaviness or tremors in the body.
Skin eruptions and warts:
This addresses pustular skin eruptions, warts, and conditions with a bluish-red discoloration.
It is also helpful for small-pox and similar dermatological issues.
Fever:
Antimonium tartaricum is used for fevers marked by alternating chills and intense heat, along with profuse sweating.
Symptoms include cold, clammy sweat and overall exhaustion.
It is beneficial for intermittent fevers and associated lethargy.
Sensory abnormalities:
This medicine treats for sensations of coldness in blood vessels and a feeling of heaviness or dragging in the back and coccyx.
It also addresses avelvety sensation in the chest.

name: ANTIPYRINUM
indications:
Skin Eruptions and Allergic Reactions:
Aids in erythema multiforme, eczema, and pemphigus with sudden onset.
Relieves urticaria with intense pruritus, often appearing and disappearing suddenly, with internal chilliness.
Manages angioneurotic edema, especially of the face, lips, eyelids, and genitals.
Antipyrinum
supports cases of dark blotches and swelling on the skin of the penis.
Helpful in itching and burning eruptions, with vesicles or bullae.
Nervous Anxiety and Seizures:
Relieves nervous anxiety, fear of insanity, and hallucinations of sight and hearing.
Supports in epileptiform seizures, trembling, cramps, and muscle contractures.
Aids in numbness, crawling sensations, and general prostration from nervous exhaustion.
Edematous and Constriction Sensation:
Manages throbbing headaches, particularly with constriction and flashes of heat.
Relieves headache under the ears and accompanying earache, buzzing, and tinnitus.
Aids in red, edematous conjunctiva with puffiness of lids and lachrymation.
Face Swelling and Toothache:
Relieves facial swelling and puffiness, particularly with lip edema and ulceration.
Supports in burning of mouth and gums, vesicular eruptions, and bloody saliva.
Manages toothache in the lower jaw, cheek lumps, and swollen tongue.
Dysphagia and Mucosal Irritation:
Aids in pain on swallowing, with burning sensation and fetid pus expectoration.
Helpful in white false membrane formations in the throat, suggestive of inflammatory or infectious conditions.
Relieves fluent coryza, nasal obstruction, and aphonia.
Supports dyspnea, frontal sinus pain, and Cheyne-Stokes respiration.
Burning in Stomach:
Manages burning in the stomach, nausea, and vomiting associated with systemic toxicity.
Aids in relieving gastric discomfort following drug reactions or fever states.
Decreased Urine Excretion and Vaginal Burning:
Supports in diminished urine output, especially with albumen and blood in urine.
Manages itching and burning in the vagina, suppressed menses, and watery leucorrhea.
Aids in penile edema, especially when dark skin blotches are present.
Faintness and Circulatory Weakness:
Antipyrinum
relieves faintness with sensation of heart stoppage.
Manages throbbing throughout the body, with rapid, weak, and irregular pulse.
Aids in circulatory weakness accompanying skin eruptions and fever with profuse sweating, nervous shuddering without chill.

name: Apis Mellifica
indications:
Edematous Swellings and Inflammations
Beneficial in assisting rosy-red, painful, puffy swellings of the skin and mucous membranes.
Indicated for erysipelas, cellulitis, and serous effusions.
Urine Burning and Soreness
Helps in burning, soreness, scanty or suppressed urination.
Apis mellifica is useful in strangury, incontinence, and high-colored urine with casts.
Pleuritic Effusion and Edema
Indicated in edema of larynx, dyspnea, and suffocative cough.
Provides relief in hydrothorax and pleuritic effusion.
Ovarian Pain with Metrorrhagia
Alleviates symptoms of ovarian inflammation, especially on the right side, with stinging pain and swelling.
Useful in dysmenorrhea, suppressed menses, metrorrhagia, and ovarian cysts.
Urticaria and Carbuncles
Used for urticaria, carbuncles, hives, erysipelas, and itching skin eruptions.
Soothes burning, stinging, red, and sensitive skin conditions.
Eye Inflammation
Beneficial for conjunctivitis, eyelid swelling, and stinging pain in the eyes.
Used for keratitis, styes, and eye infections with chemosis and redness.
Gastrointestinal Distress
Helpful in diarrhea, especially watery, yellow, and painless types, and involuntary stools.
Alleviates sore, tender abdomen, and dropsy of the abdomen.
Mental Irritability and Tearful
Addresses apathy, irritability, jealousy, and emotional hypersensitivity.
Symptoms include sudden shrill cries, tearfulness, and difficulty concentrating.
Headache and Numbness
Indicated in headaches with sudden stabbing pain, vertigo, and head heaviness.
Beneficial for numbness, tingling, and soreness of limbs.
Fever and General Weakness
Used in afternoon fevers with chill, thirst, and minimal sweating.
Apis mellifica helps with prostration, bruised soreness, and fatigue after illness.

name: APIS VIRUS
indications:
Neurological Conditions and Meningitis
Indicated in meningitis in children, especially with symptoms of coma, frothing at the mouth, and neurological depression.
o:
Apis virus addresses hysteria, fainting tendencies, and sudden syncope, often of a nervous origin.
Septic States and Infections
Beneficial in cases of septicemia, where there is systemic toxicity, rigors, and chilling sensations.
Useful in post-infectious weakness, particularly following scarlatina with glottic edema.
Edematous and Dropsical Conditions
Assists internal dropsy and edema, especially in mucosal or respiratory tissues.
Specifically indicated in edema of the glottis, posing risk of respiratory obstruction.
Chill and Fever States
Relieves symptoms of violent rigors, shivering, and shaking chills, often seen in septic or toxic conditions.

name: APIUM GRAVEOLENS
indications:
Urinary Retention and Abdominal Colic:
Aids in obstinate retention of urine, with painful abdominal pressure.
Relieves sharp sticking pain in the left iliac region, passing to the right side, with a sense of impending stool.
Supports cases of nausea, which increases with abdominal pain.
Apium graveolens manages soreness and sensitivity in the abdomen with loose stools or diarrhea.
Headache with Unrefreshing Feeling:
Relieves throbbing headaches, especially those improved by eating.
Supports individuals with mental fidgets, night-time restlessness, and overthinking that prevents sleep.
Aids in cases where patients wake between 1 to 3 a.m.
feeling unrefreshed, yet not physically tired.
Helpful in managing sunken eyeball sensation and itching in the inner canthus of the left eye.
Ovarian Pain and Tender Nipple:
Supports dysmenorrhœa with sharp, short ovarian pains, better when lying on the left side with legs flexed.
Relieves tenderness in nipples and uterine discomfort associated with premenstrual tension.
Aids in pelvic pain linked to left-sided ovarian discomfort, relieved by flexion and rest.
Rheumatic Pain:
Relieves rheumatic pain in the neck muscles and sacral region.
Manages growing pains in young individuals or adults with a constitutional tendency to muscular aching.
Tickling Cough with Chest Tightness:
Aids in tickling, dry cough with intense constriction over the sternum.
Relieves dyspnoea and tightness of the chest, especially on lying down.
Supports swollen throat sensations, associated with shortness of breath and drawing pain through to the back.
Skin Burning and Itching Disorders:
Apium graveolens manages itching blotches, burning skin sensations, and creeping feelings under the skin.
Aids in urticaria with shuddering, especially in hypersensitive skin.
Supports healing in granulating ulcers with profuse discharges.

name: APOCYNUM ANDROSAEMIFOLIUM
indications:
Vomiting and Shooting Groin Pain:
Aids in vomiting and purging, especially when relief follows copious evacuations.
Apocynum androsæmifolium
manages constipation associated with abdominal discomfort.
Relieves shooting pain in the left groin, suggesting involvement of pelvic or intestinal nerves.
Indicated in cases with sudden nausea, altered taste, and reflex symptoms.
Musculoskeletal and Joint Pains:
Relieves wandering rheumatic pains and violent joint pains with shifting locations.
Supports in swelling of hands and feet with stiffness and tenderness.
Helpful in managing pain in the right shoulder, left big toe joint, and knee.
Aids in burning and cramps in the soles, particularly in lower extremities.
Headache and Facial Neuralgia:
Manages stiffness and pain in the back of the head and neck.
Relieves neuralgic pain in the left zygoma and twitching in the face.
Supports in left-sided dental pains, especially in the lower jaw.
Pelvic Heaviness and Menstrual Irregularities:
Aids in profuse flow of clear urine, particularly in conditions suggestive of dropsy or fluid imbalance.
Relieves profuse menstruation lasting several days, accompanied by violent pressing pain.
Apocynum androsæmifolium
supports in pelvic congestion and heavy, prolonged menses.
Altered Senses:
Notable for peculiar altered olfaction, where everything smells like honey.
Described presence of a most delightful taste in the mouth, indicating sensory alteration.

name: APOCYNUM CANNABINUM
indications:
Dropsy and Edematous Conditions:
Aids in managing general dropsy with anasarca, ascites, and hydrothorax.
Supports drainage of excess fluid in renal and cardiac dropsy.
Apocynum cannabinum
relieves bloated abdomen and serous effusions with marked thirst and gastric intolerance.
Helpful in acute hydrocephalus with fluid accumulation and suppressed vitality.
Indicated in dropsy with a slow, weak pulse, and oppression in the epigastrium.
Urinary Complaints:
Supports in urinary suppression, dribbling, and strangury, especially with bladder distension.
Relieves hot, turbid urine with mucus and burning post-urination.
Aids in renal dropsy with scanty, difficult urination and diminished expulsive power.
Gastric Irritability and Digestive Issues:
Relieves nausea with drowsiness, especially in cases linked to Bright’s disease.
Manages excessive vomiting, where food or water is immediately ejected.
Supports flatulent stools with soreness and feeling of relaxed sphincter.
Aids in epigastric oppression, bloating, and sinking sensation in the stomach.
Useful in gastric weakness following or accompanying systemic water retention.
Arrhythmia and Cardiac Dropsy:
Aids in tricuspid and mitral regurgitation with cyanosis and pulsating jugulars.
Manages arrhythmia, low arterial tension, and irregular cardiac action in fluid-retaining states.
Relieves general circulatory stasis linked with dropsical complaints.
Absence Menses and Climacteric Hemorrhages:
Supports in amenorrhoea with bloating, and metrorrhagia accompanied by faintness and depression.
Relieves climacteric hemorrhages, where blood is expelled in large clots.
Aids in vital exhaustion during menstrual disturbances or menopause.
Dry Cough with Sighing Breathing:
Relieves short, dry, unsatisfactory cough with sighing respiration.
Supports chest oppression linked to abdominal distension and heart weakness.
Nasal Catarrhal:
Manages chronic nasal catarrh with frequent sneezing and easy nasal blockage.
Relieves snuffles in children, especially when linked to dullness and cold sensitivity.
Mental Dullness and Sleepiness:
Supports in mental dullness, low spirits, and sluggish memory.
Apocynum cannabinum
aids in restlessness and poor sleep, particularly in fluid-overloaded or toxic states.

name: APOMORPHIA
indications:
Vomiting and Gastrointestinal Reflex Disturbances:
Aids in managing sudden, forceful vomiting that occurs without preceding nausea.
Relieves reflex vomiting triggered by cerebral pressure or tumors.
Supports cases of vomiting in pregnancy, especially when it is unresponsive to typical medicines.
Helpful in sea-sickness, particularly when vomiting is abrupt and exhausting.
Manages sympathetic vomiting arising from non-gastric origins.
Substance Dependence and Nervous Exhaustion:
Supports detoxification and symptom relief in individuals with alcoholism and opium addiction.
Apomorphinum
aids in managing symptoms of combined substance dependency, including nausea, constipation, insomnia, and emaciation.
Relieves delirious headache, marked by intense vertigo and heat in head.
Supports in pronounced hysteria, especially when accompanied by digestive and sleep disorders.
Mental Confusion and General Prostration:
Apomorphinum
relieves drowsiness and faintness following vomiting or central nervous system exhaustion.
Manages insomnia and mental confusion seen in debilitated, toxic states.
Aids in reducing systemic burden from narcotic or alcoholic toxicity.

name: APOMORPHINUM MURIATICUM
indications:
Vomiting and Gastrointestinal Reflex Disturbances:
Apomorphinum muriaticum a
ids in managing sudden, forceful vomiting that occurs without preceding nausea.
Relieves reflex vomiting triggered by cerebral pressure or tumors.
Supports cases of vomiting in pregnancy, especially when it is unresponsive to typical medicines.
Helpful in sea-sickness, particularly when vomiting is abrupt and exhausting.
Manages sympathetic vomiting arising from non-gastric origins.
Substance Dependence and Nervous Exhaustion:
Supports detoxification and symptom relief in individuals with alcoholism and opium addiction.
Aids in managing symptoms of combined substance dependency, including nausea, constipation, insomnia, and emaciation.
Relieves delirious headache, marked by intense vertigo and heat in head with dilated pupil.
Supports in pronounced hysteria, especially when accompanied by digestive and sleep disorders.
Mental Confusion and General Prostration:
Apomorphinum muriaticum r
elieves drowsiness and faintness following vomiting or central nervous system exhaustion.
Manages insomnia and mental confusion seen in debilitated, toxic states.
Aids in reducing systemic burden from narcotic or alcoholic toxicity.

name: AQUA MARINA
indications:
Sensitivity to Seaside and Sea Travel:
Aids in managing sea-sickness, nausea, and queasiness aggravated by the motion or air near the sea.
Aqua marina supports recovery from symptoms brought on by staying at or near the seaside—such as headache, constipation, and biliousness.
Headache and Facial Neuralgia:
Relieves neuralgic pains extending down the right temple and forehead.
Manages left-sided facial pain aggravated by exposure to cold water.
Supports in headache conditions related to weather and location changes, especially near the ocean.
Throat and Cough Reflex:
Aids in sensation of a hair or fishbone stuck in the throat, provoking repeated swallowing.
Manages tickling in the throat causing adry, inbeneficial cough.
Relieves pain in throat radiating to the ear and temples upon swallowing.
Supports constant hawking and raising of tough, white, cotton-like phlegm.
Uneasiness and Sluggish Digestion:
Relieves bilious complaints such as nausea and abdominal uneasiness.
Supports in nausea linked with a nauseous sensation in both stomach and bowels.
Aqua marina manages sluggish digestion and constipation triggered by marine environments.

name: AQUILEGAIA VULGARIS
indications:
Hysteria and Nervous Sensitivity:
Aquilegia vulgaris aids in managing hysterical symptoms such as globus hystericus
(sensation of a lump in the throat) and clavus hystericus:
(sharp, localized head pain).
Supports nervous trembling of the body, especially when accompanied by emotional agitation.
Relieves hypersensitivity to light and noise often seen in nervous women.
Helpful in hysterical conditions during climaxis with associated digestive symptoms.
Dysmenorrhoea and Menstrual Flow Irregularities:
Relieves scanty menses accompanied by dull, painful pressure in the right lumbar region.
Aquilegia vulgaris manages dysmenorrhœa in young girls, especially when pain intensifies at night.
Aids in menopausal symptoms marked by morning vomiting of green substance.
Supports hormonal balance in climacteric women with emotional and gastric distress.
Sleep Disturbance:
Helpful in cases of sleeplessness related to nervous tension and hormonal imbalance.
Relieves disturbed rest caused by heightened sensitivity and internal unrest.

name: ARALIA RACEMOSA
indications:
Asthma and Respiratory Obstruction:
Aids in dry, wheezing asthma with a sense of impending suffocation and rapidly increasing dyspnoea.
Manages loud, musical whistling on both inspiration and expiration—worse during inspiration.
Relieves respiratory attacks aggravated on lying down; patient is obliged to sit up to breathe.
Supports constant need to clear the chest to improve inspiration.
Relieves spasmodic night cough that awakens the patient after first sleep and prevents further rest.
Relieves raw, burning soreness behind sternum and in both lungs, especially intense behind the sternum.
Supports alternating lung discomfort depending on body position—initially affecting the right lung.
Aralia racemosa manages cough caused by throat tickling or sensation of a foreign body.
Aids in early-stage cough with scanty sputum, progressing to warm and saltish expectoration.
Supports easy raising of loose phlegm after rising in the morning.
Rectal Disorders and Prolapsus:
Aids in sensation of impending diarrhoea, though only small amounts of soft yellow stool are passed with difficulty.
Supports prolapsus ani where rectal mucous membrane descends like a tumour.
Relieves aching pain in the rectum post-stool, extending upwards on the left side.
Manages rectal irritation and incomplete evacuation symptoms.
Acrid Leucorrhoea and Pelvic Discomfort:
Relieves acrid, offensive leucorrhoea associated with bearing-down pains.
Supports pelvic discomfort linked to mucous discharges and uterine heaviness.
Nasal and Throat Irritation:
Relieves smarting soreness of the posterior nares caused by acrid mucus.
Manages soreness of the alae nasi as if cracked or fissured.
Aids in easing mild nausea and discomfort in the throat.
Gastrointestinal Affection:
Supports faint nausea in both throat and stomach.
Aids in managing vague intestinal sensations that precede diarrhoea.
Relieves early digestive upset and functional discomfort after eating.
Fear:
Supports patients with persistent fear of lung disease that cannot be shaken off.
General Weakness and Malaise:
Aralia racemosa relieves marked prostration and “half-sick” feeling accompanied by nausea.

name: ARANEA DIADEMA
indications:
Periodicity, Coldness, and Damp Sensitivity:
Indicated in conditions with distinct periodic return of symptoms, particularly coldness and pain.
Coldness to the very bones; not relieved by heat or covering.
Aids in heat and flickering in eyes with sudden violent toothache especially while lying down.
Suited to hydrogenoid constitutions with intolerance to lakes, rivers, and damp climates.
Nervous System and Neuralgia:
Aranea diadema
helps in trigeminal neuralgia on the right side, with pain radiating inward.
Lumbo-abdominal neuralgia and intercostal nerve pain radiating from extremities to spine.
Confusion in the head, better from smoking in open air.
Restlessness during sleep with sensation of swollen, heavy hands and forearms.
Irregular Menses and Neuralgic Pain:
Menses too early and excessively copious.
Abdominal distention with heaviness in the pelvis.
Supports in associated neuralgic pain and lower abdominal discomfort.
Bleeding from Lungs and Chest Pain:
Bright red hemorrhage from lungs.
Indicated in intercostal neuralgia with sharp, radiating chest pain.
Helpful where lung involvement appears with vascular irritation.
Cramps and Enlarged Spleen:
Cramps in stomach after eating even a little food.
Epigastric region painful to pressure.
Colicky pain returning at the same hours daily.
Enlargement of the spleen and sensation of a heavy stone in the lower abdomen.
Diarrhea accompanied by abdominal heaviness and neuralgic features.
Extremities and Bone Pain:
Pain in long bones, especially during fever.
Bone-pains in arms and legs; aching in the heel (os calcis).
Sensation of numbness and limbs “falling asleep.”
Hands and legs feel enlarged, heavy, and asleep at night.
Sleep Disturbance:
Restlessness with frequent waking due to sensation of swelling in hands and forearms.
Heavy, numb sensation preventing restful sleep.
Fever and Constitutional State:
Chilliness and fever with bone pain and abdominal heaviness.
Marked periodicity in fever—same time daily.
Always worse in rainy weather and during damp conditions.

name: ARECA CATECHU
indications:
Helminthic Infestations:
Highly beneficial in helminthiasis, particularly where parasitic worms disturb digestive health.
Acts as a strong anti-parasitic agent through its active alkaloid action.
Eye Disorders:
Indicated in glaucoma, especially where rapid pupil constriction is required.
Arecoline contracts the pupil more rapidly and forcefully, though with shorter duration.
Supports ocular nerve regulation and intraocular pressure control.
Salivary and Secretory Action:
Acts as a salivatory agent, aids in enhancing glandular secretions.
Supports moisture and functional activity in dry mouth conditions.
Cardiovascular and Intestinal Stimulation:
Increases the amplitude of heart pulsations, aiding circulation.
Areca catechu support intestinal contractility, beneficial in conditions of sluggish bowels or hypo-motility.

name: ARGEMONE MEXICANA
indications:
Abdominal Spasms and Flatulence:
Beneficial in colicky cramps and spasms of the bowels.
Supports in griping sensation in the pit of the stomach.
Relieves nausea and sick feeling, as if about to vomit.
Assists in belching and passing excessive gas.
Helpful in lack of appetite with abdominal uneasiness.
Painful Neuro-Muscular Conditions:
Manages painful neuro-muscular states that interfere with sleep.
Indicated in rheumatic disorders, especially when linked to Bright’s disease.
Supports general relief in muscular and joint pain.
Headache and Throat Dryness:
Relieves throbbing headache focused in the eyes and temples.
Head feels hot and congested.
Helps in painful dryness of the throat, aggravated on swallowing.
Urinary Troubles:
Passage of reduced quantity of urine.
Urine changes color, indicating functional urinary disturbance.
Female Reproductive Concerns:
Assists in cases of suppressed menstruation.
Helps in diminished sexual desire with accompanying weakness.
Extremities Stiffness and Swelling:
Argemone mexicana alleviates stiffness and pain in the left knee.
Supports in managing swelling of the feet and lower limbs.

name: ARGENTUM CYANATUM
indications:
Respiratory Spasms and Suffocative Attacks:
Beneficial in sudden suffocative attacks with short and difficult breathing.
Assists in managing constant dry, spasmodic cough which severely limits speech to single words.
Indicated in asthma-like episodes arising from throat or chest constriction.
Throat Burning and Esophageal Spasm:
Relieves scraping and burning sensation in the throat.
Useful in spasms of the esophagus with a marked sense of tightness and pain.
Supports in pain located in the supra-sternal fossa and under the manubrium sterni, aggravated by turning to the side.
Cardiac Affections:
Helpful in conditions resembling angina pectoris with chest tightness and difficulty breathing.
Argentum cyanatum supports circulation and cardiac comfort during constrictive episodes.
Cramps and Muscular Pain:
Manages painful cramps in the feet, often associated with systemic toxicity or muscular tension.
Facial and Mucosal Affection:
Face and tongue appear markedly red during attacks, indicating intense vascular and mucosal irritation.

name: ARGENTUM IODATUM
indications:
Throat, Pharynx, and Bronchial Disorders:
Aids in persistent catarrhal inflammation of the throat, pharynx, larynx, and bronchia.
Helps in managing chronic hoarseness associated with mucosal irritation.
Supports in long-standing bronchial catarrh and respiratory congestion.
Glandular Affections:
Useful in glandular swellings, especially when linked to chronic or syphilitic conditions.
Assists in reducing persistent glandular enlargement and dysfunction.
Mental Disorders:
Beneficial in peculiar mental states, including those marked by instability or emotional disturbance.
Argentum iodatum helps in managing altered mental function arising from chronic systemic imbalances.
Cataract:
Aids in management of cataract condition with opacity of lens.
Cardiac Concerns:
Assists in managing certain heart-related symptoms connected to catarrhal or systemic chronic states.

name: ARGENTUM METALLICUM
indications:
Mental Fatigue
Useful in states of melancholy, mental fatigue, and a constant hurried feeling.
Patient experiences adistorted sense of time
— time seems to pass slowly.
Mental symptoms often accompany left-sided physical pains and chest oppression.
Headache and Paroxysmal Neuralgia
Relieves dull, paroxysmal neuralgia that builds gradually and ends suddenly.
o:
Scalp is very sensitive to touch, with a feeling of emptiness and hollowness in the head.
Assists vertigo with an intoxicated feeling, especially when looking at running water.
Beneficial in facial bone pain, especially between the left eye and frontal eminence.
Red, thick eyelids and exhausting coryza with frequent sneezing.
Throat and Larynx Complaints
o:
Argentum metallicum alleviates rawness and soreness in the throat, especially on coughing or speaking.
Indicated in hawking of gray, jelly-like mucus, especially in the morning.
o:
Loss of voice:
(aphonia), especially in professional singers and speakers.
Sensation of a raw spot near the suprasternal fossa, with hoarseness and cough worsened by laughing or reading aloud.
o:
Altered voice timbre with chest weakness, more pronounced on the left side.
Hectic Fever and Chest Disorders
Assists hectic fever at noon, cough with easy expectoration resembling boiled starch.
Beneficial for chest oppression, dyspnea, and soreness from voice strain.
Used in conditions with total loss of voice, especially due to laryngeal irritation.
Backache
Relieves severe backache, especially when it forces the patient to walk bent over.
Associated with chest oppression, making upright posture difficult.
Polyuria
Supports increased urination (polyuria)
with profuse, turbid urine and a sweet odor.
Helps with frequent micturition, often accompanied by burning sensation.
Extremities and Rheumatic Pain
Alleviates rheumatic pain in joints, especially in the elbows and knees.
Assists trembling weakness in the legs, worse when descending stairs.
Useful in writer’s cramp, involuntary finger contractions, and partial paralysis of the forearm.
Reduces swelling of the ankles and general muscular fatigue.
Painful Testes
Relieves crushed pain in the testicles.
Manages seminal emissions without sexual excitement.
Assists frequent and burning urination associated with reproductive strain.
Bearing Down Pain and Enlarged Ovaries
o:
Argentum metallicum soothes bearing-down pains and sensation of enlarged ovaries.
Indicated in prolapse of the uterus, spongy eroded cervix, and foul-smelling leucorrhoea.
Helpful in left ovarian pain, climacteric hemorrhage, and uterine diseases associated with joint and limb pain.
o:
Sore feeling throughout the abdomen, worse from jarring or movement.

name: ARGENTUM MURIATICUM
indications:
Tearing Pains
Beneficial in managing tearing or sharp pains experienced generally throughout the body.
These pains may not be localized and can appear in various parts.
Urinary Complaints
Frequent and urgent need to urinate.
o:
Argentum muriaticum is beneficial in cases where the patient must void urine immediately upon feeling the urge.
Metallic and Bitter Taste
Addresses abnormal taste sensations, particularly ametallic or bitter flavor in the mouth.
Can be used when such symptoms occur in relation to other systemic conditions.
Frontal Headache
Relieves frontal headaches that typically worsen after 4 p.m.
Headaches aggravated by stooping or bending forward show marked improvement with this medicine.

name: ARGENTUM NITRICUM
indications:
Mental agitation and neurotic symptoms:
Argentum nitricum is useful for patients experiencing significant mental distress, including fears of impending evil, impulsive actions, and a sensation of parts expanding or other perceptual distortions.
It is indicated in cases where patients are highly nervous, anxious, and prone to making hurried decisions or actions.
Mucous membrane inflammation:
This addresses severe inflammation in mucous membranes, including the throat and gastrointestinal tract.
It is particularly helpful for conditions presenting with splinter like pains, muco-purulent discharge, and a notable desire for sweets.
Gastric and intestinal disturbances:
Argentum nitricum is indicated for a range of digestive complaints, including excessive flatulence, belching, nausea, and vomiting.
It is helpful for patients experiencing ulcerating, burning, gnawing stomach pains, often accompanied by an urgent craving for sweets and a painful swelling and discomfort in the abdomen.
Neurological Disorders:
The medicine beneficial for neurogenic conditions such as paraplegia, myelitis, and disseminated sclerosis.
It is particularly useful when symptoms include trembling, lack of coordination, and nervous headache following mental exertion.
Respiratory Complaints:
Argentum nitricum helps with chronic hoarseness, suffocative coughs, and feelings of tightness in the chest.
It is also indicated for respiratory conditions that worsen at night, as well as palpitations and breathing difficulties.
Dermatological issues:
This addresses skin problems characterized by a dry, tense appearance, with symptoms resembling awithered texture.
It is beneficial for managing irregular blotches and areas of hardened skin.
Urinary tract issues:
Argentum nitricum is indicated for conditions such as unconscious urination, painful and scanty urine, and inflammation of the urethra.
It is also helpful in early-stage gonorrhea with profuse discharge and severe cutting pains.
Menstrual and reproductive disorders:
It is useful for women experiencing gastralgia before beginning of menstruation, profuse leucorrhea with cervical erosion, and uterine hemorrhage.
It can also help with nervous erethism and painful ovarian conditions.
Sensory and Perceptual disturbances:
Argentum nitricum helps with blurred vision, photophobia, and nasal ulcers.
It is also useful for sensations of splinter in the throat and inflammatory conditions affecting mucous membranes.
General weakness and fatigue:
This is indicated for patients who experience profound exhaustion in calves.
It can be helpful in conditions where there is a feeling of being prematurely aged or debilitated.

name: ARGENTUM OXYDATUM
indications:
Diarrhoea with Anaemia
Particularly useful when diarrhoea occurs in individuals suffering from or recovering from anaemia.
Helps improve weakness and digestive irregularities caused by blood deficiency.
Post-Haemorrhagic Anaemia
Beneficial in assisting anaemia resulting from blood loss due to injury, surgery, or internal bleeding.
Supports the restoration of vitality and blood quality.
Metrorrhagia
o:
Argentum oxydatum helps manage abnormal uterine bleeding between menstrual periods.
Useful in cases with prolonged or excessive bleeding leading to exhaustion and low haemoglobin levels.

name: ARGENTUM PHOSPHORICUM
indications:
Internal and External Dropsy
Beneficial in managing abnormal fluid accumulation within the body (internal dropsy), including around organs and cavities.
o:
Argentum phosphoricum also addresses external manifestations such as swelling in the limbs or face due to fluid retention.
Supports the elimination of excess fluids and helps restore the body’s natural equilibrium.

name: ARISTOLOCHIA CLEMATIS
indications:
Sleep Disturbances
Aids in relieving tossing about in sleep and nighttime restlessness.
Helps manage nervous excitement in bed, especially before menses.
Emotional Sensitivity
Helps in managing emotional instability, including easy weeping and deep sadness.
Aristolochia clematis aids in relieving the feeling of being easily offended and emotionally reactive.
Sadness improves in open air and during menstruation.
Fear and Anxiety
Aids in relieving fear of being alone and fear of people.
Helps manage anxiety about the future and social withdrawal.
Supports emotional grounding in those with anticipatory anxiety.
Mood Instability
Manages alternating moods – sadness with cheerfulness, exhaustion with activity.
Helps in cases of exhilaration alternating with lack of confidence.
Supports emotional regulation during climacteric and premenstrual phases.
Behavioral Tendencies
Aids in relieving feelings of isolation and forsakenness.
Helps introverted individuals cope with aggravation from company.
Supports those with manic industriousness, especially during emotional stress.
Mental Restlessness
Helps relieve restlessness and mental symptoms before menstruation.
Supports emotional well-being during menopause and puberty.
Mood swings and mental symptoms associated with hormonal changes are well-managed.
Menstrual and Uterine Pain
Aids in managing delayed first menses and suppressed menses due to cold.
Helps in relieving pain and inflammation of the left breast.
Useful in amenorrhoea during climacteric period.
Relieves pain in the uterus before and during menstruation.
Helps manage dark, coagulated, prolonged menses and menses during lactation.
Aids in relieving itching of genitals aggravated after menses.
Skin Eruptions
Manages eczema, especially of varicose veins.
Aids in assisting skin sensitivity to chafing and infected ulcers.
Helps in relieving erysipelas and ulceration of varicose veins.
Polyuria and Urethral Inflammation
Relieves frequent urination at night and involuntary urination in elderly women.
Aids in managing inflammation of the urethra.
Helps with incontinence due to injury.
Nausea and Rectal Discharge
Aids in managing ravenous appetite with vertigo.
Relieves violent nausea, especially when worsened by certain foods.
Helps in relieving mucous rectal discharge, tenesmus, and prolapse.
Mucosal Inflammation
Useful in inflammation of the middle ear with noises and pain.
Aids in managing profuse nasal discharge with sneezing in the morning.
Helps relieve visual disturbances such as darkening on rising and light sensitivity.
Joint and Musculoskeletal Pain
Manages joint pain aggravated by pregnancy, sewing, or knitting.
Helps relieve varicose and congestive leg pain before menses.
Aids in swelling and tearing pain in the joints.
Supports recovery from inflammation of joints, phlebitis, and milk leg.
General Weakness and Convalescence
Aristolochia clematis helps relieve weakness, chilliness, and vertigo.
Aids in physical recovery post-illness or miscarriage.
Supports individuals with tiredness that improves with menstruation.

name: ARISTROLOCHIA SERPENTARIA
indications:
Dyspepsia and Vomiting
Beneficial in cases of dyspepsia, flatulence, and nausea with vomiting.
Indicated when the patient feels increased appetite but becomes satisfied with the first few bites.
o:
Aristolochia serpentaria helps in heaviness and fullness of the stomach, often relieved by passing gas.
Assists vomiting that continues until the stomach is fully emptied.
Beneficial in relieving distension, cutting abdominal pain, and rumbling in the bowels.
Abdominal and Colic Complaints
Helpful in colic centered in the umbilical region.
Alleviates abdominal uneasiness and discomfort, especially when accompanied by frequent eructations and flatulence.
Indicated for distended abdomen with pressure and gas buildup.
Stool and Anus Disorders
Assists frequent but ineffectual desire for stool, with scanty, hard, and sticky feces.
Addresses excessive flatulence during defecation, often with minimal stool passed.
Relieves distressing itching around the anus and discomfort from retained gas.
Urinary and Genital Irritation
Supports relief from general irritation in the urinary and genital organs.
Indicated in frequent urge to urinate, with large or small amounts of urine passed.
Urine may be brownish, and the desire to urinate can be urgent and uncomfortable.
Irritability and Nervous Tension
Recommended for individuals experiencing peevishness and mental irritability.
Useful in states of disinclination for mental or physical work, often associated with nervous tension.
Headache and Strain
o:
Aristolochia serpentaria alleviates sticking pain in the forehead, which can extend to the base of the brain.
Assists increased sensation of warmth in the head.
Relieves pressive pain in the nape of the neck, especially during fatigue or mental strain.
Excess
Salivation o Helps with copious salivation and frequent need to spit, often seen in cases of gastric irritation or nausea.

name: Arnica Montana
indications:
Injuries and Trauma
Beneficial in assisting symptoms resulting from falls, blows, contusions, and mechanical injuries.
Aids in recovery from trauma, whether recent or remote in origin.
Prevents septic infections and supports healing in pus-forming wounds.
Helpful in abscesses that do not mature and in tissue degeneration.
Addresses black and blue spots, bruises, and hemorrhagic conditions.
Musculoskeletal and Rheumatic Discomfort
Relieves sore, lame, bruised feelings in the limbs and body.
Joints feel sprained, and the bed feels too hard.
Eases rheumatism of muscular and tendinous tissues, especially in back and shoulders.
Useful in gout, pelvic bruises, and dislocated sensations.
Alleviates pain in the back and limbs, especially after overexertion.
Reduces coldness in the forearms and pain that worsens with touch.
Indifference and Delirium
Assists traumatism of grief, remorse, or shock from financial loss.
Helps in cases of fear of touch or approach, nervousness, and oversensitivity.
Indicated in indifference, moroseness, and delirium.
Patient may say
“nothing is the matter”:
yet feel ill.
Beneficial in agoraphobia, mental strain, and coma-like drowsiness with correct replies when spoken to.
Headache and Vertigo
o:
Arnica montana relieves hot head with cold body, confusion, and pinching head pains.
Assists chronic vertigo, particularly with whirling of objects during walking.
o:
Scalp feels contracted, with cold spot on the forehead.
Soreness and Paralysis
Soothes bruised, sore eyes after close work or exposure to bright visuals.
Helps in retinal hemorrhage, muscular paralysis, and diplopia from trauma.
Manages tinnitus, blood from ears, and bruised pain in ear cartilage.
Assists nosebleeds after coughing, cold nose, and soreness inside the nose.
Fetid Breath and Sunken Face
Corrects fetid breath, bitter or bad egg taste, and dry mouth.
Useful in soreness of gums after dental procedures and empyaema of maxillary sinus.
Face appears sunken or very red, with heat in the lips and facial herpes.
Abdominal Pain
Assists vomiting of blood, pressure in the stomach, and fetid vomiting.
Useful in pain during eating and sensation of stomach pressing against spine.
Relieves stitches under false ribs, distension, and offensive flatulence.
Offensive
Stool and Dysentry o Manages offensive, brown, bloody, putrid, and involuntary stools.
Helps in tenesmus, diarrhea from consumption, and worse lying on the left side.
Assists dysentery with muscular pain and the need to lie down after each stool.
Urinary Retention
Supports cases of urinary retention from overexertion.
Assists dark urine with brick-red sediment and vesical tenesmus with painful urination.
Uterine Hemorrhage and Sore Nipples
Beneficial in bruised sensations after labor, after-pains, and uterine hemorrhage after injury.
Assists sore nipples and mastitis from trauma.
Helpful in the sensation of fetus lying crosswise.
Spasmodic Cough and Angina Pectoris
Assists dry, spasmodic cough caused by grief or cardiac lesion.
Helpful in acute tonsillitis, swollen palate, pneumonia, and dyspnea with hemoptysis.
Manages hoarseness, raw sore feeling in morning, and bloody expectoration.
Used in angina pectoris, irregular pulse, cardiac dropsy, and fatty heart.
Skin Eruptions
Addresses black and blue discolorations, itching, burning, and acne indurata.
Useful in boils, bedsores, and symmetrical skin eruptions.
Sleep Restlessness and Terror Dreams
o:
Arnica montana assists restlessness, sleeplessness after fatigue, and dreams of death, mutilation, and terror.
Helpful in involuntary stools during sleep and nightly horrors.
Fever and Chills
Suitable for low-fever states, typhoid-like symptoms, and septic fevers.
Characterized by chills over the body, hot head, cold extremities, and nightly sour sweats.

name: ARNICA MONTANA RADIX
indications:
Blood & Circulatory Disorders:
Helps in hemorrhagic states with weak, irregular pulse and circulatory depression.
Supports collapse with bluish lips, cold surface, and faintness as if death were imminent.
Manages passive venous stasis with ecchymoses and bluish spots on skin.
Digestive & Abdominal Affections:
Helpful in violent nausea and persistent vomiting caused by gastric irritation.
Arnica montana radice manages burning and sinking at epigastrium with distension.
Assists in gastric catarrh with loss of appetite.
Female & Uterine Complaints:
Helpful in passive uterine hemorrhage, especially in weak, prostrated states.
Supports recovery after blood loss with cardiac and nervous weakness.
Nervous & General Symptoms:
Arnica montana radice helps in stupefying headache, vertigo, and confusion as if objects were too far away.
Aids in nervous irritability with trembling and muscular weakness.
Children or adults may present with extreme prostration and collapse.
Skin & Musculoskeletal:
Supports cases of bluish or reddish-purple discolorations of skin.
Helpful in ecchymosis, bruised soreness, and general tenderness to touch.
Assists with swelling and unhealthy skin conditions after trauma or blood changes.

name: ARSENICUM ALBUM
indications:
Profound Debility and Exhaustion:
Arsenic album is indicated for individuals experiencing severe weakness and exhaustion after minimal exertion.
Symptoms include persistent restlessness and a sense of fatigue that worsens at night, reflecting astate of general debility and irritability.
Burning Pains:
This medicine is useful for addressing burning sensations throughout the body.
These pains are often relieved by heat and can occur in various sea shore locations, indicating asystemic tendency toward burning discomfort.
Gastrointestinal Distress:
Arsenic album helps manage severe gastrointestinal issues, including nausea, vomiting, and intense stomach burning.
It is particularly useful for symptoms triggered by specific foods, with a notable aversion to food and the presence of dark, foul-smelling stools.
It also aids in the treatment of dysentery and cholera.
Respiratory Disorders:
This helps for respiratory conditions such as asthma and suffocative catarrh.
Symptoms may include asensation of constriction in the chest, a dry cough that worsens at midnight, and difficulty breathing, especially when lying down.
Itching and burning:
Arsenic album addresses various skin issues, including severe itching, burning, and rough, scaly eruptions.
It is useful for treating malignant pustules, ulcers, and gangrenous skin inflammations, characterized by swelling and burning sensation.
Febrile and Septic Conditions:
It is indicated for high fevers, particularly those accompanied by significant exhaustion and cold sweats.
Arsenic album is also used for managing septic fevers and conditions like typhoid, where there is marked fatigue and restlessness.
Nervous and Mental Disturbances:
This helps with severe mental symptoms such as extreme anxiety, fear of death, and suicidal tendencies.
It also addresses hallucinations, confusion, and a persistent sense of despair, indicating asignificant impact on mental health.
Anemia and Nutritional Deficiencies:
Arsenic album is beneficial for treating anemia and chlorosis, with symptoms including gradual weight loss and impaired nutritional absorption.
It supports individuals with poor nutritional status and general weakness.
Cardiac weakness:
The medicine is used for various heart conditions, including palpitations, angina pectoris, and signs of fatty degeneration.
It also addresses faintness, dilatation and cyanosis, indicating compromised heart function.
Urinary Disorders:
It is beneficial for urinary issues such as scanty, burning urine and albuminuria. Symptoms may include weakness in the abdominal area after urination and conditions related to Bright's disease.
Reproductive Health Issues:
In females, Arsenic album is indicated for excessive menstruation, burning in the ovarian region, and acrid leucorrhea.

name: ARSENICUM HYDROGENISATUM
indications:
Severe Collapse States and Exhaustion:
Particularly indicated in collapse of cholera and yellow fever with systemic breakdown.
Relieves great malaise and prostration, especially when triggered by cold, damp conditions or sudden temperature changes.
Headache and Facial Pain:
Alleviates astupefying, heavy sensation in the head, as if weighted down.
Face appears drawn, aged, and filled with pain, reflecting underlying toxic states.
Loss of Appetite and Abdominal Complaints:
Manages tormenting hiccough accompanied by extreme sensitivity in the epigastric region.
Helpful in loss of appetite with a sensation of internal burning.
Relieves burning sensations on the abdomen's surface, accompanied by cold feet and general chill.
Useful in constipation with heaviness, described as a weighted stiffness in the abdomen.
Anorectal and Perineal Health:
Addresses frequent, sharp pains in the perineum, extending either to the anus or upward into the anterior rectal wall.
Burning Heat and Hematuria:
Beneficial in cases with renal pressure radiating to the shoulder blades.
Assists in copious pale urination, and haematuria with systemic weakness.
Reduces burning heat over the renal region, especially in fever states.
Menses Suppression and Pustular Eruption:
In males, supports healing of pustular eruptions on foreskin and glans, which develop into round superficial ulcers.
In females, indicated in sudden menses suppression with subsequent systemic effects: internal chill, tearing pain in limbs, confusion, ear ringing, red diarrhoea, cracked dry tongue, and retching cough at night—particularly when Arsenicum album fails.
Respiratory Discomfort:
Manages tight chest constriction and ammoniacal breath, particularly in systemic collapse states.
Aids in dry cough at night that causes retching and worsens overall fatigue.
Pain in Back and Extremities:
Relieves sharp pain behind the right shoulder-blade, described as sticking or stabbing in nature.
Assists with tearing pains in hands and feet, commonly post-menses suppression or systemic infection.
Skin and Circulation:
Indicated in cases of dark-brown, sallow skin tone, signaling toxic or circulatory failure.
Relieves numbness or “deadness” in limbs, progressing from hands to forearms and feet to knees, later affecting the nose and eyebrows—with accompanying cessation of pulse.
Notably, hair turns white over affected "deadened" areas, suggesting aprofound systemic effect.
Fever and Temperature Dysregulation:
Relieves burning heat in localized areas, particularly over the kidney region, with systemic fever and weakness.
Beneficial in recurrent fevers with great exhaustion and chilliness.

name: ARSENICUM IODATUM
indications:
Pleuritis and Tubercular Affections:
Indicated in early tuberculosis with afternoon fever, exhaustion, and night sweats.
Aids in pulmonary tuberculosis with hoarse, racking cough and purulent expectoration.
Helpful in chronic pneumonia with abscess formation and unresolved lung inflammation.
Manages pleuritis with exudation, chronic bronchitis, and broncho-pneumonia after influenza.
Reduces dry cough with difficult expectoration and aphonia.
Improves respiratory weakness with cardiac debility and emaciation.
Nasal Acridity and Throat Burning:
Beneficial in persistent, acrid, corrosive nasal discharges with sneezing and mucosal ulceration.
Useful in hay fever, old nasal catarrh, and swelling of nasal tissues.
Aids in hypertrophy of Eustachian tube with associated deafness.
Soothes sore, swollen, and excoriated nasal membranes.
Relieves burning throat pain with swollen tonsils and fetid breath.
Indicated in chronic follicular pharyngitis and diphtheritic membranes extending to the lips.
Cardiac Weakness and Vascular Dysfunction:
Supports senile heart weakness, myocardial degeneration, and arteriosclerosis.
Indicated in chronic aortitis and feeble, irregular pulse, especially in the elderly.
Aids in conditions of anemia with palpitation and shortness of breath (amenorrhea-related).
Addresses threatened pyemia with systemic prostration and recurring fever.
Watery Diarrhoea and Heartburn:
Alleviates intense nausea and vomiting, especially occurring an hour after eating.
Manages epigastric pain and distress, along with painful heartburn (pyrosis).
Helpful in intense thirst with immediate vomiting after drinking water.
Useful in chronic, watery diarrhoea in phthisical (tubercular) patients with good appetite but increasing emaciation.
Mucosal Inflammation:
Aids in scrofulous ophthalmia with inflammation and discharge.
Beneficial in otitis media with offensive, corrosive ear discharge and thickened tympanic membrane.
Dry Skin and Exfoliation:
Assists dry, scaly skin conditions like ichthyosis and psoriasis.
Relieves eczema of the beard with oozing, itching eruptions worsened by washing.
Indicated in acne with hard, indurated base and pustular apex.
Supports exfoliation of skin in large flakes, revealing raw, moist surfaces beneath.
Addresses enlarged scrofulous glands and venereal buboes with general wasting.
Weakness and Fever States:
Beneficial in cases with recurrent fever, drenching night-sweats, and rapid, feeble pulse.
Aids in profound prostration with inability to bear cold.
Useful in chronic infections with a tendency to lingering inflammation, debility, and emaciation.
Tremulous and Vertigo:
Relieves vertigo with tremulous sensation, especially in aged individuals.
Helps in states of nervous exhaustion, fatigue, and lingering weakness post-illness.

name: ARSENICUM METALLICUM
indications:

Aids in weak memory, especially for reading and comprehension.
Supports patients with irrational fears, such as fear of being poisoned.
Helpful in mental dullness and poor retention.
Headache and Hairfall:
Reduces heavy, dull headache in the forehead, especially in the morning.
Eases fullness in the head on waking, with a sensation as if the brain would burst.
Alleviates left-sided pain extending to ear and eye, often with associated nausea.
Addresses hair fall related to systemic imbalance.
Headache triggered by writing, laughing, or thinking.
Swelling and Facial Burning:
Relieves sore, red, and irritated eyes; beneficial for right-sided pterygium.
Eases swelling and soreness of the upper eyelid.
Assists coryza and hoarseness, especially worse in the morning.
Manages sneezing, red eyes, and excoriating tears, with periodic nasal swelling.
Reduces facial burning, swelling, and itching, aggravated at night and improved by cold washing.

Helps with a white-coated tongue and dental impressions on the tongue’s surface.
Useful in sore, ulcerated mouth and inflamed throat.
Addresses small throat ulcers and painful swallowing, especially right-sided inflammation after coryza.
Sore Liver and Bloating:
Relieves sore liver pain radiating to shoulders and spine.
Soothes spleen and groin pain, especially in the evening.
Reduces abdominal bloating and breast-area discomfort.
Manages early morning abdominal pain with burning, watery stools that relieve pain but cause great exhaustion.
Eases right-sided groin swelling, worse on leg extension.
Irregular Bowel and Hemorrhoids:
Alleviates burning diarrhoea with watery stools, followed by weakness and sleepiness.
Beneficial in assisting constipation with difficulty or straining.
Relieves painful, bleeding haemorrhoids with anal itching that extends to perineum and scrotum, better from washing with hot water.
Bubo and Chancres:
Addresses evening heat in urine and red sandy sediment.
Relieves groin pain (right in the morning, left in the evening).
Eases bubo in the right groin, worse from stretching, better from walking.
Assists chancres with burning pain and offensive genital sweat.
Arsenicum metallicum helps reduces itching in the glans and scrotum with swelling of the prepuce.
Scanty Menses:
Useful in early, scanty menstruation.
Relieves burning in the uterus and vagina, especially when touched.
Eases pain during periods in the pelvic and vaginal regions.
Respiratory and Chest Discomfort:
Eases stitching pain in the breasts, radiating to the hip and spleen.
Relieves chest heaviness at night, often with dreams involving danger or water.
Cardiac Pain and Pulse Acceleration:
Manages cutting pain in the heart around 4 p.m., with relief on lying on the left side.
Useful in morning pulse acceleration.
Musculoskeletal Discomfort:
Reduces stiffness and swelling in fingers and joints, with joint cracking.
Alleviates icy coldness or burning in hands and feet.
Assists lameness in the right hip and thigh, worse from initial movement, bathing, or lying on the right side; better from walking.
Relieves dryness in the right knee joint.
Skin peeling and Rashes:
Assists skin peeling in small scales.
Useful in facial or abdominal rashes and small boils.
Reproduces suppressed syphilitic skin symptoms in chronic cases.
Sleepiness:
Aids in excessive daytime drowsiness, even after restful sleep.
Supports those who feel sleepy but are unable to fall asleep.

name: ARSENICUM SULPHURATUM FLAVUM
indications:
Diarrhoea and Stomach Burning:
Beneficial in chronic, offensive diarrhoea with watery, green, and slimy stools.
Particularly indicated for diarrhoea occurring daily at 8 a.m. and continuing throughout the day, sparing nighttime.
Eases associated colic, tenesmus, and backache linked to loose bowels.
Alleviates gnawing and burning sensations in the stomach, often accompanied by nausea and vomiting.
Useful in cases of indigestion marked by disgust for food and yellow-white furred tongue.
Anxiety and Emotional Disturbances:
Addresses intense anxiety and apprehension, especially when torturous or obsessive in nature.
Helpful in patients with disturbed sleep marked by starting or jerking as if falling out of bed.
Supports relief from night-time restlessness, mental excitement, and dreams associated with seminal emissions.
Gonorrhoea and Yellow Discharges:
Especially useful in gonorrhoea with copious, persistent yellow discharge and severe urethral burning.
Relieves pain and restlessness in gonorrhoeal cases, where the discomfort is constant day and night.
Headache and Ulcers:
Manages needle-like, stitching pains in the right frontal region of the head.
Supports oral health in cases with swollen, stiff tongue coated yellow-white, later becoming dry.
Useful in herpetic ulcers of the mouth and throat with marked dryness and bitter taste.
Skin Eruptions and Peripheral Symptoms:
Addresses skin eruptions, particularly on the outer side of the left wrist and inner side as well.
Suitable for cases where dry, cracked itchy eruptions accompany internal weakness or chronic infections.
Weakness and Delayed Development in Children:
Arsenicum sulphuratum flavum helps emaciated children, particularly those who walk late or show signs of developmental delay linked to chronic digestive or systemic disturbance.
Supports recovery in chronic laryngeal conditions such as laryngeal phthisis and post-illness weakness.

name: ARSENICUM SULPHURATUM RUBRUM
indications:
Skin Conditions:
Help in psoriasis, eczema, acne, and furuncles.
Helps with itching in various parts of the body.
Stomach and Digestive Complaints:
Addresses burning in the stomach described as "like coals of fire," worse by drinking cold water.
Sharp, cutting pains in the left side of the abdomen after meals.
Sensation of weight and gnawing in the stomach.
Diarrhoea:
Manages diarrhoea with yellow, mushy stools, occurring early in the morning after rising and again in the evening before bed.
Constant tenesmus (straining) in the anus accompanies the stool.
Head and Neuralgia:
Severe, continued pain deep in the brain in the right frontal region and right ear, worse from stooping and exercise, better from cold application, and worse around 5 p.m.
Waking with dull pain in the forehead over the eyes, spreading over the top of the head to the crown.
Pain starting at the back of the head and spreading around the sides.
Neuralgia on the right side of the face, nose, jaw, and through the temple.
Mouth and Throat:
Mucous membranes of the mouth and throat are inflamed.
Right tonsil enlarged.
Intolerable itching in the throat that triggers ashort, dry, expulsive cough.
Hoarseness with thick, sticky mucus in the throat.
Chest and Heart:
Wakes at 5 a.m. with a sharp, cutting pain starting between the cartilages of the 5th and 6th ribs, going inward and upward into the chest, worse with the slightest motion.
Occasional sharp pains through the base of the heart that interfere with breathing.
Backache and Painful Limbs:
Heavy, pressing pain from the tip of the coccyx to the anus after rising in the morning, with soreness of the coccyx.
Pain in the anus worse from straining at stool or urination.
Rheumatism running from the right shoulder down the arm, felt as if in the bone.
Pain in the right hip with lameness of the leg.
Severe pain in the left shin (tibia).
Joints remain stiff and immovable during recovery from acute symptoms.
Chilliness and Convulsions:
Marked chilliness, felt even while sitting in front of a hot stove.
Restless sleep with very vivid dreams.
Irritability, with the person acting with unusual energy despite feeling unwell.
Convulsions and numbness have also been noted.
Most symptoms are worse at night and worse on waking.

name: ARTEMISIA VULGARIS
indications:
Epileptic and Convulsive Disorders:
Highly beneficial in epileptic seizures, especially when triggered by fright, exhaustion, or menstrual irregularities.
Useful in cataleptic states induced by physical exertion or emotional strain, where attacks are marked by breath-holding followed by deep inspiration.
Aids in convulsions of suckling or teething children, with trismus and frothing at the mouth.
Supports cases of epilepsy with violent sweating and prolonged deep sleep post-attack.
Addresses nightly convulsions with tongue-biting, teeth grinding, and thumbs clenched into fists.
Nervous and Mental Disturbances:
Manages somnambulism and sleepwalking with absent-minded behavior.
Helpful in stupor following convulsions and unconscious chewing motions.
Assists inclination to steal or unusual behavior following fright or emotional trauma.
Supports cases with confusion, speech difficulty, or catatonic tendencies.
Eases Head, Eye, and Facial Spasms:
Relieves sharp shooting pains and spasmodic twitching that pull the head backward or sideways.
Assists in facial twitching, mouth distortion, and pressed jaw during spasms.
Manages dizziness triggered by colored light (e.g., through stained glass), a unique symptom keynote.
Digestive and Abdominal Distress:
Alleviates nausea, vomiting, and stomach cramps that accompany nervous episodes.
Eases violent abdominal cramping and greenish diarrhea often linked to seizures or worm infestation.
Aids in difficulty swallowing, where food escapes the mouth during spasms or seizures.
Irregular Menses and Lochia:
Especially beneficial in irregular, suppressed, or painful menstruation leading to seizures.
Assists violent uterine spasms and contractions, prolapse, and threatened miscarriage.
Supports cases of checked lochia and eclampsia in nursing mothers.
Helpful in nervous chlorosis associated with dryness of skin and uterine irritation.
Urinary Retention and Nocturnal Emission:
Relieves obstinate urinary retention (strangury), especially in children.
Manages involuntary passage of urine and feces during convulsions.
Addresses nocturnal emissions and seminal loss associated with nervous episodes.
Respiratory and Physical Weakness:
Eases rattling or obstructed breathing during fits.
Manages breath-holding episodes in catalepsy with sudden deep sighs.
Artemisia vulgaris alleviates fatigue and weakness in the legs after exertion or illness.

name: ARUM MACULATUM
indications:
Throat and Swallowing Difficulties:

indications:
Scrofulous and Rachitic Conditions:
Calcarea carbonica is particularly suited for individuals with scrofulous (a type of tuberculosis affecting the lymph nodes) and rachitic (related to rickets) conditions.
These are marked by swollen glands, bone deformities, and general weakness.
Cough:
This is supportive for treating various respiratory conditions including tickling coughs, which are particularly troublesome at night. It also addresses dry coughs with thick, yellow mucus and can help with extreme shortness of breath. It is beneficial for individuals with a cough exacerbated by eating or after exposure to certain irritants.
Digestive Problems:
Calcarea carbonica is indicated for individuals with a marked aversion to meat and fat, alongside cravings for indigestible substances like chalk or coal.
Digestive symptoms include frequent sour eructations, heartburn, and loss of appetite. It is useful for managing conditions involving sour vomiting and an overall weak digestive system.
Abdominal Distress:
It helps in conditions of abdominal sensitivity, with symptoms like swollen abdomen, incarcerated flatulence, and distention. Individuals may experience pain and discomfort in the liver region, and sensitivity to tight clothing around the waist.
Glandular Swelling:
This addresses swelling in various glands including submaxillary, mesenteric, and inguinal glands. It is indicated for conditions where these glands become swollen and painful.
Skin Conditions:
Calcarea carbonica is used for skin issues such as unhealthy, flaccid skin prone to ulceration and infections. It also helps in cases of nettle rash, warts, and chilblains.
Delayed milestones:
In children, it is indicated for delayed milestones like learning to walk, and a tendency to eat indigestible substances. They may have a large head, pale skin, and be prone to obesity. It is also helpful for managing their digestive disturbances and susceptibility to colds.
Menstrual irregularities:
For females, Calcarea carbonica is used to treat irregular menstrual cycles, including early, profuse, or prolonged periods.
It also addresses leucorrhea (a milky vaginal discharge) and conditions of uterine polyp or deficient lactation.
Neurological and Psychological problems:
This is beneficial for those experiencing mental fatigue, confusion, and anxiety, especially with fears of loss of reason or misfortune.
It addresses symptoms like apprehension, forgetfulness, and an aversion to work or any exertion.
Joint and Muscular Pain:
It is indicated for joint pain, particularly rheumatoid in nature, and muscle pain that feels like sprains with tearing sensation.

Addresses sensation of a bone or foreign object lodged in the pharynx.

Manages sticking pains in both hypochondria, especially the left side.
Helps with pain in the spleen region, described as if a ball were turning on its axis.

Addresses violent stitches in the small intestines, particularly when bending forward.

Aids in relieving painful stool with sensations as if a nail were scratching in the anus.
Addresses thin, pasty stools with mucus.
Aids in passing tapeworm segments and managing associated digestive irritation.
Helps in hemorrhoids and tearing, sticking rectal sensations.
Addresses crawling sensations in the rectum and anus, suggestive of worm infestation.
Early Menstruation:
Helps regulate early-onset menses, especially when they occur around eight days ahead of schedule.

Aids in managing hoarseness and rawness in the trachea with accompanying throat pain.
Helps in dry coughs with expectoration of mucus and blood, especially with chest stitching.
Calcarea caustica manages oppressive, pressive, or sticking pains under the sternum.
Addresses stabbing sensations across the chest and specifically on the left side.

Helps in stiffness of the neck and back of the neck, extending to all neck muscles.
Aids in tearing pain in the nape and between the shoulders.
Manages violent scapular pain that extends to the lower back, worsened on inspiration.
Addresses tearing in the coccyx and small of the back, along with pressure, drawing, or sticking sensations.
Aids in evening sensations in the shoulder blades as if they were fuzzy or numb.
Helps with back pain on waking that improves with movement.
Trembling, Weakness, and Wandering Pains:
Helps manage trembling in the limbs and general weakness, often improved temporarily by eating.
Addresses rheumatic pain that alternates between different joints.
Aids in wandering, shifting pains throughout the limbs and body.
Helps in relieving aches in the hands and feet, particularly after afoot bath.
Joint Stiffness and Tearing Sensations:
Aids in tearing pains in shoulders, arms, axillae, and left wrist.
Helps with a paralytic feeling in the right hand.
Addresses tension and stiffness in the lower extremities.
Manages stitches in hip joints and tearing pain in knees and lower legs.
Helps with specific tearing sensations in right tibia, left heel, and left tendo Achillis.
Aids in pain from corns marked by sharp sticking.
Skin Eruptions and Itching:
Aids in managing rash-like eruptions on the forehead.

Helps address restlessness during sleep with frequent, vivid dreams and nightmares.

Calcarea caustica aids in managing violent chills with chattering of teeth occurring in the evening between 7 to 7:30 p.m.

indications:

Vomiting of undigested food with weakness and daintiness of appetite.

Blind piles, with pain in back extending down on the sacrum.

Supports healing of chaps, cracks, fissures, and indolent, fistulous ulcers.

Addresses marked skin whiteness, suppurations, and knots, kernels, hardened glands in the female breast.
Conjuncitivitis and Cyst:
Supports in cataract, conjunctivitis, and corneal spots, especially in strumous children.

Fear and Depression:
Relieves groundless financial fears, mental depression, and feelings of danger in dreams.
Supports individuals overwhelmed by chronic physical conditions with emotional heaviness.
Spasmodic Cough and Hoarseness:
Calcarea fluorica manages hoarseness, spasmodic cough, tiny yellow mucus expectoration, and tickling on lying down.
Aids in croup, relaxed uvula, tonsillar crypt plugs, and throat burning improved by warm drinks.
Sleep Disturbance:
Supports in unrefreshing sleep with vivid dreams and feelings of danger or insecurity.

name: CALCAREA HYPOPHOSPHOROSA
indications:
Mental and Physical Exhaustion:
Supports in mental depression with marked indisposition to move or exert.
Calcarea hypophosphorosa relieves emotional inertia, where the person feels unable to respond, think clearly, or act.
Headache with Vascular Congestion:
Manages dull, heavy, pressive headache extending across the top of the head and parietal regions.
Addresses headaches with mental depression, sense of fullness, and oppression about the heart.
Aids in pain moving from the vertex to forehead, extending right to left temple across the frontal bone.
Cardiovascular and Respiratory Symptoms:
Relieves fullness and oppression around the heart, particularly following acongestive headache.
Aids in dyspnea requiring open air, profuse sweating, and complete muscular collapse.
Supports in vascular engorgement, where veins of the hands, arms, neck, and head stand out prominently.
Paralysis and Loss of Power:
Addresses total loss of muscular strength, where limbs are perfectly powerless.
Supports individuals who are unable to move arms or legs, rise from a chair, or speak above alow monotone.
Manages complete loss of desire to move, coupled with physical inability to do so.
Sweating and After-Effects of Collapse:
Relieves profuse, general sweating, particularly associated with cardiac or circulatory exhaustion.
Calcarea hypophosphorosa addresses dry, cracked lips, increased thirst, and low-grade feverish states following collapse or sweating.

name: CALCAREA IODATA
indications:
Glandular Swellings and Tumors:
Supports enlarged, indurated, and swollen glands, particularly in chronic scrofulous or tubercular constitutions.
Aids in tumors of the breast, especially where the tissue is hard and slow-growing.
Addresses cases of mollities ossium:
(softening of bones), combining Calcarea’s nutritive support with Iodine’s resolving power.
Supports chronic consumption and cancerous tendencies with glandular involvement.
Mental Indolent and Emotional Indifferent:
Relieves mental indifference and apathetic behavior, common in chronic fatigue or wasting disorders.
Calcarea iodata manages indolence and lack of initiative, especially when related to constitutional weakness.
Headaches and Dizziness:
Aids in giddy headaches, light-headedness, and unusual sensations (e.g., “as if the head wasn’t, yet was”).

Relieves sharp, piercing pain in the right temple, and headaches provoked by cold wind while riding.
Mouth and Taste Disturbances:
Addresses dry, furred feeling on the lips and tongue.
Supports management of bitter taste, which is relieved by tobacco in some cases.
Aids in astringent taste, often reflecting deeper systemic imbalance.
Digestive and Flatulent Complaints:
Relieves frequent eructations, hiccough, and nausea.
Manages abdominal rumbling with constant evacuation of large quantities of flatus.
Supports flatulent dyspepsia and bowel sluggishness linked to glandular conditions.
Skin Irritations:
Aids in itching that shifts location, often only relieved after vigorous scratching.
Calcarea iodata addresses irritative skin tendencies, especially in glandular or lymphatic patients.

name: CALCAREA MURIATICA
indications:
Glandular Affections and Scrofula:
