Mental Weakness & Anxiety:
Histaminum helps in addressing mental fatigue, irritability, and a general inability to focus or recall names and words. It is also useful for alleviating disturbing thoughts of death and unpleasant dreams.
Pain and Constriction:
Individuals may experience pain in small spots, particularly in the eyes (worsened by drafts), and a constriction sensation at the root of the nose.
Feelings of tightness, constriction, or enlargement in the chest or heart are common, often accompanied by anxiety.
Leucorrhoea:
An offensive leucorrhoea, resembling burnt blood, may be present.
Respiratory Symptoms:
Histaminum helps alleviate symptoms of respiratory distress related to allergies, such as wheezing, shortness of breath, and chest tightness, by reducing inflammation in the airways.
External Sensitivity:
Individuals may experience sensitivity to drafts or changes in temperature, which can exacerbate their symptoms, particularly in the respiratory system.

name: HOANG-NAN
indications:
Mental and Emotional:
Beneficial in mental fatigue, lassitude, and an overall disinclination to mental or physical effort.
Hoang-Nan helps those feeling drained, or unable to engage in daily tasks due to constitutional weakness.
Head and Vertigo:
Indicated for headaches associated with vertigo, particularly in systemic or toxic states.
Digestive and Abdominal Complaints:
Assists in abdominal colic, often accompanied by diarrhea in acute or chronic conditions.
Useful in digestive disturbances linked to toxemia or systemic infections.
Urinary System:
Indicated in albuminuria confirmed in multiple provers, pointing to kidney involvement.
Helps in cases with mucous casts in the urine, often accompanying chronic nephritis or toxic states.
Skin Conditions and Ulcers:
Remarkably beneficial in pustular eczema, boils, carbuncles, and other suppurative skin disorders.
Aids in malignant ulcers, including those with syphilitic or leprous origin.
Useful in prurigo with persistent, itching eruptions and breakdown of skin integrity.
Neurological and Paralytic States:
Supports in paralytic conditions, especially when stemming from chronic infection or systemic disease.
Indicated in tetanic convulsions, particularly those that begin in the lower limbs and spread upward.
Ulcerative and Glandular Affections:
Strongly beneficial in constitutional syphilis, aiding overall nutritional improvement and detoxification.
Hoang-Nan addresses glandular swellings and indurations, especially when connected to chronic infection.

name: HOLARRHENA ANTIDYSENTERICA
indications:
Dysentery:
Useful in treating acute and chronic dysentery, especially when associated with weakness, emaciation, and loss of appetite.
Helps alleviate colicky pain around the navel and reduces the severity of mucous stools with less blood.
Gastrointestinal discomfort and the recurrence of dysentery.
Fever:
Acts as an anti-pyretic, helping to reduce fever and manage associated symptoms, particularly in the context of gastrointestinal infections.

name: HOMARUS GAMMERUS
indications:
Frigtened and Mental Fatigue:
Homarus gammerus supports frightened, nervous states with dread of motion.
Useful in dullness, mental fatigue, and aversion to exertion.
Assists in emotional restlessness and a strange disconnected sensation when trying to grasp objects.
Limbs and Joint Pains:
Helpful in bone-deep pains in arms, elbows, and wrists, worse on the right side.
Alleviates pain in thighs, knees, and feet, often burning or laming in nature.
Manages weakness and trembling of the knees, more pronounced in the afternoon.
Assists in grinding joint pain, especially around the metatarso-phalangeal joints.
Dyspnea and Burning in Chest:
Relieves shortness of breath, especially after retiring.
Aids in sharp pains in the lungs, both left and right, radiating to the scapula and diaphragm.
Useful in burning sensations in the chest, around the sternum, and through the lungs.
Stomach Distress and Abdominal Pains:
Supports morning belching, stomach distress, and burning after meals.
Aids in pain across the epigastric region, radiating to the back or kidneys.
Useful in diaphragmatic pain, spleen and liver tenderness, and abdominal pressure after eating.
Irregular Bowels:
Manages alternating diarrhea and constipation, shifting every few days.
Indicated in tenacious, large stools passed with difficulty after disturbed sleep.
Helps in frequent urging, often followed by relief after passing gas.
Back and Spine Discomfort:
Assists in aching beneath the diaphragm, scapulae, and lower back.
Sharp pains near the kidneys and iliac crest may appear suddenly and force one to sit down.
Skin Eruptions and Pruritus:
Aids in itching all over the body, often changing locations and worse at night.
Beneficial for burning, biting, and darting sensations, especially on the lower limbs and calves.
May be followed by oedema of the lips and throat, especially after intense itching episodes.
Sleep Disorders:
Supports individuals who are restless at night, often waking shortly after falling asleep.
Aids in insomnia from systemic pain, particularly in the epigastric region, limbs, and back.
Often experiences disturbed sleep with vivid sensations, hot feet, and sensation of trembling without actual movement.
Headaches and Vertigo:
Aids in morning headaches, particularly sharp and localized to the temporal region, more on the left side.
Pain may radiate from over the eyes to the occiput, often with scowling or a need to rub the area.
Beneficial in frontal pain just above the eyes and dizziness.
Orbital Pain & Lachrymation:
Relieves eye aching, soreness to touch, and morning eyelid adhesion.
Indicated for smarting eyes, lachrymation, and orbital pain extending to the occiput.
Eases stabbing pains in the ear lobes, especially left side.
Sore Throat and Sneezing:
Helps in stinging and burning of the nasal passages, especially in the morning.
Useful in left-sided watery discharge, nasal stoppage, and frequent sneezing.
Indicated in sore, burning, and smarting throat, with granular appearance and sticky mucus.
Alleviates rawness and oedema of the throat, sometimes making breathing difficult.
Soreness often worse on the left side, but improved by cold air or holding the head.
Sexual Excitement:
Indicated for morning and night sexual excitement, sometimes prolonged.
General Weakness:
Homarus gammerus is useful in strange body sensations, feeling as if unable to move or act.
Aids general malaise, with weakness after exertion and relief after eating.
Often experiences arolling, full pulse with chilliness and feverish episodes.

name: HURA BRASILIENSIS
indications:
Emotional Unstability and Exhaustion:
Hura brasiliensis aids in sudden emotional outbursts, where weeping alternates with laughter.
Helpful in deep sadness with fear of losing loved ones; may visualize dead individuals.
Supports conditions marked by exaggerated conscientiousness, discouragement, and irritability.
Relieves mental exhaustion and aversion to work or responsibility.
Spinal, Muscular, and Joint Pains:
Supports in painful stiffness of the neck, especially on the right side.
Manages excruciating lumbo-sacral pain, especially when lifting.
Helpful in weariness of limbs, dislocated joint pain, and numbness in arms and legs.
Useful for throbbing in fingertips, splinter-like pain under nails, and knee soreness.
Skin Eruptions & Itching:
Beneficial in vesicular eruptions that itch intensely and may discharge fluid under pressure.
Aids in eczema-like eruptions, especially on cheeks, ribs, and bony prominences.
Reduces itching on the face, eyelids, beard, and extremities, often disturbing sleep.
Catarrhal Affections:
Beneficial in throbbing at the root of the nose, left wing redness, and acute smell sensitivity.
Helps manage coryza with nosebleeds and early catarrhal symptoms.
Reduces facial puffiness, dull complexion, and scarlet mottling.
Indicated in lip eruptions, pimples on gums, and coppery mouth taste.
Headache and Tinnitus with Visual Disturbances:
Indicated in head heaviness, dizziness, and numbness of the scalp.
Helps with constriction in the back of the head and painful lancinating headaches.
Supports burning, prickling, and sandy sensation in the eyes, with visual disturbances like sparks or zigzags.
Useful for ear pain, especially right-sided, and whizzing or whistling tinnitus.
Indigestion and Abdominal Colic:
Aids in stomach pain, especially when associated with ravenous hunger quickly relieved by eating.
Relieves nausea, qualmishness, and throbbing left-sided abdominal pain.
Manages cutting or twisting pains across the lower abdomen and pelvic region.
Useful for stitching pain in the ileo-caecal region aggravated by movement.
Frightful colic with diarrhœa and shivering.
Hard Stool and Anorectal Constriction:
Supports in painless, offensive diarrhea, sometimes containing threadworms.
Assists in frequent, inbeneficial urging, anal constriction, and difficult hard stools with constipation.
Followed by marked weakness of the chest and body after stool.
Renal Colic and Profuse Menses:
Indicated for pain in the right kidney and urgent need to urinate, especially while walking.
Urine may be light green, clear, or deposit awhite sediment.
Hura brasiliensis assists in intense erections, amorous dreams, and yellowish semen.
Useful for early, profuse menses, uterine cramping as if a sharp instrument were thrust into it, and leucorrhea.
Cough with Lancinating Chest Pain:
Relieves dry cough from throat dryness, with thick, frothy, or bloody expectoration.
Helps with rust-colored sputum, feeling of suffocation, and sighing or yawning from chest tension.
Indicated in lancinating chest pains, throbbing sensations, and small lump feeling under right breast.
Sleepiness and Vivid Dreams:
Helps in restless nights, yawning, and drowsiness.
Indicated in disturbing dreams of swimming, yellow water, corpses, or being pursued.
General Weakness and Fever:
Manages cold, damp skin, especially on the feet and body.
Useful in sudden chills, flushes of heat, and cold sweat, particularly on the face.
Hura brasiliensis aids in recovery from malaise, physical fatigue, and low vitality.

name: HYDRANGEA ARBORESCENS
indications:
Urinary Tract infection:
Burning Sensation in the Urethra: There is a burning feeling during urination.
Frequent Urination: The urge to urinate occurs often, indicating irritation or infection.
Difficulty Starting Urination: Patients may experience trouble initiating the urine flow.
Mucus in Urine: A heavy deposit of mucus can be found in the urine.
Renal Calculi (Kidney Stones)
White Amorphous Salt Deposits: The urine contains aprofuse amount of white, amorphous salts.
Pain in the Loins: Sharp pain is particularly felt in the loins, especially on the left side.
Bloody Urine: The presence of blood in the urine indicates irritation or damage in the urinary tract.
Renal Colic:
Severe, intense pain in the lower back area, specifically around the kidneys.
Enlarged prostrate:
Increase in the size of the prostate gland, along with urinary problems.
Excessive thirst accompanied by discomfort in the abdomen.
Chest oppression:
A feeling of tightness or heaviness in the chest.
Abdominal discomfort:
Symptoms include pain or discomfort in the lumbar region, often associated with urinary issues.
Dizziness:
A sensation of lightheadedness or vertigo.
No description available.
Hydrangea arborescens:

name: HYDRASTINUM
indications:
Mouth Ulcers & Aphthous Conditions:
Hydrastinum
is indicated in aphthous sore mouth with painful ulceration of mucosa, especially in children and debilitated patients.
Used for simple or malignant ulcers inside the mouth, gums, or soft palate.
Supports tissue repair and pain reduction in cancerous oral lesions when used locally.
Nasal Discharges & Ozæna:
Beneficial in ozæna
—a chronic nasal condition marked by foul-smelling, crusty discharges.
Aids in ulcerative lesions inside the nares and nasal cavity, especially those with necrotic tissue and fetid smell.
May prevent secondary infections in nasal ulcers and support mucosal healing.
Ulcers and Malignant Conditions:
Helpful in managing malignant ulcers, including oral, nasal, or skin-based ulcerative growths.
Aids in checking tissue degeneration and aids in granulation.
Female Reproductive Health:
Uses by physicians in managing uterine hemorrhage, especially passive, prolonged, or post-hemorrhagic states.
Hydrastinum
supports mucosal and epithelial healing within the vaginal and cervical areas affected by ulceration or erosion.

name: HYDRASTIS CANADENSIS
indications:
Catarrh:
Hydrastis canadensis is known for its effect on mucous membranes, leading to a thick, yellowish, ropy secretion.
Catarrh with specific mucous discharge.
General Debility and Cachexia:
Particularly beneficial for older, easily fatigued individuals with significant weakness.
Poor digestion, persistent constipation, muscle weakness, and overall exhaustion.
Dyspepsia:
Hydrastis affects the liver and digestive tract.
Weak digestion, bitter taste in the mouth, sore sensation in the stomach, atonic dyspepsia, constant sore feeling in the stomach, pulsation in the epigastrium, difficulty eating bread or vegetables, jaundice, gallstones, and gastrointestinal catarrh.
Cancerous Conditions:
Used in the early stages of cancer before ulceration occurs, focusing on pain relief.
Useful in tumors, including goitre during puberty and pregnancy.
Depression:
Depression with a sense of impending death and a desire for it.
Headache and Sinus Conditions:
Dull, pressing pain in the forehead, myalgic pain in the scalp and neck muscles, sinusitis following acold, and eczema along the hairline.
Ear and Nasal Catarrh:
Roaring in the ears, muco-purulent discharge, deafness, Eustachian catarrh, thick nasal discharge, watery excoriating discharge, and ulceration of the nasal septum.
Mouth ulcers:
Peppery taste, swollen and flabby tongue with teeth imprints, stomatitis, ulceration of the tongue, raw and smarting sensation in the throat, follicular pharyngitis, and post-nasal dripping of tenacious mucus.
Back Pain:
Dull, heavy, dragging pain in the lumbar region, stiffness, and the need to use arms for support when rising from a seat.
Anal prolapse and fissure:
Prolapsed anus, fissures, constipation with a sinking feeling in the stomach, dull headache, hemorrhoids with exhausting light flow, smarting pain during stool, and prolonged pain after stool.
Urinary problems:
Gleety discharge and urine with a decomposed odor.
Gonorrhea:
Thick, yellow discharge in the second stage of gonorrhea.
Menorrhagia and Leucorrhea:
Erosion and excoriation of the cervix, acrid and corroding leucorrhea, and menorrhagia, pruritus vulvae with profuse leucorrhea, sexual excitement, and breast tumors with retracted nipples.
Bronchitis:
Raw and sore chest, dry cough, bronchial catarrh, bronchitis with thick yellow expectoration, frequent faint spells with cold sweat, and feeling of suffocation when lying on the left side.
Skin eruptions:
Smallpox-like eruptions, lupus, ulcers, cancerous formations, excessive sweating, and unhealthy skin.

name: HYDROCORTISONE
indications:
Skin Affections & Allergies:
Supports cases of eczema, urticaria, and allergic rashes with intense itching.
Helps relieve chronic dermatitis, psoriasis, and inflammatory eruptions.
Manages hypersensitive skin with redness, scaling, and burning.
Aids in relieving allergic rhinitis and hay fever symptoms.
Adrenal Insufficiency & Weakness:
Hydrocortisone assists in states of adrenal exhaustion with profound weakness.
Supports recovery in fatigue, mental dullness, and inability to cope with stress.
Helps in cases of hypotension, lassitude, and endocrine imbalance.
Inflammatory & Rheumatic Conditions:
Joint pains with swelling, stiffness, and tenderness.
Supports management of chronic arthritis and inflammatory rheumatism.
Helps in muscular soreness and general aching in autoimmune conditions.
Digestive & General States:
Hydrocortisone manage gastric irritation, nausea, and loss of appetite linked with endocrine imbalance.
Supports recovery in cachectic, anaemic constitutions with restlessness.
Assists in debility after long-continued allergic or inflammatory illness.

name: HYDROCOTYLE ASIATICA
indications:
Chronic Skin Affections:
Assists in scaly, crusty eruptions with circular patterns and raised edges.
Hydrocotyle asiatica
is useful in cases of leprosy, ichthyosis, favus, and lupus.
Eruptions with redness, itching, and burning, especially on the face, neck, back, and thighs.
Beneficial in elephantiasis arabum and gangrenous changes after amputation.
Supports healing in erythematous and miliary eruptions on neck, back, and chest.
Dullness with Gloomy:
Marked mental dullness, with a sensation of heaviness and indifference.
Prone to gloomy thoughts, misanthropy, and desire to be left alone.
In some cases, alternating states of gaiety or loquacity.
Headache and Cranial Sensations:
Indicated in neuralgic drawing in the cranial nerves, particularly in the frontal and occipital areas.
Heaviness and congestion of blood to the head, especially with vertigo.
Acute sensitivity of the occiput; pain often worsens with touch.
Sensation of constriction in the back of the skull and scalp.
Mucosal Inflammation:
Pricking, dimness, and dazzling vision, especially with conjunctival injection.
Throbbing, ringing, and confused noises in the ears; fullness and blowing sounds in left ear.
Nasal swelling and dry coryza with tickling and frequent nosebleeds.
Painful sensation in the left cheekbone and an intoxicated facial appearance.
Dryness and Increased Salivation:
Whitish patches
on tongue, with increased saliva and bitter or insipid taste in the morning.
Pain and redness in the velum palati, worsened by swallowing food.
Pricking, burning, and dryness in the esophagus and pharynx.
Hyperemia of buccal mucosa and impaired speech due to oral discomfort.
Gastric Discomfort and Hepatic Obstruction:
Aversion to food and tobacco; acid eructations and gastric discomfort.
Swelling and cramp-like contractions in the stomach, often forming aball-like sensation.
Heat in stomach
region radiating outward; anxiety in gastric area.
Violent contractions of intestines with flatus.
Useful in hepatic obstruction, pain in liver region, and associated hypogastric heat.
Constipation and Anal Itching:
Aids in dry, dark, and excess stools with a sensation of weight in the rectum.
Ineffectual urging, burning, and itching in the anus.
Beneficial in itchy rectal conditions with increased dryness and irritation.
Polyuria and Bladder Irritation:
Frequent urination
with constriction, and irritation along the urethra & bladder.
Urine appears brown on cooling and is turbid without sediment.
Slight formication in kidneys, especially the left side.
Increased secretion of urine and soreness in the urinary tract.
Sexual Indifference and Follicular Inflammation of Cervix:
Supports in drawing sensation in spermatic cords, scrotal relaxation, and impotence.
Indicated for sexual indifference and feeling of weight in the prostate gland.
In females, increased leucorrhoea, pain in uterus, especially left side.
Useful in pruritus of the vagina, heat and itching at its orifice, and uterine heaviness.
Recommended in follicular inflammation of cervix and vagina, and labour-like pelvic pain.
Chest Oppression and Cardiac Spasm:
Pricking and dryness
in the throat and larynx; irritation of air passages.
Voice feels weak, and talking induces fatigue.
Oppression in the chest
that comes and goes, often linked to poor expectoration.
Constriction of heart; with quiet and regular pulse or irregular beating of heart. Cardiac spasm.
Aching in Back and Limbs:
Aids in rheumatic pains in the left rhomboid region and loins.
Heaviness in kidneys, dull aching and bruised sensations in lower back.
Wandering pains in muscles of chest and legs.
Crampy pains in legs and calves, numbness in forearms and hands.
Pain in joints and muscles, worse on the left side; limbs feel weak and unsteady.
Sleep Disturbances and Fatigue:
Helps with yawning, daytime sleepiness, and persistent dreams.
Profound mental and physical fatigue; feeling bruised on waking.
General sense of malaise and disinclination for exertion.
Unpleasant mouth taste and Heavy, dreamless sleep.
Fever and Coldness of Extremities:
Hydrocotyle asiatica
helps with cold chills, cold hands and feet, especially in the afternoon.
Sensation of coldness in forearms and legs, temporarily relieved by rubbing.
Flushing heat in face, especially temples; bone heat, particularly in legs and tibia.
Profuse sweating
and signs of feverish onset without pulse alteration.

name: HYDROGEN
indications:
Emotional Disorders
Beneficial in cases of deep psychological isolation, existential anxiety, and spiritual crises.
Helps individuals feeling separated from the world or struggling with identity.
Cognitive and Perceptual Disturbances
Assists with poor concentration, memory lapses, and distorted perception of size or distance.
Useful in students or individuals with attention deficits.
Delusional and Dissociative States
Addresses delusions such as body-soul separation, and disconnection from reality.
May be indicated in cases with dissociative or schizoid tendencies.
Fear and Anxiety Disorders
Beneficial in individuals suffering from intense fears—of death, disease, going insane, or the unknown future.
Calms mental unrest and restores emotional equilibrium.
Dream Disturbances
Helps manage vivid, disturbing dreams involving death, crime, and animals.
Congenital Conditions
May aid in certain cases of congenital deformities, reflecting its deep systemic action.

name: HYDROPHOBINUM
indications:
Nervous and Mental Disturbances:
Intense nervous excitability with fears, phobias, or uncontrollable impulses.
Thoughts of violence or harmful actions, often irrational and involuntary.
Sudden outbursts of rage, biting tendencies, and desire to harm.
Obsessions, hallucinations, and clairvoyant states.
Acute sensitivity to external stimuli like sound, light, and smell.
Mania, lyssophobia, or hysterical behaviors following animal bites or emotional shocks.
Anxiety and fear of water (hydrophobia), wind, or bright lights.
Head and Brain Symptoms:
Violent headaches with pressing, throbbing pain, especially in the temples and forehead.
Head feels light, sore, or as though filled with air.
Convulsive movements of the head and neck; somnambulism.
Increased oiliness of hair; irritable and sensitive scalp.
Eyes and Vision:
Intense photophobia and visual hallucinations.
Rolling, staring eyes with dilated pupils; ulcers in the eye following bite wounds.
Vision of distant or imaginary figures (clairvoyance).
Ear and Nose Hypersensitivity:
Extreme sensitivity to noise; even conversation may trigger convulsions.
Strong sensitivity to smells; aggravation from tobacco or snuff.
Frequent sneezing as if a cold is about to begin, often caused by light or dust.
Throat and Swallowing Issues:
Intense spasm of the throat, especially when attempting to drink water.
Sore, burning throat with constant need to swallow but inability to do so.
Aversion to water; spasms triggered by the sight or sound of fluids.
Digestive and Abdominal Complaints:
Nausea, vomiting, and faintness after eating or drinking with prostration and restlessness.
Diarrhea or dysentery aggravated by hearing or seeing running water. Swollen inguinal glands.
Tenesmus during and after stool. Bloody mucus stool.
General soreness and rigidity in whole of abdomen; inability to digest solid foods.
Urinary and Sexual System:
Frequent urination triggered by the sound or sight of water.
Satyriasis or excessive sexual excitement, especially in males.
Involuntary seminal emissions, priapism, or hydrocele.
Female sexual hypersensitivity; prolapsed uterus and painful coition.
Respiratory System:
Breathing difficulties with spasmodic tightness in the chest and throat.
Barking, hoarse voice with dry cough.
Dyspnea aggravated by cardiac pain or anxiety.
Spinal and Limb Afflictions:
Ascending paralysis (Landry’s disease); twitching in limbs and muscles.
Weakness in legs, trembling, and spontaneous jerking.
Pain along sciatic nerve; heaviness of limbs.
Skin and Wound Reactions:
Quick healing of wounds; itching and biting sensations in skin.
Red or bluish discoloration around bite wounds; pustular eruptions.
Ulcers or malignant sores following bites or vaccination.
Sleep and Dreams:
Insomnia despite fatigue; frequent waking with exciting dreams.
Frequent yawning without sleepiness.
Tiredness in sacrum and back with numbness in head and inclined to be angry.
Fever and General State:
Intense coldness along the spine or right arm, often followed by heat and perspiration.
Sensation of internal heat with external coldness and weakness.
Profound prostration, especially after emotional or physical exertion.

name: HYGROPHILLA SPINOSA
indications:
Anasarca & Dropsy:
Helps in treating anasarca (generalized swelling of the body) and dropsy (edema), addressing fluid retention and systemic imbalances.
Gonorrhoea & Urinary Issues:
Aids in treating gonorrhoea and providing relief from urinary troubles and calculi (kidney stones).
Supports the treatment of hepatic obstruction with accompanying dropsy.
Insomnia & Impotency:
Those suffering from insomnia, helping promote restful sleep.
Impotency and related conditions, improving overall sexual health.
Rheumatism:
Provides relief from rheumatism, promoting better mobility and reducing discomfort.
Skin Conditions:
Useful for treating skin troubles, especially those that worsen from heat and improve with cold applications.
Fever:
Particularly helpful in treating malaria associated with urticaria.
The fever appears in the morning without chill or thirst and is accompanied by intense itching, which is relieved by cold applications.

name: HYOSCYAMUS NIGER
indications:
Mania and Mental Deterioration:
Hyoscyamus niger helps in uncontrollable talkativeness, lascivious behavior, and nudity, often seen in psychiatric conditions.
Indicated in mania with quarrelsome, suspicious, and obscene actions or speech.
Assists in delirium, jealous fits, and fear of poisoning.
Suited for mental deterioration, low muttering speech, and coma vigil in typhoid and other fevers.
Useful for patients who laugh at everything, act foolishly, or attempt to run away.
Headache and Brain Fluctuation:
Manages light-headedness, vertigo, and the sensation of a loose, fluctuating brain.
Helps in brain inflammation with unconsciousness, and head rolling movements.
Indicated in delirium tremens, with muscle twitching and violent mental activity.
Nymphomania and Sexual Hyperactivity:
Lasciviousness, with masturbatory gestures, nudity, or exposure of genitals.
In men, indicated for impotence, or sexual hyperactivity during fevers.
In women, helps with hysterical spasms, convulsions during menses, or puerperal mania.
Supports suppressed lochia, urinary disturbances, and convulsions in pregnancy.
Muscles Tremor and Cramping:
Indicated in tremors, spasmodic jerks, and epileptiform attacks.
Relieves cramps in calves and toes, and twitching of muscles
(subsultus tendinum).
Helps children who cry and sob in sleep or pick at the bedclothes.
Insomnia and Restlessness:
Profound insomnia, restlessness, or coma vigil with open eyes.
Patients may startle awake, experience nightmares, or fantastic dreams.
Aids in delirium with sleeplessness, often linked to fever or mania.
General Weakness and Convulsions:
Deep nervous agitation, restlessness, and muscle twitching.
Relieves tremulous weakness, especially in fevers or prolonged illness.
Deep sleep with convulsions.
Dilated Pupil and Vision Issues:
Pupils are dilated, fixed, sparkling, with a vacant or downcast gaze.
Aids in strabismus (eye misalignment), double vision, and colored borders around objects.
Manages spasmodic closing of eyelids and unresponsive eye movements.
Throat Constriction and Difficult Speech:
Tongue is dry, red, cracked, and stiff; difficult speech and foaming at the mouth.
Teeth covered in sordes; lower jaw often drops involuntarily.
Severe throat constriction and inability to swallow liquids despite thirst.
Elongated uvula and burning sensation in throat.
Toxic Gastritis:
Relieves nausea, hiccough, and vomiting, often with violent cramps.
Suited for toxic gastritis from spoiled or irritating food.
Manages distension, tympanites, and colic as if the abdomen would burst.
Red patches or spots may appear on the abdomen.
Irregular Bowel and Bladder Paralysis:
Aids in involuntary diarrhea, worsened by sleep or mental excitement.
Useful in lying-in diarrhea and bowel incontinence during fever or unconsciousness.
Supports in paralysis of the bladder and involuntary urination.
Patient may lack the will to urinate.
Hemoptysis and Spasmodic Cough:
Hyoscyamus niger aids in dry, spasmodic cough, especially worse lying down and better sitting up.
Relieves suffocative fits, chest tightness, and itching in the throat triggering cough.
Suited for hemoptysis or cough associated with spasms.

name: HYPERICUM PERFORATUM
indications:
Nerve Injuries:
Hypericum is highly effective for injuries involving the nerves, particularly those affecting fingers, toes, and nails.
It is especially useful for crushed fingers and tips, puncture wounds, and to alleviate pain after surgical operations.
Symptoms include excessive pain, prevention of lockjaw (tetanus), and spasms occurring after an injury.
Neuritis:
Tingling, burning, numbness, and flossy skin, along with general nerve pain and bruised feeling.
Pain Relief Post-Surgery:
This remedy can often replace the need for morphine in managing postoperative pain.
Haemorrhoids:
Pain, bleeding, and tenderness in the rectal area, along with dry, dull, pressing pain.
Spinal Injuries:
Pain in the nape of the neck, spinal concussion, and coccyx injury with pain radiating up the spine and down the limbs.
Asthmatic Conditions:
Hypericum helps with spasmodic asthmatic attacks that improve with copious expectoration, worsening in foggy weather but relieved by profuse perspiration.
Psychological disturbances:
This remedy aids those experiencing psychological disturbances following ashock.
Feelings of being lifted high or anxiety about falling, making mistakes in writing, and feelings of melancholy.
Headache and facial neuralgia:
Throbbing pain in the top of the head, brain feeling compressed or alive, facial neuralgia, and pulling, tearing toothache.
Skin problems:
This remedy treats skin issues, especially those resulting from nerve injuries.
Excessive sweating of the scalp, eczema with intense itching, herpes zoster, and lacerated wounds with significant blood loss.
Extremity Pain:
Addresses pain and discomfort in the limbs.
Darting pain in the shoulders, cramps in calves, pain in toes and fingers (especially tips), crawling sensations in hands and feet, and joints feeling bruised or experiencing hysterical pain.

name: HYPOPHYSINE
indications:
Female Disorders & Menstrual Irregularities:
Supports relief in amenorrhoea, dysmenorrhoea, and irregular cycles linked to pituitary imbalance.
Helps manage uterine inertia, scanty flow, or suppressed menses.
Assists in cases of sterility and irregular ovulation patterns.
Menopausal disturbances with flushing, restlessness, and nervousness.
Circulatory & Blood Pressure States:
Hypophysine supports regulation in hypertension due to pituitary-hypothalamic dysfunction.
Aids in conditions of sudden vascular excitement with throbbing headache.
Circulatory weakness with faintness and pallor.
Metabolic & Endocrine Disorders:
Assists in obesity linked with pituitary insufficiency.
Supports cases of diabetes insipidus with excessive thirst and polyuria.
Helps balance fluid metabolism and endocrine secretions.
Nervous Exhaustion & General Weakness:
Manages nervous irritability, restlessness, and sleeplessness from hormonal imbalance.
Supports recovery in weakness, fatigue, and dullness from pituitary dysfunction.
Depression and lack of concentration associated with endocrine disorders.

name: HYPOPHYSINE LA
indications:
Emotional and Irritability:
Indicated in emotional shocks following disappointment in love.
Discouragement and low mood during menstruation, often with hypersensitivity.
Irritability at ovulation, especially over trivial matters.
Paralyzing dreams of being pursued, threatened, or attacked, particularly by a red-skinned man with arrows.
Headache and Vertigo:
Occipital pain and constriction of the forehead, often from 3:00–4:00 p.m.
Headache alternating with scotoma, or accompanied by blindness in the left eye.
Worsens from jumping, too much sleep, or wearing contact lenses.
Vertigo, especially before or during menses, with a tendency to fall.
Pulsating, temple-to-temple pain due to anger or anxiety.
Helpful in psoriasis of the scalp with soreness and rawness.
Face Pigmentation and Mucosal Irritation:
Brown spots and pigmentation on the face.
Hoarseness of voice during hot weather.
Watery nasal discharge after menses and between 6:30–10:00 p.m.
Pain and obstruction at the root of the nose; nasal symptoms may impair hearing.
Yellow purulent discharge from the left ear; itching eruptions behind ears.
Myopia and visual distortion, especially when lowering eyes or during vertigo.
Right eye pain > pressure, with accompanying redness.
Digestive Disturbances:
Foetid watery discharge from the umbilicus.
Pimples on the abdomen, often transient but recurring.
Pain in the right hypochondria at the beginning of meals.
Hunger with headache, but aversion to eating.
Constipation alternating with diarrhea: dry, hard stools with mucus, or loose stools from prior incorrect food intake.
Diarrhea from seafood, and nausea aggravated by the smell of fats.
Lecorrhoea and Nodes in Mammae:
Itching and redness of the vagina, with discolored leucorrhoea.
Dark, chocolate-like menses, offensive and clotting after two to three days.
Flushes of heat, especially in climacteric women and young girls in the afternoon.
Nodules in the mammae: painful on the left side; enlarged, red, and hot on the right.
Profuse milk secretion upon squeezing the breasts.
Dysuria with Sleeplessness:
Urine has a distinct amniotic-like odor.
Needle-like pain at the urethral meatus, especially at the end of urination.
Sleeplessness, with stitching back pain around 6:00–7:00 a.m., relieved by rising.
Musculoskeletal Pain:
Lumbago on the left side; dorsal and cervical back pain < with motion.
Moist yellow acne on the cervical region, more on the right side.
Joint pain during wet weather, especially in elbows and fingers.
Finger joint pain > hot water, motion, and relieves by pressure.
Cough and Asthma:
Cough originating from throat irritation, especially on the left side.
Asthmatic breathing at night, aggravated by cold from bed sheets and requiring the patient to sit up.
Skin Eruptions:
Dry, granular, and vesicular eruptions that worsen at night.
Intense itching, often leading to scratching until bleeding, especially during sleep.
Also indicated in acne, vitiligo, and psoriasis of the scalp.

name: IBERIS AMARA
indications:
Cardiac Conditions and Palpitations:
Iberis amara assists in palpitations triggered by slight exertion, such as walking or pulling awindow.
Palpitations accompanied by flushed face, red eyes, and dull headache.
Suitable in consciousness of heart activity, especially with sharp, stitching pains and weight over the heart.
Relieves irregular, tremulous, or intermittent pulse, often felt as double beats.
Beneficial in hypertrophy of the heart with sensations of dragging, constriction, or prickling like a needle in the ventricles.
Dull, heavy aching in the left arm, with tingling and numbness in fingers.
Pain in the heart worsens lying on the left side or during laughing, coughing, or exertion.
Chest Constriction and Respiration Difficulty:
Helps relieve tightness, constriction, and pain under the sternum, often radiating through the chest.
Indicated in anxious pressure in the chest, with associated heat in the head and flushed face.
Respirations are laboured, frequent, and difficult, especially after exertion or while lying down.
Tickling and Stringy Mucus:
Aids in tickling, dryness, and tightness in the larynx and throat.
Constant hawking of stringy mucus, especially after meals, provides relief.
Choking and constrictive sensations in the throat associated with cardiac discomfort.
Helps in dyspnoea that worsens on going upstairs, often with a tight chest and urge to take deep breaths.
Tingling and Numbness:
Tingling and numbness in the left fingers, radiating up the left arm, often accompanied by palpitations.
Dull, heavy pain in the left arm, resembling pressure from prolonged compression.
Cold hands and feet, especially with hot face and flushed appearance.
Trembling of lower limbs after physical activity.
Disturbed Sleep:
Restless nights with ludicrous, horrid, or disturbing dreams.
Sleep disturbed by darting heart pain, especially when lying on the left side.
Tossing and turning throughout the night, leading to daytime irritability.
Fever and General Soreness:
Iberis amara aids in feverish chilliness, especially with nausea and cold extremities.
Heat and fullness in neck and head, along with flushed face, are common during febrile stages.
General feeling of lameness, fatigue, and soreness, resembling the after-effects of a cold.
Feeling as if unable to move even a finger, due to overwhelming weakness or trembling.
Sadness and Dull Memory:
Helpful in sadness, despondency, and mental oppression, often with frequent sighing.
Aids in irritability, dulled memory, and early morning nervousness.
Indicated in indefinable dread, trembling, and cold sweat on the face.
Restlessness, feeling of being frightened, and emotional hypersensitivity are prominent.
Headache and Vertigo:
Useful in vertigo with chilliness, nausea, and headache—especially when rising, standing, or stooping.
Head feels full, especially in the occiput with sensation as if it were turning around.
Pain in the right side of the head, often associated with flushed face and cold extremities.
Indicated in frontal headache after waking, linked with loss of appetite.
Redness of Eyes and Hearing Dullness:
Supports in red, hot eyes with a sensation of being forced outward.
Indicated in flashes before the eyes, especially with palpitations and headaches.
Ears feel dull, with roaring, laboured breathing, and associated heaviness of the head.
Belching and Liver Discomfort:
Iberis amara is indicated in loss of appetite, sour belching, and nausea with chilliness.
Supports in liver discomfort, right hypochondriac fullness, and clay-colored stools.
Manages abdominal tenderness, distension, and thin whitish stools with general digestive sluggishness.
Urinary Issues:
Aids in frequent but scanty urination or excessive passage of urine.
Useful when urinary changes are accompanied by cardiac symptoms.

name: IGNATIA AMARA
indications:
Hysteria:
Ignatia is particularly useful for individuals with heightened sensitivity and emotional disturbances. It addresses symptoms such as tonic spasms, hyperesthesia of the senses, and a tendency toward rapid and extreme mood changes.
Grief and Emotional Trauma:
This remedy is effective for those suffering from the effects of grief, worry, and disappointment. Symptoms may include silently brooding, melancholic mood, sighing, sobbing, and an inability to communicate feelings.
Headaches:
Ignatia is indicated for headaches that feel like a nail driven into the side of the head, cramp-like pains over the root of the nose, and congestive headaches following anger or grief.
Asthenopia (Eye Strain)
Symptoms include spasms of the eyelids and neuralgic pain around the eyes, often accompanied by flickering zigzags.
Facial Twitching:
The remedy helps with involuntary twitching of facial muscles and lips, as well as changes in facial color when at rest.
Oral Conditions:
Conditions such as a sour taste in the mouth, a tendency to bite the inside of the cheeks, constant saliva, and toothache aggravated by coffee and smoking are addressed by Ignatia.
Throat Problems:
It is beneficial for a feeling of a lump in the throat (globus hystericus), sore throat with stitches, and inflamed, swollen tonsils with small ulcers.
Digestive Issues:
Ignatia can relieve sour eructation, an all-gone feeling in the stomach, flatulence, hiccough, and stomach cramps worsened by slight contact. It also helps those who crave acidic foods and experience sinking sensations in the stomach.
Abdominal Pains:
Symptoms include rumbling in the bowels, a weak feeling in the upper abdomen, and colicky, griping pains in the sides of the abdomen.
Rectal Disorders:
Ignatia is useful for itching and stitching sensations up the rectum, prolapse, painful constriction of the anus after stool, and hemorrhoids with pain and bleeding.
Urinary Issues:
It is indicated for profuse, watery urine.
Respiratory Conditions:
Dry, spasmodic coughs in quick shocks, reflex coughs, and hollow, spasmodic coughs that worsen in the evening are symptoms treated by Ignatia.
Menstrual and Female Reproductive Issues:
The remedy is suitable for menstrual irregularities such as early, profuse, or scanty black menses, feminine sexual frigidity, and menstrual suppression due to grief.
Musculoskeletal Pains:
Symptoms include jerking of limbs, pain in the Achilles tendon and calf, and ulcerative pain in the soles.
Sleep Disturbances:
Ignatia can help with very light sleep, jerking limbs upon falling asleep, insomnia due to grief and cares, and prolonged, troubling dreams.
Fever and Skin Conditions:
The remedy is indicated for chills with thirst that are not relieved by external heat, itching, nettle-rash, and excoriation around sensitive areas like the vagina and mouth.

name: ILEX AQUIFOLIUM
indications:
Intermittent Fever:
Acts as a useful support in the management of intermittent fever.
Particularly beneficial where periodic fever is accompanied by spleen pain or digestive disturbances.
Suitable in fevers with seasonal recurrence, especially those showing marked winter amelioration.
Jaundice and Intestinal Catarrhal:
Supports in jaundice, especially with sluggish liver function and associated digestive complaints.
Aids in mucous diarrhoea, indicating its role in intestinal catarrh or possible psilosis (sprue).
Helpful in conditions involving colic or abdominal discomfort from hepatic or splenic origin.
Eye and Orbital Inflammation:
Particularly useful in rheumatic inflammation of the eyes, especially with associated periostitis of the frontal bone.
Indicated in cases with staphyloma, a condition of abnormal protrusion of uveal tissue in eyeball, corneal degeneration, or chronic eye infiltration.
Beneficial for burning orbital pain at night, even in long-standing, difficult eye cases.
Spleen Affections:
Assists in managing spleen pain, especially where there is a history of fever, or chronic congestion.
Prostate Irritability:
Aids in prostatic irritation, particularly with constant urethral dripping or sensation of irritation in the urinary tract.
Musculoskeletal and Rheumatic Affections:
Also include assistment of rheumatism, pleurisy, and gout.
Suitable for systemic inflammatory complaints, especially when aggravated in warm weather.

name: ILLICIUM ANISATUM
indications:
Respiratory Complaints and Cough:
Illicium anisatum is useful in frequent cough with pain and expectoration of whitish or pus-like mucus.
Indicated in hæmoptysis, especially when blood is mixed with phlegm, and pain is localized in the right chest or region of the third rib.
Aids in dyspnoea, especially in elderly or asthmatic patients.
Feeling of emptiness in the chest after coughing; tough mucus expectoration, especially in chronic alcoholics.
Gastrointestinal Issues and Colic:
Relieves violent wind colic, particularly when it occurs at regular hours and lasts for months.
Helps in splenic pain and rumbling in the abdomen with disturbed bowels.
Beneficial in stomach bloating, acidity, nausea, and gagging, often with an upward extension to the chest.
Notable satiety after eating little, with altered taste perception—most foods taste too salty or bitter, except rye bread, which is craved.
Skin Affections:
Manages pin-like stitches, especially in the left palm and forearm, often followed by burning.
Relieves itching and crawling sensations, especially in the right palm and above the left ear, better by scratching or touch.
Musculoskeletal and Limb Discomfort:
Manages pain in the region of the third rib, both right and left sides, often related to chest congestion or cough.
Cramp-like pulling pain in left dorsal vertebrae, as if caused by cold.
Relieves peculiar sensation of the left thigh feeling broken while sitting, which disappears upon standing.
Jerking, tearing, and pressure sensations in the elbow, palms, and metacarpal areas.
Sensation as if an artery had been injured by a blow in the left arm.
Crawling, stitching, and burning sensations in various parts of the skin, especially hands and forearms.
Apthae and Dryness:
Aids in aphthous conditions of the tongue, especially on the edges, with folding of tongue margins like bags.
Burning and numb sensations in lips, with dryness and tightness of the upper lip.
Indicated in tough, viscid phlegm rising from the stomach, often seen in chronic drinkers.
Assists in palpitation, especially when accompanied by aphthae and general weakness.
Headache and Catarrhal:
Helps in head pain, typically worse in the morning and better by evening.
Indicated in ringing and buzzing in the ears, sometimes followed by sleep.
Itching over and around the left ear, better by touch.
Aids in nasal catarrh with watery discharge, sneezing, and sharp stitches at the tip of the nose.
Disturbed Sleep:
Aids in disturbed and sleepless nights, especially around nightfall.
Fever:
Illicium anisatum is indicated in fever-like sensations starting in the abdomen, spreading to chest and stomach, with symptoms lessening during the day.
General sense of internal heat moving in waves across the torso.

name: INDIGO
indications:
Neurological Conditions and Epilepsy:
Indicated in epileptic seizures, particularly where the aura begins between the shoulder blades.
Useful for flashes of heat from abdomen to head preceding aconvulsion.
Indigo tinctoria addresses reflex spasms, especially from worm infestations.
Indicated in neurasthenia, hysteria, and excessive nervous irritability.
Relieves sensation of the brain being frozen or head feeling bound with a tight band.
Aids children or adults with night crying, gloomy states, or emotional sadness.
Gloomy and Hysterical:
Supports in states of gloom, mental sadness, and crying spells, particularly at night.
Enhances mental clarity in those with excited moods, anxious, and urge to be busy.
Balances hysterical presentations, especially where pain is predominant.
Headache and Vertigo:
Manages vertigo with nausea and an undulating sensation in the head.
Eases pressure in the head as if a tight band encircled the forehead.
Beneficial in cases where the hair on the vertex feels pulled or head feels cold or frozen.
Mucosal Affection:
Controls excessive sneezing and epistaxis (nosebleed).
Relieves roaring and pressure in the ears, commonly associated with nervous sensitivity.
Bloated Abdomen and Rectal Prolapse:
Helps with metallic taste, eructations, and bloating.
Aids in anorexia and heat flushes originating from the stomach and rising to the head.
Indicated in prolapse of the rectum and intense anal itching, especially at night, causing sleep disturbance.
Catarrhal of Bladder:
Indicated in catarrh of the bladder, with turbid urine and frequent urge to urinate.
Musculoskeletal and Limb Affections:
Indigo tinctoria manages sciatic pain, especially from mid-thigh to knee.
Eases boring pain in the knee joint, which improves with walking.
Notable for pain in limbs after meals, suggesting areflex or circulatory component.

name: INDIUM METALLICUM
indications:
Headaches and Migraine:
Indicated in bursting headaches during or following straining at stool.
Indium metallicum relieves dull, distressing pain in the forehead and temples, often accompanied by nausea, weakness, and daytime sleepiness.
Violent sneezing spells, especially when associated with migraine-like symptoms.
Associated with “gone” sensation in the stomach, especially around
11 a.m., indicative of nervous exhaustion.
Sleepy and irritable with headache.
Feels unfocused and mentally tired; cannot fix thoughts on anything.
Sexual Weakness and Early Menses:
Aids in cases of frequent seminal emissions, often leading to general debility.
Indicated in sexual psychopathy, including mental disturbances linked with suppressed libido or overindulgence.
Useful in reduced sexual power, tenderness of testicles, and drawing pain along the spermatic cord.
Itching of glans penis.
Notable for early menses with cross temper and weeping mood.
Throat and Mucosal Complaints:
Useful for enlarged and ulcerated uvula, often seen with thick, sticky mucus accumulating in the posterior pharynx.
Suitable for dryness, throbbing, stinging soreness; painful swallowing better by eating, and drinking cold water.
Swollen tonsils with tickling in throat that induces hawking.
Skin Affections:
Indicated in painful, suppurating pimples on the face.
Cracks and soreness in the corners of the mouth.
Hot and red face during headache.
Small vesicles on mucous membrane of lower lip with colorless transparent fluid.
Extremity and Musculoskeletal Issues:
Helps with stiffness in the neck and shoulders with shooting pains in fingers and leg especially right.
Relieves pain localized to the left arm, possibly neurological or muscular in origin.
Manages restlessness and fatigue in the legs, as well as itching in the toes.
Severe lancinating pains in biceps of left arm, extending into shoulder with paralytic weakness.
Indium metallicum aids in heaviness in leg with sensation as if loaded with tingling.
Painful and Offensive Urine:
Characterized by a horribly offensive urine smell, which develops after urine stands for some time—an important diagnostic cue.
Involuntary relaxation of the anal sphincter during micturition.
Painful urination.

name: INFLUENZINUM
indications:
Epidemic Use:
Influenzinum is commonly used during influenza epidemics as a substitute for other remedies.
Preventative and Therapeutic Approach:
Influenzinum is employed both preventatively and therapeutically.
It is recommended to be taken preventatively by unaffected individuals during afamily's cold outbreak whether they are of the influenza type or not.
For those already experiencing symptoms, it is taken every two hour to mitigate the progression of influenza or similar viral infections.
Helps In treating abdominal colic associated with diarrhea, worse during pain.

name: INGLUVIN
indications:
Vomiting in Children:
Especially useful in cases of cyclic vomiting in infants and young children.
Helps when vomiting appears without clear cause or follows minor dietary indiscretion.
Ingluvin soothes gastric irritation and aids in calming reflex sensitivity of the stomach.
Digestive Disorders during Pregnancy:
Assists in nausea and diarrhea during pregnancy.
Useful when gastrointestinal symptoms are accompanied by weakness or nutritional disturbance.
Respiratory and Catarrhal Conditions:
Aids in managing cough associated with catarrh.
Supports clearer breathing by alleviating underlying mucosal irritation.
Ataxia with Vesical and Anal Symptoms:
Ingluvin is indicated in cases showing unsteady coordination (ataxia) with urinary or anal disturbances.
May be considered in degenerative conditions affecting motor coordination and sphincter control.

name: IODIUM
indications:
Metabolic Disorders
Iodium is beneficial in assisting rapid metabolism, weight loss, and excessive hunger.
Beneficial for individuals who eat well yet continue to lose flesh.
Glandular Disorders
Helps manage enlarged glands, including thyroid (goitre), testicles, and mammary glands.
Supports conditions of glandular atrophy and connective tissue degeneration.
Respiratory Issues
Useful in laryngitis, pneumonia, bronchitis, and croup, especially in scrofulous children. Painful roughness worse when coughing.
Alleviates hoarseness, dry tickling cough, and difficulty breathing, with a marked desire for cool air.
Difficult expansion of chest with blood-streaked sputum.
Digestive Problems
Relieves indigestion, gas, throbbing in the stomach, and abdominal pain.
Useful in alternating diarrhoea and constipation, especially with white frothy, fatty stools.
Fatigue and Weakness
Helps in cases of extreme fatigue, muscle weakness, and shortness of breath, especially on exertion.
Aids recovery in chronic wasting diseases like tuberculosis, adenoids.
Mental Restlessness
Addresses restlessness, anxiety when at rest, and melancholy.
Beneficial in cases with sudden impulses, suicidal thoughts, and aversion to people. Forgetfulness and depression.
Irregular Menses
Useful in irregular menstruation, uterine hemorrhage, ovarian pain, and thick, slimy acrid leucorrhoea.
Supports assistment of mammary gland atrophy and nodular swellings.
Hydrocele
Helps in testicular swelling, loss of sexual function, and hydrocele.
Skin Inflammatory Conditions
Assists in managing dry, hot, and yellowish skin, withered skin, nodosities, and swollen glands.
Useful in inflammatory skin diseases linked to glandular dysfunction.
Tachycardia and Inflammation
Aids in managing tachycardia, palpitations, and myocarditis. Great weakness with faintness.
Reduces arterial stiffness and supports vascular health in cases of high blood pressure.
Bone and Joint Issues
Provides relief in nightly bone pain, joint inflammation, and rheumatism, especially of the upper limbs.
Beneficial in gonorrhoeal rheumatism and white swelling.
Fever and Infections
Helps manage acute infections, influenza, and plague-like conditions.
Reduces fever with restlessness, profuse sweat, and general debility.
Mucosal Inflammation
Beneficial in eye infections, lachrymation, dacryocystitis, and Eustachian deafness.
Fluent hot coryza with hot skin. Nasal obstruction with sneezing.
Iodium assists nasal congestion, loss of smell, and pain in frontal sinuses.
Foul ulcers and excessive salivation.

name: IODOFORMUM
indications:
Tubercular Conditions
Highly beneficial in tubercular meningitis.
Iodoformum assists in managing symptoms of pulmonary tuberculosis, especially in early stages with chest pain and haemoptysis.
Chronic Diarrhoea in Children
Assists subacute and chronic diarrhoea, especially in undernourished or tubercular children.
Relieves greenish, watery, undigested stools accompanied by irritability and distended abdomen. Scaphoid (sunken) abdomen, especially in children.
Useful in cholera infantum and enlarged mesenteric glands.
Head and Neurological Symptoms
Alleviates sharp, neuralgic headaches with a heavy feeling in the head.
Head feels too heavy to lift; itching in the occiput.
Helpful in meningitis with disturbed sleep, sighing, and crying in children.
Marked drowsiness and lethargy.
Eye Disorders
Iodoformum addresses retro-bulbar neuritis, central scotoma, and partial atrophy of the optic disc.
Symptoms include dilated pupils, unequal reaction to light, diplopia, and failing vision.
Respiratory and Chest Conditions
Soreness in apex of right lung, with wheezing and cough, especially at night.
Smothering sensation, as if a weight is on the chest.
Pain in left breast, described as a hand grasping at the base of the heart.
Asthmatic breathing and haemoptysis in suspected or early tuberculosis.
Muscular and Extremity Weakness
Marked weakness of legs and knees, especially when going upstairs.
Unable to stand or walk with eyes closed (positive Romberg sign indicating neuromuscular weakness).

name: IPECACUANHA
indications:
Persistent Nausea and Vomiting:
Characterized by unrelenting nausea and vomiting, which are primary guiding symptoms for the use of Ipecacuanha.
Vomiting can include food, bile, blood, and mucus.
Indigestion:
Especially indicated for symptoms arising after consuming indigestible foods like raisins and cakes.
Susceptibility to Cold and Moisture:
Particularly suitable for feeble individuals, who often catch colds in a relaxing atmosphere, and are sensitive to warm, moist weather.
Spasmodic Conditions:
Addresses spasmodic irritation in the chest and stomach, leading to conditions like dyspnea, asthma, and spasmodic jerking of the arms.
Hemorrhages:
Effective for bright-red and profuse bleeding, including uterine hemorrhage and hemoptysis (coughing up blood) from slight exertion.
Irritability:
Patients may exhibit irritability, holding everything in contempt, and experiencing desires for unspecified things.
Headaches and Skull Pain:
Sensation of the bones of the skull feeling crushed or bruised, with pain extending to the teeth and root of the tongue.
Eye Issues:
Symptoms include red, inflamed eyes, profuse tearing, changing vision states, and nausea induced by looking at moving objects.
Orbital neuralgia:
Presence of blue rings around the eyes and periodic orbital neuralgia with tearing, sensitivity to light, and smarting eyelids.
Coryza:
Useful in coryza (inflammation of the mucous membranes in the nose), nasal blockage, and nosebleeds, often accompanied by nausea.
Nausea and Vomiting:
Clean tongue with a moist mouth, constant nausea, and vomiting.
The stomach may feel relaxed as if it’s hanging down, and hiccoughs can occur.
Colic and Dysentery:
Amebic dysentery with tenesmus (straining to pass stools), severe pain around the navel causing nausea, and minimal thirst. Pain can be cutting and clutching.
Stools may appear pitch-like green, like frothy molasses, and associated with griping pain at the navel.
Uterine troubles:
Includes profuse uterine bleeding, nausea during pregnancy, and menstrual cycles that are too early and too heavy. Pain can radiate from the navel to the uterus.
Respiratory Problems:
Dyspnea, constant chest constriction, yearly asthma attacks, persistent sneezing, wheezing cough, and suffocative cough where the child may become stiff and blue.
Symptoms may also include bubbling rales, whooping cough, nasal bleeding, and hoarseness.
Fever:
Aids in intermittent fevers with irregular patterns, often following the use of quinine.
Symptoms include slight chills with significant heat, nausea, vomiting, and dyspnea, along with relapses due to improper diet.
Sleep Issues:
Patients may sleep with their eyes half-open and experience shocks in all limbs when falling asleep.
Spasm:
Body may stretch stiffly, followed by spasmodic jerking of the arms towards each other.
Rashes:
Skin appears pale and lax, with blue discoloration around the eyes and the presence of a miliary rash (a type of rash with small, raised lesions)

name: IRIDIUM METALLICUM
indications:
Anæmia:
Beneficial in managing weakness and fatigue related to anaemia.
Chronic Bronchitis:
Iridium metallicum provides relief in chronic respiratory issues.
Abscess in Axilla:
Arrests suppuration and supports healing of underarm abscesses.
Gout:
Helps in managing symptoms associated with gouty pain and inflammation.
Neuralgia:
Alleviates nerve pain, particularly in the head, limbs, and face.
Rheumatism:
Useful in relieving rheumatic pain and tension in joints and muscles.
Spinal Paresis and Hemiplegia:
Aids in cases of partial paralysis and right-sided hemiplegia with normal skin temperature.
Mental Fatigue and Weariness:
Reduces weariness in back and limbs, improves mental focus and self-confidence, and facilitates mental labour.
Head Pain:
Relieves neuralgia of the head, especially in the temples and occipital region, aggravated by open air and noise.
Eye and Ear Sensations:
Eases upward pulling sensations in the eyes and short-lasting numbness in the ears and body.
Facial Pain:
Assists stinging and pressure in malar bones with associated warmth spreading over the face.
Salivation and Mouth Symptoms:
Associated with increased saliva and sensations in malar regions.
Stomach Cramps:
Helps in managing gastric cramping and discomfort.
Female Reproductive Health:
Supports in conditions like uterine ulcers, bluish patches on the uterus, ovarian swelling, and breast pain.
Lower Limb Weakness and Pain:
Relieves formication, smarting hip pains, sciatica, and pressure sensations in thighs and knees.
Upper Limb Complaints:
Iridium metallicum addresses deep red swelling in the thumb, wrist and finger pain, and axillary abscess.

name: IRIS TENAX
indications:
Headache and Scalp Burning:
Iris tenax helps in managing headaches returning weekly, starting in the right eye and extending to the right side of the head.
Aids in relieving symptoms associated with vomiting of green bile, nausea, and chills between 2 and 3 p.m.
Supports relief from dull aching in both temples, especially on waking early in the morning.
Helps with itching and burning of the scalp; pain improves by using the cool side of the pillow.
Vomiting and Gastrointestinal Disturbances:
Aids in relieving vomiting of green or greenish-yellow bile, especially in the morning upon standing.
Helps with the “gone” feeling in the stomach pit accompanied by nausea.
Manages cutting abdominal pain, especially in the right side and ileo-cæcal region.
Supports digestion by helping with abdominal pressure and facilitating evacuation following pain.
Mental Sadness and Emotional Distress:
Manages feelings of gloominess, homesickness, and irrational sadness.
Helps in reducing emotional distress like crying from imagined grief or loss.
Aids in balancing mood swings—despondency alternating with periods of unusual cheerfulness.
Fever:
Supports management of fever with chills starting at 2 p.m., rising temperature (up to 102°F), and sweating as it subsides.
Helps in fever states associated with gastrointestinal or emotional symptoms.
Burning of Mouth and Throat:
Helps in relieving burning sensation in the mouth and throat, described as being “on fire.”
Manages dryness of mouth and need for constant swallowing.
Aids in soothing symptoms with sweet oil, camphor, or sucking cold air.
Eye Irritation:
Helps in reducing itching and smarting of the eyes, especially when linked with temporal headaches.
Manages burning sensation in the eyes, like exposure to horseradish, without tearing.
Toothache:
Supports relief from pain in the upper left second molar, especially during night and morning hours.
Helps in managing persistent pain unrelieved by temperature changes.
Sleep Disturbance:
Aids in managing insomnia caused by emotional distress or physical discomfort.
Helps with disturbed sleep, temple pain, and eye itching; relief obtained by turning the pillow to the cooler side.
Constipation:
Helps in relieving constipation and promoting bowel activity after digestive discomfort.
Urinary Changes:
Manages temporary urinary disturbances such as passing brownish urine at frequent intervals.
Weakness and Fatigue:
Iris tenax supports recovery from morning exhaustion, even after reduction in pain.

name: IRIS VERSICOLOR
indications:
Stomach Burning and Bilious Vomiting:
Highly beneficial in burning sensations throughout the entire alimentary canal.
Used in sour, bloody, or bilious vomiting, often preceded by intense nausea.
Helpful in loss of appetite and indigestion linked with overactive salivary and biliary systems.
Abdominal Pain and Diarrhea:
Supports in soreness of the liver, flatulent colic, and painful cutting sensations in the abdomen.
Indicated in watery diarrhea with burning at the anus and throughout the bowels.
Relieves green, offensive, and periodic nighttime stools.
Also used for constipation due to liver dysfunction, often in the 30C potency.
Thyroid Issue and Profuse Salivation:
Helps with scalded sensation in the mouth and tongue.
Reduces burning, heat, and smarting in the throat.
Supports relief in profuse, ropy salivation, especially in conditions with nausea or bilious vomiting.
Supportive in goitre and thyroid dysfunctions, especially with digestive correlations.
Frontal Sick Headache:
Indicated in frontal headaches accompanied by nausea and vomiting, particularly in bilious subjects.
Sick headache starts with visual disturbances (blurred vision) and worsens at rest.
Especially affects the right temple and forehead, with a constricting sensation on the scalp.
Beneficial in headaches from mental overexertion, often following intense periods of concentration.
Facial Neuralgia:
Beneficial in facial neuralgia beginning in the infra-orbital region, especially after meals, and radiating across the face.
Aids in easing spasmodic or neuralgic facial pains linked to digestive upset.
Rheumatic and Sciatic Pains:
Helpful in shifting joint and limb pains, especially where discomfort seems to “move” between locations.
Useful in sciatica, particularly affecting the left hip, with pain extending to the back of the knee.
Indicated in gonorrheal rheumatism.
Eczema and Psoriasis:
Iris versicolor assists herpes zoster associated with underlying gastric disturbances.
Beneficial for pustular eruptions and chronic eczema, especially with nightly itching.
Recommended in cases of psoriasis, where patches are irregular and shiny-scaled.
Ringing and Aural Vertigo:
Assists in roaring, buzzing, and ringing in the ears, frequently coupled with temporary deafness.
Relieves aural vertigo marked by disturbing internal noises and a sense of imbalance.

name: JABORANDI
indications:
Alopecia (Hair Loss)
Jaborandi is known to help in cases of hair loss. It stimulates the hair follicles and can promote hair growth, making it beneficial for conditions like alopecia.
Scalp Irritation:
For individuals with a persistently dry scalp, Jaborandi's general glandular stimulation can help in reducing scalp irritation, increasing the natural oils and moisture on the scalp, thus improving overall scalp health.
Strengthening Hair Follicles:
By improving blood circulation to the scalp, Jaborandi helps in strengthening hair follicles, which can result in healthier hair.
Excessive Sweating (Diaphoresis)
Jaborandi is a potent remedy for conditions involving profuse sweating, such as night sweats commonly seen in consumptive (tuberculous) patients. Often unilateral, with palpitation,
Excessive Salivation:
Useful in abundant flow of saliva.
Pupil Constriction (Miosis)
Effective in conditions where the pupils are abnormally constricted.
Hot Flashes:
Sudden intense episodes of heat, often accompanied by sweating.
Nausea and Vomiting:
Nausea, especially when triggered by looking at moving objects, along with vomiting.
Bronchial Irritation:
Useful in inflammation of the bronchial mucous membrane, leading to coughing and breathing difficulties.
Lung Edema:
Fluid accumulation in the lungs, resulting in foamy sputum and defective breathing.
Slow, sighing Respiration:
Irregular Pulse:
Pulse may be irregular and dicrotic (having two beats per cardiac cycle).
Chest Tightness:
Feeling of heaviness or tightness in the chest.
Cyanosis:
Useful in blue discoloration of the skin due to poor oxygenation.
Nervous Cardiac Issues:
Cardiac symptoms that are influenced by nervous system disturbances.
Eye Strain and Fatigue:
Useful for relieving eye strain and fatigue, especially from prolonged use.
Ciliary Muscle Irritability:
Discomfort due to irritation of the muscles controlling the lens of the eye.
Visual Disturbances:
Includes hazy vision, indistinct vision, and retention of retinal images after using the eyes.
Blurred Vision:
Vision disturbed, often blurry, cloudy for distant objects.
Fluid Buildup in Ears:
Effective in serous exudation into the tympanic cavities.
Tinnitus:
Ringing or buzzing in the ears.
Painless Diarrhea:
Frequent, painless bowel movements, often with facial flushing and profuse sweating.
Reduced Urine Output:
Scanty urination, often accompanied by pain over the pubic area and a frequent urge to urinate.
Dry Skin:
Persistent dryness of the skin.
Useful in dry eczema.

name: JACARANDA CAROBA
indications:
Male Sexual Health & Venereal Complaints:
Indicated in balanorrhœa, phimosis, and suppuration between glans and prepuce.
Helps in itching, burning, and pricking sensations in the prepuce; the urethral orifice appears red, swollen, and inflamed, resembling “two lips.”
Discharge of yellowish-white liquid from under the foreskin, associated with pain and discomfort.
Painful erections, often caused by swelling of the foreskin, with intense sensitivity.
Chancrous ulcers, red pimples that ulcerate and leave red marks.
Provides relief in syphilitic infections and associated genital itching, soreness, and eruptions.
Acute pain in the testicles (especially left) during walking and swelling of the scrotum.
Chordee (curved penis) and gonorrheal inflammation, including secondary complications like gonorrheal rheumatism.
Rheumatism & Muscular Pain:
Useful in muscular rheumatism, especially in the neck, loins, arms, and knees.
Stiffness and soreness of the nape, making it difficult to turn the head.
Pain radiating from the left elbow to the forearm, with red, scaling spots on the wrist.
Alleviates rheumatic pain in knees:
(notably the right), better from movement.
Headache and Coryza:
Dull, shifting headache, often located between the temples or moving from forehead to the nape.
Sensation of pressure in the temples and forehead, like a plug pressing inward.
Flapping or wing-like sensations in the ears, with stoppage, heat, and pain radiating toward the nostrils.
Sneezing, fluent coryza, and heaviness of the head, especially in the vertex and eyes.
Constipation & Anal Itching:
Constipation with itching and lancinations at the anus, sometimes accompanied by small excrescences or ulcers.
Pain and stitches around the umbilicus, and tender swelling in the right groin.
Helpful in itching around the anus, especially while sitting.
Chest Pain & Weak Pulse:
Assists in dull or sharp chest pain, especially under the sternum while breathing or lifting the head.
Palpitations with a sense of the heart beating in the stomach area.
Lancinating pain at the heart, extending toward the right chest, with slow, weak pulse.
Ulceration & Fever:
Useful in chronic leg ulcers, syphilitic skin lesions, and red spots with scaling.
Indicated in restless sleep, accompanied by frightening dreams and uneasiness.
Addresses internal chills, followed by dry, prickling heat across the body, as in febrile or post-infectious states.

name: JALAPA
indications:
Digestive & Bowel Complaints:
Indicated in profuse, watery, sour-smelling diarrhea, often bloody or excessive, especially in infants.
Colicky pain before and during stool, felt intensely in the small intestines, with a sensation as if the abdomen would be cut to pieces.
Jalapa helps in flatulence and borborygmus, with frothy, offensive eructations that relieve abdominal pain.
Useful in pain and soreness of the anus, along with pain in the sigmoid flexure and right hypochondrium.
Diarrhea associated with general coldness and a bluish tint to the face.
Infantile Conditions:
Extremely beneficial in infantile diarrhea, particularly when the child is quiet during the day but screams and tosses about all night due to severe abdominal pain.
Addresses restlessness, uneasiness, and tossing of limbs, with an irritable and sensitive disposition.
Restlessness and Prostration:
Suited for conditions with mental restlessness, anxiety, and general weakness.
Fainting fits, sudden prostration, and physical fatigue after or during intestinal disorders.
Headache and Dryness:
Helps in violent headaches with a smarting sensation in the skin of the forehead.
Dryness of lips and biting or stinging pain on the tongue and in the throat.
Irritable Bladder:
Assists in pain and pressure in the bladder region.
Thrilling sensations in the urethra while urinating; may be linked to irritative or reflex states of the urinary tract.
Backache and Gout:
Useful for pain around the left scapula and aching in arms and legs, especially on the right side.
Addresses pain in thighs, burning soles of the feet, and pulsating pain in the big toe, suggestive of gouty or inflammatory conditions.
Helps with uneasiness in limbs and involuntary tossing during fever or abdominal complaints.
Coldness and Fever:
Associated with febrile episodes, cold sensations, and excessive perspiration of the head and upper body.
Jalapa alleviates general coldness and blueness of the face, especially during infantile or enteric complaints.

name: JANOSIA ASHOKA
indications:
Amenorrhea:
JANOSIA ASHOKA is indicated for the absence of menstruation. It helps to restore and regulate menstrual cycles.
Metrorrhagia:
Useful for managing abnormal uterine bleeding, ensuring control over excessive or irregular bleeding.
Delayed and Irregular Menses:
Assists in regulating menstrual periods that are delayed or inconsistent.
Menstrual Colic:
Aids in alleviating painful menstrual cramps.
Ovarian Pain Before Menstruation:
Addresses pain in the ovaries experienced before the onset of menstrual flow.
Menorrhagia:
Helps in reducing heavy menstrual bleeding.
Leucorrhea:
Useful for treating vaginal discharge.
Irritable Bladder:
Addresses symptoms of bladder irritation, which can be associated with heavy bleeding.
Unilateral Headache:
Suitable for one-sided headaches, particularly those related to uterine issues or congestion. These headaches are often relieved by open air or the onset of menstrual flow.
Eye Pain and Supraorbital Pain:
It helps with pain in the eyeballs and pain above the eyes, as well as sensitivity to light (photophobia).
Nasal Catarrh:
Indicated for profuse, watery nasal discharge and loss of sense of smell.
Excessive Thirst and Nausea:
Manages intense thirst and severe nausea.
Chronic Constipation:
For relieving persistent constipation.
Hemorrhoids:
Helps in painful, swollen veins in the rectum and anus.
Disturbed Sleep:
Assists in improving sleep quality, addressing issues like disturbed sleep or vivid dreams of traveling.
Spinal Pain:
Addresses pain that starts in the spine and radiates to the abdomen and thighs, providing relief from such discomfort.
No description available.

name: JATROPHA CURCAS
indications:
Diarrhea and Cholera-like Symptoms:
Aids in sudden, explosive, and gushing watery diarrhea, often resembling rice water.
Diarrhea accompanied by cramping pains, chills, cold sweat, and general collapse.
Stools expelled with force and noise, with rumbling and gurgling in the abdomen.
Simultaneous vomiting and diarrhea, especially of green or watery substances.
Helpful in early stages of cholera or cholerine before full collapse occurs.
Diarrhea from cold; vomiting not relieved by fluids.
Burning and Abdominal Colic:
Supports in burning and sinking sensations in the stomach with persistent nausea.
Vomiting of water, bile, or food with great ease and force.
Abdominal colic with lancinating and rolling sensations, as if balls were tumbling inside.
Swelling and tenderness in the abdomen, with sensitivity to touch.
Useful in painful thrusting from the umbilicus to the lumbar region.
Anxiety and Mental Dullness:
Manages great anxiety and uneasiness, especially at night, with chest constriction.
Indicated in mental dullness, ecstasy during purging, and sense of weightlessness.
General indifference to pain with profound physical exhaustion.
Useful in collapse states, where there is a feeling of weariness, faintness, or loss of strength.
Skin Eruptions:
Helpful in itching eruptions, pimples, and prickly heat especially between toes and fingers.
Itching around mouth and face; skin becomes hot and irritated.
Recurrent skin complaints linked to digestive or nervous triggers.
Cough and Chest Symptoms:
Assists in managing short, hacking, and persistent hollow cough, especially disturbing sleep.
Constriction in the chest with anxiety and difficult, panting respiration.
Pain and pressure in the chest and clavicle, along with stitching sensations behind the sternum.
Stiffness & Cramps:
Supports in violent cramps in calves, legs, and feet,.
Cramping, knotting, and stiffness of muscles in upper and lower limbs.
Helpful in bruised soreness of back and chest muscles, especially after illness.
Indicated in stiffness of the neck and lumbar region.
Polyuria and Morning Sickness:
Frequent urging to urinate; urine pale yellow and frothy.
Aching and drawing in male genitals, often extending to the thighs.
Vomiting of pregnancy, especially early morning nausea.
General Weakness and Collapse:
Jatropha curcas helps in collapse-like states with cold body, clammy sweat, and weak pulse.
General prostration from slight exertion, especially during illness.
Cold hands and feet with heat in head and throat during fever.
Marked drowsiness or insomnia due to anxiety and internal restlessness.

name: JUGLANS CINEREA
indications:
Skin and Eruptive Disorders:
Aids in managing
skin eruptions such as eczema, pustules, and erythema.
Supports
assist ment of erysipelatous redness and scarlatina-like flush.

itching and pricking sensations, especially when overheated.

Juglans cinerea
s upports management of liver dysfunction with pain in the hepatic region and under the right scapula.
Aids in relieving
jaundice, particularly with yellow-green stools and associated pruritus.
Helps with
atonic dyspepsia marked by eructation and flatulent abdominal distension.
Manages
soreness in the region of the liver and digestive sluggishness linked to bile stasis.

cholelithiasis:
(gallstones) with suffocative feelings and hepatic discomfort.
Headache and Scalp Eruptions:
Helps with
dull, full sensations in the head and sharp pains in the occiput.
Aids in managing
headaches associated with liver dysfunction.
Supports relief from
pustular eruptions on the scalp, lids, and around the eyes.

head enlargement and tension in the occipital area.

Juglans regia
s upports relief from burning and pressure in the anus after alarge stool.

early waking and inability to return to sleep, often due to mental restlessness

pulling sensations in the cervical spine as though drawing the head to one side.

relief from tension in the dorsal vertebrae, often as if the back would bend backwards.

name: JUNIPERUS COMMUNIS
indications:

Addresses prostatic discharge and urinary complaints in the elderly with poor digestion.
Dysmenorrhoea:
Dysmenorrhea, especially where juniper tea has been employed for symptomatic relief.
Helps relieve uterine congestion-related pelvic discomfort.
Flatulent Colic:

Juniperus communis helps in respiratory irritation with urinary retention or suppression.

indications:
Convulsions & Nervous Disorders:
Juniperus virginiana
supports in violent, tetanic-like convulsions with total unconsciousness and rigid spasms.
Eyes begin to jerk and glare, followed by head twitching and body convulsions.
Useful when patients display terror, staring eyes, and imploring gestures during fits.
After convulsions, a coma-like state with stertorous breathing and slow pulse may develop.
Twitching of voluntary muscles with signs of neurological exhaustion and stupor.
Mental Confusion & Coma:
Helpful in fever-induced delirium with incoherent raving and piteous moaning.
Marked mental dullness, stupor, or total insensibility following toxic episodes.
Assists in post-coma recovery where patient awakens with no memory of prior events.
Indicated in states of shock, fright, or emotional overwhelm linked to seizures or poisoning.
Headache and Facial Spasm:
Sensation of the head being tightly bound, as if by an iron band.
Face appears swollen, livid, and venous, with bluish discoloration and distended veins.

Helps in patchy denudation of throat mucosa, often painful or raw.
