Heavy, full sensation in head; worsens when upright.
Pressure in vertex and occiput; pain over eyes.
Prickling in limbs with dull head sensation.
Head sensitive to touch; symptoms improve after sleep.
Feeling as if pulled backward from occiput.
7. Gastrointestinal Trouble:
Sharp, colicky abdominal pain relieved after passing stool or flatus.
Jelly-like or mushy stools; urgent desire with incomplete relief.
Crawling sensation in rectum, as if from worms.
Stool alternating between hard and loose, often unsatisfactory.
Soreness in rectum; frequent gas; tenderness in epigastrium.
8. Respiratory Difficulty:
Dry cough from slightest exertion.
Difficulty breathing due to abdominal pressure or during chill.
Oppression of lungs at night; mucus in larynx hard to expel.
9. Skin Sensitivity:
Crawling, tingling, or cold sensation under the skin.
Skin hypersensitive; flesh feels bruised or sore, especially after chills..
10. Restless Sleep & Dreams:
Restless sleep with frequent waking.
Dreams of bugs, water, or sexual content.
Wakes with sadness, fatigue, or heaviness.
Muscle twitching just as sleep begins.
11. Fever & Chills:
Oxytropis campestris helps in chills begin between shoulder blades, spread downward.
No thirst during chills or heat.
Accompanied by abdominal muscle contractions and body pains.
Breathing becomes difficult as chill subsides.
Recurrent chills every seventh day; persistent spinal coldness

name: OXYURUS VERMICULARIS
indications:
Rectal Irritation & Itching:
Markedly helpful in persistent itching and crawling sensation in anus.
Children constantly scratch and rub the anal region, worse at night.
Helps in irritation with soreness, redness, and excoriation around anus.
Nervous Restlessness:
Children become irritable, peevish, and difficult to manage.
Sleeplessness with tossing and grinding of teeth during sleep.
Nervous agitation and crossness associated with worm irritation.
Digestive Disturbance:
Loss of appetite or variable hunger with abdominal distension.
Oxyurus vermicularis assists in colicky pains in abdomen with rumbling and uneasiness.
Alternate diarrhoea and constipation from intestinal irritation.
Disordered Sleep:
Frequent waking at night with crying or restlessness.
Child picks at nose and grinds teeth while asleep.
Dreams of fright, uneasiness, and disturbed sleep pattern.
General Weakness:
Pale face, dark circles around eyes, and emaciation in wormy children.
Offensive breath and salivation sometimes present.
Oxyurus vermicularis helps in irritability of bladder, occasional enuresis from reflex worm irritation.

name: OZONE
indications:
Nasal and Respiratory Complaints:
Aids in persistent, violent coughs with associated sneezing and rawness in the throat and air passages.
Helps with hoarseness, aphonia, and dry, tearing coughs that are worse at night, especially between 2 to 5 a.m.
Treats suffocating chest sensations, tightness under the sternum, and tickling in the trachea.
Addresses lumpy, whitish sputum or yellow purulent expectoration following respiratory irritation.
Relieves nasal blockage from tough, whitish-yellow mucus requiring frequent picking.
Headache and Sensory Symptoms:
Indicated in dull frontal headaches, especially over the left eye or right eyebrow.
Useful for cold sensations in the left temple and scalp sweating.
Assists with tingling of the facial skin and itching of conjunctivae. Sharp, stabbing, and sudden-onset pain localized in the right eyeball, slightly medial to the pupil.
Mouth and Throat Disorders:
Useful in treating canker sores in the cheeks and mucosa.
Ozone eases rawness in the throat, especially in the fauces and glottis.
Beneficial in burning dryness of the upper larynx with no associated thirst.
Digestive & Abdominal Discomfort:
Treats great flatulence with a sensation of accumulation in the rectum, often creating urgency and fear of passing stool inadvertently.
Helpful in bloating and disturbed abdominal function.
Sexual & Urinary System:
Useful for fine, stinging rashes on the scrotum that appear and disappear quickly.
Musculoskeletal and Back Pain:
Alleviates intense pain in the sacral region, with fatigue extending into the pelvic area and perineum.
Relieves heaviness in thighs and legs, especially after overexertion.
Skin Conditions:
Assists in treating itching of fingers, especially left index finger, with or without visible eruptions.
Beneficial for pimples and blister-like eruptions near the anus that become sore after rubbing.
Used in cases of facial tingling and recurring skin irritations.
Fever and General Fatigue:
Helps manage sweating on the scalp, especially with headache between the eyes.
Ozone addresses low-grade fevers, generalized fatigue, and post-viral weakness.

name: PAEONIA OFFICINALIS
indications:
Anorectal & Perineal Disorders:
Indicated in painful hemorrhoids, fissures, and ulcerations in and around the anus, especially with burning, biting, and moist discharges.
Useful in rectal fissures, ulcers, and rhagades, causing extreme discomfort during and after stool.
Helps in fetid, oozing ulcers around the anus and perineum, often funnel-shaped or deep and sensitive.
Useful in diarrhea with faintness, burning in the anus, and post-defecation internal chilliness.
Ulcerative Skin and Mucosal Conditions:
Treats bed-sores and chronic ulcers with profuse, offensive secretions, especially on the sacrum, breast, coccyx, legs, and perineum.
Helpful in serpiginous leg ulcers, toe ulcers, and painful sores caused by trauma or pressure.
Indicated in sensitive ulcers of lower body, that resist healing and cause persistent pain.
Bristling sensation on arm with feeling of sticking in the fingers, in the sides.
Head and Nervous System:
Aids in rush of blood to the head, heaviness, dullness, vertigo, and headaches focused in the forehead or temples, often with roaring in ears, and flickering in eyes. Postprandial headache characterized by a pressive sensation localized to the left side of the head.
Manages delirium, irritability, evening apprehension, and mental depression after 5 p.m. Marked anxiety with social withdrawal; heightened emotional sensitivity, particularly to distressing news
Helpful in nightmares, anxious dreams, and restless, unrefreshing sleep with emissions or oppression.
Eye and Facial Disorders:
Supports in conjunctivitis- red watery eyes, photophobia, burning, dry eyes, and inflammation with tearing and smarting.
Treats tearing eye pain, dry lids, and pain behind the eyes.
Addresses facial redness, puffiness, and heat, often with tingling or crawling sensations.
Digestive & Abdominal Disturbances:
Treats colicky pains, pinching, borborygmi, and cutting sensations in the abdomen, especially across the upper portion.
Eases epigastric burning, anxiety after eating, and vomiting with painful diarrhea.
Beneficial for symptoms worsened by warm rooms or emotional shock
(e.g., unpleasant news).
Urinary and Female Genital Complaints:
Helps with burning urination, frequent micturition at night, and dribbling urine due to bladder constriction.
Reduces painful swelling of female genitals.
Chest & Cardiovascular Symptoms:
Relieves sticking, cutting, and throbbing pains in the chest, especially the left side and sternum, often radiating or aggravated by movement and respiration.
Useful for dull cardiac pains, palpitations, and heat in the chest.
Indicated in ulceration of the left breast due to unresolved abscesses.
Back, Limbs & Musculoskeletal Discomfort:
Eases ulcers over the sacrum, pinching pains, and sticking in the cervical spine.
Helps with fatigue, tearing pains, cramps, and sensation of deadness devoid of blood in fingers and toes.
Relieves cramps in knees, weary pain in ankles when sitting, and tension in tendons and muscles, making walking difficult.
Skin and Itching Conditions:
Addresses itching, prickling, stinging sensations especially on chest, head, limbs, and axillae.
Relieves crawling sensations, nettlerash-like itching, and ulcers emitting foul-smelling moisture.
Sleep and Dreams:
Indicated in restless sleep, daytime drowsiness, night terrors, and disturbing amorous or frightful dreams.
Dreams often involve death, ghosts, quarrels, or oppressive chest pressure during sleep.
Fever and General Weakness:
Treats cold limbs, hot flushed face, skin heat, and sweat with blood rush to head.
Beneficial in weakness while walking, sensation of being unwell in damp weather and burning sensation extending from the fauces through the pharynx to the esophagus, aggravated by hawking; associated with dysphagia.

name: PALLADIUM
indications:
Female Reproductive System & Pelvis:
Palladium metallicum aids in chronic oophoritis, especially when the parenchyma is still partially functional.
Treats uterine prolapse and retroversion, often secondary to long-standing right ovarian disease.
Helps in subacute pelvic peritonitis, with prominent right-sided pelvic pain and backache.
Manages pain and swelling in the right ovary, accompanied by bearing-down sensations.
Supports relief from glairy leucorrhoea, and menstrual discharge even while nursing.
Relieves cutting uterine pain, especially when it is ameliorated by stool.
Aids in soreness and shooting pains from the navel to the breast, indicating broad pelvic involvement.
Treats stabbing or burning pain in the pelvis, improved by gentle rubbing.
Alleviates stitches near the right breast nipple, often accompanying ovarian complaints.
Mental and Emotional Health:
Supports emotional balance in individuals with a strong need for approval and exaggerated pride.
Aids in mood swings, with a tendency to weep easily and become offended or irritable quickly.
Treats exhaustion and pain aggravation after socializing, despite appearing cheerful in company.
Helps control impulsive or violent speech, particularly in those who are sensitive to criticism.
Abdominal Complaints:
Palladium metallicum relieves flatulent distension and soreness in the abdomen, particularly in the right groin.
Manages shooting pain from the navel to the pelvis, and sensations as if the intestines were strangulated or bitten off.
Supports reduction of abdominal swelling and pressure symptoms due to pelvic pathology.
Dull rectal pain at noon, as if from retained stool, without any urge to defecate.
Headache and Facial Neuralgia:
Treats pain across the top of the head, moving from ear to ear, aggravated by social activity or entertainment.
Helps in temporo-parietal neuralgia, especially when pain radiates to the shoulder.
Manages the peculiar sensation of the head being “swung backward and forward.”
Supports skin tone in those with a sallow complexion, especially when linked to hormonal imbalance or mental fatigue.
Extremities, Spine & Joints Weakness:
Aids in fatigue and weakness in the small of the back and limbs, particularly in patients averse to physical exertion.
Relieves fleeting neuralgic pains in arms and legs, as well as darting pains from toes to hips.
Treats rheumatic pain in the right hip and right shoulder, with an affinity for right-sided sciatica.
Palladium metallicum manages pruritus and skin sensitivity in the extremities.
Coughing & Dryness of Throat:
Aids in burning in nose with evening coryza; painful pustules on and near the nose, one bleeding after pressure.
Dry throat and tongue without thirst; sensation of a lump or crumb in throat; difficulty swallowing as if something is hanging near the hyoid bone.
Treats frequent hawking of tough mucus or solid lumps, which must be swallowed; slimy taste that returns after rinsing.
Palladium metallicum helps in coughing or sneezing triggers abdominal pain; deep breath causes chest stitches; expectoration feels like pressure into the head.
Chilliness & Itching:
Chilliness with cold hands and feet, accompanied by colic; limbs feel cold with back pain.
Redness and presence of warts on knuckles.
Itching and crawling sensation, like flea bites, on back, arms, abdomen, thighs, and ankles.
Frequent Micturition:
Frequent urge to urinate with a feeling of bladder fullness, but scanty output.
Dark urine with red or brick-dust sediment and painful weakness of bladder.

name: PANCREATINUM
indications:
Pancreatic & Metabolic Disorders:
Supports the function of the pancreas in cases of chronic pancreatitis, pancreatic insufficiency, or glandular degeneration.
Indicated in pancreatic diabetes, where symptoms are linked to insufficient insulin or enzymatic output.
Helps regulate gouty diathesis, where uric acid metabolism is disturbed and pancreatic weakness is suspected.
Digestive Disorders & Diarrhea:
Aids in conditions with faulty digestion due to enzyme deficiency, particularly in breaking down fats, proteins, and carbohydrates.
Useful in diarrhea caused by malabsorption, often seen with pancreatic impairment.
Glandular Infections & Inflammation:
Indicated in mumps, particularly where the parotid and salivary glands are involved, reflecting its salivary component.
Pancreatinum can assist in treating from glandular swellings and post-viral glandular fatigue.

name: PARAFFINUM
indications:
Constipation & Rectal Complaints:
Paraffinum aids in treating obstinate constipation, especially in children, where there is continual urging to stool without result.
Supports chronic constipation with accompanying hemorrhoids and an unrelieved sensation of bowel fullness.
Manages frequent but in useful desire for stool, and helps in rectal discomfort linked to abdominal pressure.
Relieves pain in the lower abdomen extending to genitals, rectum, and coccyx, which improves when sitting.
Stinging, cutting rectal pain and strong urge to pass stool lasting over an hour after abowel movement with great tenesmus.
Female Reproductive System:
Treats late, black, and profuse menses, often accompanied by pelvic and abdominal discomfort.
Helps in stabbing pain in the mons veneris and burning pain in the vulva, especially with very hot urine.
Supports relief from milky leucorrhoea, indicating underlying uterine or vaginal congestion.
Manages painful, sore nipples, sensitive even to gentle touch.
Stomach and Gastrointestinal Tract:
Aids in alternating pain between the stomach, throat, and spine, often described as twisting or knife-like.
Relieves constant hunger, constant feeling of satiety.
Paraffinum supports digestion in cases with pain across the stomach, which may extend to the chest with belching.
Helps in fixed, twisting pain in the left hypochondrium, frequently associated with palpitations.
Heavy, stone-like feeling in the stomach in the morning, evening, and after eating.
Nervous System & Painful Conditions:
Treats shifting, alternating neuralgic pain — especially the characteristic sensation of knife-like pain traveling between different areas of the body.
Supports in electric shock-like sensations in joints, and wrenching pain in muscles such as calves, extending to the toes.
Manages pain in the spine radiating to the loins and inguinal region, aggravated by climbing stairs.
Head, Face & Dental:
Aids in left-sided head and facial pain, often stinging and twisting in character.
Relieves sharp pain on the vertex, described as a nail driven into the left side of the head.
Treats twisting pain in the left ear and tearing toothache radiating down to the jaw.
Manages excessive, sticky saliva with a bitter taste.
Eyes & Vision:
Supports dim vision, often with black specks before the eyes.
Helps in red, inflamed eyelids, and the peculiar sensation of fat covering the eyes, causing blurriness.
Extremities & Joint Pains:
Treats tearing pain in ankles and soles, with accompanying swelling of the feet.
Relieves trembling and weakness in the lower limbs, extending from the knees to the toes, leading to impaired gait and difficulty lifting the feet
Supports in right arm heaviness with impaired mobility and numbness, accompanied by a constrictive sensation, as if the clothing were too tight.
Helps in drawing and stinging between the shoulders with oppression of breathing.
Skin – Burns & Frostbite:
Paraffinum is highly useful in third-degree burns, particularly those complicated by sloughing and sepsis.
Supports recovery from burns when used externally — wash with sterile water, spray with paraffin, and cover with sterile cotton.
Treats frostbite, offering soothing and protective action for damaged skin.

name: PARATHYROIDINUM
indications:

Convulsions and spasms in children related to calcium imbalance.

name: PARATYPHOIDINUM B
indications:

Aids in both acute and chronic ulcerative states, particularly of the digestive system.

Used in pre-cancerous conditions, particularly those involving ulceration, inflammation, or tissue hardening.
May assist in cancer-related inflammation or as a complementary medicine during degenerative processes.

Helpful in cases of varicose veins with distension, engorgement, and a plethoric state.
Paratyphoidinum B
assists where there is a marked tendency toward capillary inflammation or venous stasis.

name: PAREIRA BRAVA
indications:
Urinary Disorders & Kidney Pain:
Pareira brava manages in renal colic with excruciating pain radiating from the left kidney to the groin along the ureter.

Treats dropsical swelling in the feet and legs associated with urinary obstruction and renal weakness.
Pareira brava eases neuralgic pain in the anterior crural region and pain extending from bladder to lower limbs during urination attempts.
Respiratory Symptoms:
Aids in bronchial congestion marked by viscous matter obstructing airways especially the bronchi.

indications:

Throbbing, bubbling headache upon waking at night, accompanied by intense agitation.

Confused sight and wavering before eyes.

Manages painless, periodical hoarseness and cough resembling sulphur vapor irritation.
Extremities & Neuralgic Pain:
Supports relief from weariness and heaviness in the nape and shoulders.
Helps manage neuralgia starting in the left intercostal area, radiating to the left arm.
Aids in stiffness of the arm, with fingers becoming clenched.
Treats numbness in upper limbs and fingers, and neuralgia of the coccyx with pulsating and sticking pain, especially when sitting.
Everything feels rough or numb to the touch, reflecting sensory hypersensitivity or dullness.
Mental & Emotional Symptoms:
Paris quadrifolia aids in mental overactivity and garrulousness, with a tendency to talking endlessly in a foolish or inconsequential manner, often without any clear point or purpose or be overly lively.
Treats imaginary perceptions, such as foul smells and feelings of the body being too large or distorted.
Useful in sensory misinterpretation and disturbed body image perception.
Mouth & Tongue:
Treats dryness of the tongue on waking, with white coating, often without thirst.

Abdominal Discomfort:
Treats in quick return of hunger after meals; weak digestion with hiccough and heavy, burning sensation from stomach to abdomen, relieved by belching.

Frequent, scanty, or loose stools with foul odor resembling putrid flesh.
Skin Eruptions:
Paris quadrifolia helps in papular and vesicular eruptions, especially on the face, lips, and around the mouth; cracked lips and herpes near the mouth.
Violent itching, crawling sensations, and subcutaneous tingling without visible rash; skin feels raw and painful to touch.
Treats pimples on forehead with tenderness; panaritium (inflammation around nails).

name: PAROTIDINUM
indications:
Prophylaxis and Acute Mumps:

Indicated in glandular swellings, particularly of the parotid glands.
Parotidinum helps
in salivation and parotitis, especially with viral or infective origin.
Neurological and Gonadal Complications:
Helpful in meningitis or cerebral inflammation as a complication of mumps.
Indicated in orchitis
(inflammation of the testicles), particularly when arising after or during mumps.

name: PASSIFLORA INCARNATA
indications:
Spasms and Convulsions:

Neuralgia and Insomnia:
It provides relief for conditions like delirium tremens, neuralgia, and insomnia. Its calming effect helps in stabilizing the nervous system and reducing symptoms of overexcitement and nervous tension.
Headaches:
Characterized by intense pain as if the top of the head might come off. The sensation of the eyes being pushed out suggests asignificant pressure or strain in the head region.
Flatulence and Belching:
A feeling of heaviness or deadness in the stomach after or between meals, along with flatulence and sour belching. These symptoms indicate digestive disturbances that are often accompanied by discomfort and digestive upset.
Restless Sleep:
Passiflora is helpful for managing restlessness and wakefulness, particularly in individuals who are mentally exhausted, elderly, or very young.
Insomnia that results from exhaustion and stress, including nocturnal coughs.
Asthma:
Aids in asthma, with a recommendation of frequent dosing for initial relief.
Acute Mania and Diarrhea:
It is also indicated for acute conditions such as mania and painful diarrhea.
Hysteria and Childbirth-Related Convulsions:
Effective for managing hysteria and convulsions that occur during or after childbirth, showing its use in both psychological and physiological disturbances related to these states.

name: PENICILLINUM
indications:
Menopausal & Hormonal Imbalance:
Indicated in the climacteric period with associated depression, emotional dullness with depression, and mental sluggishness with difficulty in thinking & comprehension.

helps in cases where menses are late but profuse, often accompanied by leucorrhea and fatigue.

Useful in cough that forces the person to bend double due to its intensity or abdominal strain.

Urogenital Symptoms:
Treats bland, yellow leucorrhea, typically seen during hormonal changes or after suppressed infections.
Indicated in gonorrheal discharge from the urethra, especially when recurring or lingering.
Skin Conditions:
Beneficial in eczema of the eyelids, especially if linked to suppressed infections or antibiotic use.

is also indicated in myxedema and related endocrine or skin swelling disorders.

name: PENTHORUM SEDOIDES
indications:
Nasal and Post-Nasal Conditions:
Aids in thick, pus-like discharge from the nose, sometimes streaked with blood and foul-smelling.
Wet feeling in the nares and trachea, as if a violent cold or coryza were about to set in.
Nose feels stuffed, full, and congested, with itching in the nares.
Helps in rawness in the posterior nares, as though epithelium were denuded.
Headache and Catarrhal:
Penthorum sedoides is indicated in dull, heavy headache with catarrhal aching in the forehead.
Sensation of weight in the sinciput; vertigo when closing the eyes.
Beneficial in mental dullness, discouragement, despondency and inability to concentrate or study.
Digestive Trouble:
Treats clawing sensations around the umbilicus, often progressing to the lower bowels.
Borborygmus, abdominal twitching, and thickened abdominal walls.
Manages constipation from atonic bowels, followed by semi-fluid stools.
Burning and itching in the rectum and anus, with crawling sensations like a worm trying to escape.
Helps in hemorrhoids associated with aching in the sacrum and sacro-iliac joints.
Burning Urethra & Varicocele:
Supports in relieving burning along the urethra during urination; urine increased and alkaline.
Dull kidney pain; bladder sore to touch.
Treats sexual erethism approaching satyriasis, followed by prolonged mental and physical depression.
Indicated in varicocele with accompanying sacral discomfort.
Voluptuous dreams and increased urinary and sexual excitation during sleep.
Dry Cough:
Treats dry, deep cough in the morning, as though one would “ cough the insides out.”
Wet feeling in the chest, bronchi, and trachea, descending from above.
Constriction and soreness in the chest following catarrhal sensations.
Aching in Back and Extremities:
Penthorum sedoides manages heat and aching in the sacrum, often accompanying headaches.
Numbness of arms, trembling in legs, and spontaneous muscular jerks.
Aids in sudden leg movements resembling astepping motion, alternating between legs.
Soreness of knees and general limb weakness.
Skin Eruptions & Disturbed Sleep:
Useful in reappearance of previously treated impetiginous eczema.
Helps in itching and hot prickings in the skin, particularly on the face and forehead.
Fantastic and voluptuous dreams, often linked to heightened urinary activity.
General Weakness and Fever:
Penthorum sedoides helps in profound malaise, inability to attend to duties, and weakness of limbs.
Cold chills rising up the spine in rapid succession.

name: PEPSINUM
indications:
Digestive Issues:
Aids in dyspepsia characterized by heartburn, waterbrash, and delayed gastric emptying.
Treats symptoms of gastric atony, such as sluggish stomach function and food stagnation.
Helps manage gastric irritability, vomiting of undigested food or loose stools due to indigestion of food.
May assist in the regulation of stomach acidity, reducing symptoms associated with both hypoacidity and functional hyperacidity.
Pepsinum is beneficial in supporting individuals with imperfect indigestion with pain in gastric region.
Supports cases of cancer of the stomach (Ca stomach) where digestion is severely impaired and gastric secretions are deficient.
Aids in diseases of the pancreas, especially where enzymatic insufficiency leads to malabsorption and wasting.
Marasmus:
Indicated in marasmus of children who are fed on artificial food, especially when associated with digestive weakness and wasting, where food is poorly assimilated despite adequate intake.
Gout:
Helpful in managing gout with associated digestive weakness, where protein metabolism is impaired.

name: PERSICARIA ACRIS
indications:
Burning & Strangury:
Helps in painful, frequent urging to urinate with burning sensation.
Strangury with difficult passage of urine, sometimes mixed with blood.
Smarting and excoriating pains along urinary passages.
Mucous Membrane Irritation:
Irritates mucous outlets with burning, redness, and soreness.
Helpful in cases of haematuria and catarrhal bladder irritation.
Burning in rectum and anus after stool, with excoriation.
Redness of Skin & Eruptions:
Produces erysipelatous inflammation with redness and burning.
Helps in itching, smarting eruptions, and excoriated skin surfaces.
Helpful in conditions of rawness, heat, and painful sensitivity of skin.
Haemorrhagic Tendency:
Persicaria acris assists in tendencies of haemorrhage from mucous surfaces.
Bright red bleeding with soreness and burning pains.
Helpful in bleeding from urinary or rectal tract.
General Weakness and Restlessness:
Marked burning, smarting, and excoriation throughout the system.
Pains often associated with restlessness and aggravation after urination or stool.
General weakness and irritability from urinary or mucous irritation.

name: PERTUSSINUM
indications:
Whooping Cough (Pertussis)
Pertussinum is highly useful in classical whooping cough marked by paroxysmal coughing, retching, and dyspnea.
Indicated when cough ends in vomiting or sobbing.
May be used during community outbreaks or when exposed to infected individuals.
Helps manage symptoms in all stages of the illness—from onset to convalescence.
Spasmodic and Paroxysmal Cough:
Manages repeated bouts of violent, choking cough, worse at night or upon waking.
Strangling or suffocative sensation associated with cough.
Pertussinum helps in deep, croupy, spasmodic cough with flushing of the face.
Tickling in the throat-fauces or trachea that provokes persistent coughing fits.
Associated coryza:
(runny nose) and itching of the palate at bedtime.
Respiratory Distress and Chest Symptoms:
Aids in dyspnea (difficulty breathing) associated with prolonged coughing.
Sobbing or sighing at the end of a coughing episode.
Stinging chest pains with or after coughing.

name: PESTINUM
indications:
Plague and Epidemic Infections:
Pestinum acts as a homoeo pathic prophylactic during outbreaks of bubonic or pneumonic plague.
Helpful in early stages of infection marked by sudden high fever, chills, and glandular swellings.
May be used as a supportive medicine alongside other therapeutics in confirmed plague cases.
Bubo and Glandular Inflammation:
Indicated in painful, inflamed lymph nodes:
(buboes), especially in the groin, neck, and axilla.
Supports treatment of suppurative lymphadenitis.
Typhus and Septic States:
Useful in typhoid-like fevers with delirium, restlessness, and toxic systemic collapse.
May help in managing symptoms of intense fever, mental dullness, and physical prostration.
Can assist in detoxifying the system and promoting recovery in post-septic or post-infectious fatigue.
Immune and Systemic Support:
Pestinum may stimulate the immune response in cases where vitality is extremely low.

name: PETROLEUM
indications:
Skin Issues:
Petroleum aids in healing dry, cracked, and leathery skin, especially during cold weather.
Treats fissures, rhagades, and eczema with bleeding, burning, and intense itching.
Manages chilblains that are moist, itchy, and burning.
Helps in bed-sores, intertrigo, and psoriasis with thick, greenish crusts.
Supports skin repair when the slightest scratch leads to suppuration.
Aids in cases of herpes, eczema recurrence, and moist, itching eruptions, especially around nipples and perineum.
Useful in night-time itching and dry, irritable skin aggravated by cold exposure.
Gastrointestinal Troubles:
Supports relief from gastric acidity, hot, sour eructations, and heartburn.
Aids in managing gastric distension and a persistent feeling of emptiness.
Treats ravenous hunger, especially at night; requires constant eating to ease gastralgia.
Helps with nausea and accumulation of saliva, along with strong aversion to fatty foods and diarrhea from cabbage.
Petroleum manages daytime-only diarrhea, which is watery, gushing, and accompanied by anal itching.
Supports digestion in individuals with chronic gastralgia and indigestion after vexation or fright.
Emotional Sensitivity:
It helps in addressing emotional hypersensitivity, irritability, and being easily offended.
Supports emotional regulation after fright, vexation, or mental emotions.
Aids in confusion, forgetfulness, and the feeling of being lost or not oneself.
Treats anxiety about death with urgency to settle personal matters.
Manages low mood, dullness, and discouragement often seen with digestive or skin symptoms.
Mucous Membranes (Nose, Ears, Eyes)
Treats dry catarrh, with deafness & noises, chronic Eustachian catarrh, and mucous membrane irritation.
Aids in relieving nasal ulceration, cracks, and burning with ozæna and foul discharges.
Manages eczema of the ears and fissures in the meatus with soreness and intense itching.
Helps in addressing dim vision, cannot read fine print without glasses, loss of eyelashes, and marginal blepharitis.
Supports the healing of lachrymal sac infections and scurfy, dry skin around the eyes.
Ringing and cracking in ears.
Cough & Chest Oppression:
Treats dry, harsh coughs that come deep from the chest, especially at night and in cold air.
Supports relief in laryngeal conditions such as croup and diphtheritic inflammation.
Helps in easing chest oppression, hoarseness, and respiratory discomfort during winter.
Head and Scalp Irritation:
Manages headaches that compel one to hold the head still, especially while coughing.
Aids in treating occipital heaviness, vertigo on rising, and sea-sickness-like sensations.
Petroleum supports the scalp in moist eruptions, soreness to touch, and subsequent numbness.
Helps relieve the sensation of a cold breeze blowing on the head.
Urethral Discomfort & Leucorrhoea:
Treats itching in the urethra, prostatic swelling, and herpetic eruptions on the perineum.
Aids in managing albuminous, profuse leucorrhea, genital soreness, and moist discharges in women.
Supports relief in itchy nipples with a mealy appearance and premenstrual headaches.
Heart and Circulation:
Helps in fainting spells, heat flushes, and palpitations, often with a sensation of internal coldness.
Back and Extremities Stiffness:
Treats stiffness and pain in the neck, coccyx tenderness, and lumbar weakness.
Aids in recovery from chronic sprains, joint cracking, and stiffness of the knees.
Supports skin healing in rough, cracked fingertips that worsen in winter.
Manages burning, scalding sensations in the knees and fetid axillary sweat.
Fever and Chills:
Aids in managing alternating chills and sweats, especially during the night.
Petroleum helps in reducing flushes of heat, particularly on the face and head.
Supports those who experience night sweats, particularly on the feet and underarms.

name: PETROSELINUM SATIVUM
indications:
Urinary Disorders:
Aids in sudden and urgent desire to urinate, especially in children.
Pain during urination so intense it causes children to jump, cry, or dance in place.
Frequent, almost fruitless urge to urinate every half-hour.
Burning and tingling sensations running through the urethra during and after urination.
Creeping, crawling, tingling, and pressure felt throughout the urethra and region of Cowper's glands.
Crawling stitch and tickling in the navicular fossa, leading to frequent urination.
Discharges from the urethra: milky, albuminous, or yellow, often indicating gonorrhea or gleet.
Agglutination of the urethral orifice with mucus.
Male Sexual Health:
Petroselinum treats priapism:
(persistent, painful erections) without penile curvature.
Involuntary emissions, especially profuse toward morning.
Voluptuous tickling and itching sensations in the navicular fossa.
Gastrointestinal Issues:
Twitching and jerking pains in the epigastrium, often with flatulent eructations, nausea, colic, and vomiting.
Hungry and thirsty but loses desire to eat or drink upon starting.
Chronic diarrhea with whitish, clay-like stools.
Burning sensations in the anus.
Neurological and Sensory Disturbances:
Shrill, ringing sensation in the ears, described as a bell ringing out of time, affecting the entire organism.
Jerking or bubbling sensations in the muscles of the back and arms.
Nightblindness:
Night-blindness with swelling and discomfort in the eyes.
Skin Rashes:
Urticaria (itchy, red, raised skin rash).
Sleep and Dreams:
Sleep onset delayed with frequent anxious dreams.
Fever and Periodic Illness:
Petroselinum sativum is useful in intermittent fevers, especially quotidian ague with regular stages.
Suited for fevers linked with flatulent dyspepsia, or complicated by abdominal and urinary tract inflammations.
Also beneficial in fevers resulting from trauma, urethral stricture, or chronic infections.

name: PHASEOLUS NANUS
indications:
Cardiac Disorders:
Supports heart function in late-stage heart disease and cardiac failure.
Useful in cases of weak, irregular pulse and palpitations with a fear of death.
Helps restore pulse in cases of puerperal convulsions, dropsy of the pericardium, and albuminuria.
Beneficial for heart rhythm irregularities (e.g., skipped beats) and extreme cardiac exhaustion.
Can assist in cases with hard, isolated heart thumps occurring at regular intervals.
Neurological and Mental Health:
Indicated in mental dullness, where the person only responds when spoken to loudly.
Useful in cases with a sense of impending death, especially accompanying heart symptoms.
Helps relieve shock, fear, or unconsciousness due to cardiac insufficiency.
Headache and Neurological Pain:
Headache focused in the forehead and orbits, aggravated by movement and mental effort.
Pressing headache as if something is pushing hard against the temples.
Pain in right side of forehead, especially while writing.
In sensitive individuals, intense headache may trigger severe reactions.
Eye and Orbit Issues:
Pain in the right orbit or around the eyeball, worsened by movement or touch.
Sensation like a blow to the eyeball, especially the right.
Smarting, itching in the inner corners of the eyes.
Pupils may appear dilated and unresponsive in severe states.
Abdominal and Inguinal Pain:
Severe, dull pain in the epigastric region, especially when touched.
Symptoms mimicking hernia in the right inguinal ring, lasting through the day.
General discomfort in the abdomen, with possible shrinkage or drawing up of legs in children due to pain.
Urinary Disorders:
Bloody urine, possibly indicative of inflammation or trauma.
May support management of diabetes and uric acid gravel in the urinary tract.
Male Sexual Health:
Indicated for complete impotence in men.
May help reduce symptoms of prostate enlargement.
Respiratory Concerns:
Slow, sighing respiration especially in states of collapse.
May be supportive in cases of hydrothorax:
(fluid accumulation in the chest cavity).
Musculoskeletal Discomfort:
Bruised feeling in the rib cartilage and right humerus:
(upper arm bone).
Painful, movable swelling appearing near the right nipple.
General Weakness and Collapse:
Skin may be bedewed with cold perspiration.
Extremely low pulse, slow breathing, and near-collapse states.
Helpful in restoring function in shock or collapse, especially when accompanied by cardiac distress.

name: PHELLANDRIUM AQUATICUM
indications:
Emotional Imbalance:
Addresses sadness, profound anxiety, and deeply meditative tendencies.

Aids in calming overexcited or withdrawn mental states, especially with emotional detachment.
Headache & Scalp Sensations:
Treats vertigo with a sensation of falling backward or sideways, especially upon turning.
Relieves head heaviness, as though drawn backward by weight at the nape.
Aids in crushing vertex pain with burning in the eyes and lachrymation.
Supports conditions with occipital pressure, scalp itching, and post-meal head coldness.
Useful in headaches that resolve in open air or while eating.
Respiratory & Chest Afflictions:
Manages hoarseness, suffocative cough, and mucus accumulation in the throat.

Aids in chest stitching pains extending into scapula and sacrum, especially post-meal.
Relieves chest oppression on deep inspiration and side-sensitive breathing issues.

Supports cases of early, scanty, or interrupted menses with bruised limb pain.

Helps manage pains in the breast between nursing intervals.

Relieves tearing, stitching pains from the neck down into scapula or sacrum.
Helps manage bruised loins and hot iron-like burning in neck areas.
Aids in t earing pain in shoulders and arms with congested knees and calves.

Treats twitching, burning, and swelling of eyelids with sleepiness.
Aids in managing ciliary neuralgia aggravated by reading or sewing.
Relieves cloudy vision, photophobia, and morning/evening eye dryness.
Helps reduce tearing and orbital margin pain.
Manages ear tearing, boring pain, and ringing—especially in the right ear.

Supports in treating burning nostrils with swollen upper lip.
Manages loss of smell and vesicular eruptions inside the nostrils.
Treats obstructive coryza and nasal breathing difficulty.
Aids in facial tension, livid evening redness, and cheek muscle spasms.

Relieves toothache with tearing or shooting pain.
Treats red, painful gums and burning vesicles on the tongue.
Aids in managing frothy salivation, clammy taste, and dryness of the throat at night.
Helps with sore throat pain that worsens with empty swallowing but eases with food.

Manages nausea, offensive eructations with bug-like odor, and vomiting sensations.
Treats burning stomach pain and a sensation of fullness or twisting in the epigastrium.

Helps relieve stomach pain as if it were empty and rumbling with gas accumulation.

Supports relief from pinching and cutting abdominal pains.

Helps manage incarcerated flatus, flank stitching, and rumbling lower bowel sensations.

Aids in hard stools with straining and clawing at the anus.

Helps relieve anal itching that worsens after scratching.
Supports the expulsion of abundant flatus during and after the stool.

Treats pale, greenish, or scanty urine output with burning during urination.

Supports relief from urinary retention following febrile conditions.
Male Sexual Health:
Helps relieve itching on the prepuce that improves after scratching.

Aids in chest and circulatory symptoms that worsen at rest and improve with movement.

Relieves burning, smarting, and itching skin that responds to scratching.
Aids in limb tearing pain and vascular discomfort while at rest.
Sleepiness & Fever:
Manages excessive daytime drowsiness, dream disturbances, and delayed sleep onset.
Aids in fever marked by shivering, cold water-like sensations, and trembling.
Helps relieve retarded sleep with frightful dreams and agitation.

name: PHENOLPHTHALEINUM
indications:
Constipation & Intestinal Torpor:
Helpful in chronic constipation with sluggish bowel action.
Aid in reliving intestinal inactivity where purgatives have been habitually used.
Colic and griping pains accompany the sluggish stool.
Colic & Abdominal Symptoms:
Helps in abdominal pain, flatulence, and rumbling with uneasy digestion.
Nausea and occasional vomiting after doses or proving.
Sensation of heaviness in abdomen with pressing pains.
Skin & Allergic Reactions:
Aids in pruritus and erythematous eruptions in sensitive patients.
Itching, burning, and rashes associated with its use as a drug.

Liver & Blood Effects:
Congestion and functional disturbance of liver.
Phenolphthaleinum supports in portal circulation with tendency to haemorrhagic conditions.
May help in weakness and altered blood chemistry in provings.
Weakness and Lassitude:
Weakness, lassitude, and discomfort after purgation.
Nervous irritability and disturbed sleep in some cases.
Headache and vertigo linked with gastric or bowel disturbance.

name: PHOSPHORUS
indications:
Destructive Metabolism:
Conditions involving progressive damage to tissues and organs, including yellow atrophy of the liver and sub-acute hepatitis.
Depressive States:
Persistent feelings of low spirits, sadness, and irritability.
Individuals may feel overwhelmed and exhibit atendency towards restlessness.
Oversensitivity:
Over-sensitivity to external stimuli such as light, sound, and odors. This may result in excessive startled responses and heightened emotional states.
Poor memory:
Forgetfulness and brain fatigue.
Vertigo:
Dizziness or spinning sensations, particularly when standing up from a seated position.
Headache:
Burning pain, neuralgia, and chronic congestion of the head. Symptoms may improve with warmth.
Visual Disturbances:
Issues such as cataracts, misty vision, black spots, and halos around lights.
May involve atrophy of the optic nerve and other degenerative changes.
Hearing Impairment:
Difficulty hearing, especially voices, and sensations of sounds echoing.
Chronic Nasal Discharge:
Chronic catarrh, frequent nosebleeds, and sensitivity to smells, often accompanied by foul imaginary odors.
Facial Pain and Swelling:
Pale complexion, blue rings under the eyes, and necrosis of the lower jaw.
Gum and Tooth Issues:
Problems such as swollen, bleeding gums, and toothache.
Persistent dryness and soreness in the mouth.
Stomach pain:
Frequent hunger soon after eating, sour taste, and vomiting of food.
Pain in the stomach relieved by cold foods.
Abdominal pain:
Cold sensations, sharp pains, and liver congestion with jaundice.
Stool Problems:
Very fetid stools, difficult expulsion, and diarrhea with blood.
Presence of hemorrhoids.
Hematuria:
Presence of blood in the urine, particularly in acute conditions like Bright's disease.
Diminished sexual power:
Issues such as lack of sexual power and involuntary emissions with irresistible desire.
Irregular periods:
Irregular menstruation, leucorrhea, and conditions like metritis, phlebitis, and various uterine issues.
Cough and Chest Pain:
Persistent cough, hoarseness, and tightness across the chest.
Symptoms may worsen with cold air or lying on the left side.
Heart Palpitations:
Violent palpitations, especially when lying on the left side, with a rapid and soft pulse.
Dilated heart.
Back Pain:
Includes burning pain and weakness between the shoulder blades.
Extremity Issues:
Paralysis, weakness, and numbness in the limbs and tibia.
Sleep Disturbances:
Great drowsiness, vivid dreams, and frequent awakenings.
Fever Symptoms:
Chilly sensations in the evening, lack of thirst, and profuse night sweats.
Skin disorders:
Excessive bleeding from wounds, jaundice, and various skin conditions like petechiae and purpura.

name: PHOSPHORUS RUBRUM
indications:
Haemorrhagic Tendency:
Predisposition to bleeding from nose, gums, lungs, or stomach.
Bright red, profuse, and easily started haemorrhages.
Helpful in bleeding diathesis with great weakness after loss of blood.
Nervous Irritability:
Restlessness, trembling, and oversensitivity to external impressions.
Neuralgic pains with burning or stitching character.
Assists in sleeplessness and anxiety with nervous exhaustion.
Respiratory Irritation:
Dry, tickling cough with rawness in chest.
Burning sensation in air passages and chest oppression.
Spitting of bright red blood with irritation of bronchi or lungs.
Digestive & Gastric Symptoms:
Nausea, vomiting, and burning in stomach.
Sensation of emptiness or sinking at the epigastrium.
Phosphorus rubrum helps in irritation of mucous membranes leading to gastric uneasiness.
General Weakness:
Fatigue, trembling, and prostration after slight exertion.
Weakness from blood loss or nervous depletion.
Bone pains and slow recovery from illness.

name: PHYSALIS ALKEKENGI
indications:
Urinary Disorders:
Marked diuretic action with polyuria (abundant urination).
Useful in gravel, kidney stones (lithiasis), and foul, acrid urine.
Physalis alkekengi aids in nocturnal enuresis and sudden urge incontinence, especially in women.
Neurological and Muscular Conditions:
Relieves languor, muscular weakness, and tonic cramps.

Helps in conditions where every step or jar causes reverberation in the head.
Head and Mental Symptoms:
Vertigo, mental haziness, and weakened memory.
Throbbing pain in the forehead, heaviness over the eyes.
Constant desire to talk and emotional restlessness.
Respiratory Complaints:
Hoarse voice, irritated throat, and stabbing pains in the chest.
Chest oppression leading to insomnia.
Helpful in managing dryness of mouth and cough.
Fever and General Symptoms:
Feverish feelings especially in the evening; chilliness in open air.
Sweating during stool with creeping sensations.
Liver pain associated with fever episodes.
Skin Conditions:
Excoriation between fingers and toes.
Pustular eruptions on the thighs and nodes on the forehead.
Physalis alkekengi is beneficial in managing inflammatory or pustular skin disorders.

name: PHYSOSTIGMA VENENOSUM

Mental Exhaustion:
Difficulty in concentrating, forgetfulness, and a general lack of motivation.
Irritability and nervousness, often feeling overwhelmed and unable to handle stress.
Mood Fluctuations:
Feeling upbeat in the morning but becoming increasingly gloomy by noon.
A sense of being mentally overwhelmed by clutter and persistent negative thoughts.
Vertigo and Dizziness:
Characterized by a sensation of spinning or faintness, particularly when moving, reading, or changing positions.
Accompanied by nausea, dim vision, and unsteadiness.
Headaches:
Dull, heavy, or oppressive pain.
Headaches can be severe and are often localized to the forehead, temples, or around the eyes, with symptoms exacerbated by motion.
Eye Irritation:

Ear Pain and Discomfort:
Sharp, shooting pains and a sensation of fullness in the ears.

Nasal Discharge:
Runny nose, sneezing, and a burning sensation in the nostrils.
There may also be a sensation of tension in the nose and forehead.
Facial Pain and Sensations:
Neuralgic pain on one side of the face, with feelings of cramps or spasms extending to the neck.
The face may appear pale or flushed.
Sore Throat:
Painful swallowing, a raw feeling, and dark red tonsils.
The throat may feel constricted with possible small ulcers and an enlarged uvula.
Stomachache, Nausea and Vomiting:
Burning sensations in the stomach, nausea, vomiting, and various types of abdominal pain, such as colicky or lancinating pains.
There may also be a sensation of heaviness or nervousness in the stomach area.
Indigestion:
Watery and yellowish to dark and offensive stool.
Symptoms may include constipation, tenesmus, and hemorrhoids.
Urination urgency:
Frequent and copious urination, with urine varying from yellow and strong-smelling to muddy or pale.
Frequent erections in male:
Frequent erections with minimal desire and strong-smelling sweat around the genitals.
Menstrual Irregularities:
Symptoms include irregular menstruation, leucorrhea that worsens with exercise, and discomfort similar to postpartum conditions.
Cough:
Cough from throat tickling, labored breathing, and frequent yawning.
Chest Pain:
Heavy feeling and stitches in the chest, with discomfort often relieved by pressure.
Palpitations:
Irregular heartbeats, palpitations, and a sensation of pulsation throughout the body.
Neck Pain:
Stiffness, pain at the base of the brain, and cramp-like sensations.
Back Pain:
General weakness, pain, and stiffness in the back, with sensations of coldness and creeping numbness.
Fatigue:
Feeling of fatigue, numbness, or stiffness in the limbs, with cold extremities.
Disturbed sleep:
Irresistible need to sleep, restless nights with vivid dreams, and frequent awakenings due to persistent thoughts.
Fever:
Fluctuating temperatures, with sensations of coldness, heat in the face and back, and profuse sweating.

Thick, yellowish, tenacious mucus difficult to expel; pseudo-membranous exudation.

Pain radiating from nipple throughout the body when nursing.

Shooting pain from perineum to penis.

Fistula lachrymalis and abundant hot lachrymation.
Coryza with mucus from one nostril and postnasal drip.

Tongue red at tip, scalded sensation, mapped and indented with yellow stripe.
Excessive stringy saliva, mouth bleeds, blistered tongue sides.
Abdominal & Digestive Complaints:
Soreness in right hypochondrium, colic at the navel, bruised epigastrium.
Helps in constipation in the elderly and those with weak hearts.
Phytolacca manages rectal bleeding, burning and gripping abdominal pain.
Urinary System:
Treats scanty, painful urination with suppressed flow.
Nephritis with kidney region pain.
Respiratory Issues:
Especially in hoarseness, aphonia, dry, tickling, hacking cough (worse at night).
Aching in mid-sternum; difficult breathing.
Useful in chest oppression with rheumatic intercostal pain.

Sensation as if heart leaps into throat.

Manages stiff back on rising; pain radiating up and down the spine.

Patient fears rising due to leg pain.

High fever alternating with chills and extreme prostration.

Helps in dry, pale, shrunken skin, itchy papular and pustular eruptions.

Heart strain, pain on exertion or in cold.
ECG may show coronary insufficiency without infarction.
Phlebitis and poor peripheral circulation.
Gastrointestinal Distress
Acidity, heartburn, sourness, flatulence, and hunger pain not relieved by eating.
Vomiting after meals. Dilated stomach.
Constipation and sensation of a “ball” in the intestines.
Pain in the right and left iliac fossae.
Intestinal worms (oxyuris).
Mouth ulcers, cracked corners, salty taste, tender gums.
Burning Urethra & Profuse Leucorrhoea
Intense burning in the urethra and ache in kidney region.
Offensive, profuse, brown, thick, or scalding leucorrhoea.
Vaginitis, vaginal boils, and severe vulval itching (pruritus vulvae).
Bilious episodes and vomiting around menstrual periods.
Skin Irritation
Severe pruritus—particularly in body folds like perineum and axillae.
Boils (e.g., in axillae), chronic dermatitis with discharge (especially hands).
Chin and upper lip eruptions: papulo-pustular, dry, scaly, crusted, with 6-month duration.
Cough With Chest Tightness
Cough with sputum; worsened by cold air and physical effort.
Chest tightness, pain, and shortness of breath.
Paniculitis (inflammatory nodules under the skin/fat).
Musculoskeletal Pain
Backache, fibrositis of head and neck, slipped disc.
Intermittent claudication, calf and leg pain, sciatica.
Bruised appearance of legs, Raynaud’s disease, hammer toes.
Cramping, numbness, and freezing feet—worse in cold. Burning hands at night.
Dim Vision
Occasional dimness of vision.
Meibomian cyst formation in eyelids.
ENT (Ear, Nose, Throat) Trouble
Fluent coryza with indoor aggravation.
Relaxed throat, making speech difficult.
Sensation of flatulence stuck in the throat.

name: PRUNUS SPINOSA
indications:
Headache & Neuralgia:
Treats pressing-asunder pain beneath the skull with intense head heaviness.
Relieves sharp shooting from the right frontal bone through to the occiput.
Supports neuralgic conditions affecting the head, especially with bursting or lightning-like sensations.
Eases ciliary neuralgia with piercing pain in the right eyeball.
Eye & Vision:
Useful in ciliary neuralgia with violent eye pain radiating through the brain.
Prunus spinosa eases bursting pain in one or both eyes—right eye pain radiates to occiput; left eye pain relieved by tear flow.
Helps in managing irido-choroiditis and opacity of the vitreous humor.
Soothes sensation as if the eyeball would burst.
Teeth & Mouth:
Treats neuralgic toothache, with sensation as if the teeth were forcibly extracted.
Pain worsens on taking anything warm, indicating heat sensitivity.
Abdomen & Bladder:
Eases cramp-like pain in the region of the bladder, especially aggravated by walking.
Helpful in managing ascites and general abdominal fluid retention.
Rectum & Stool:
Treats difficult, knotty, hard, nodular stools and rectal pain, as if a sharp object were being pressed inward.
Prunus spinosa soothes burning in the anus following slimy, irritant diarrhea.
Urinary Tract Issues:
Addresses tenesmus of the bladder with frequent, ineffectual urges to urinate.
Relieves neuralgic dysuria with pain and difficulty initiating urination.
Useful when there is a peculiar sensation of urine reaching the glans but then receding, causing urethral pain.
Patient must wait or strain along time before urine is passed.
Respiratory & Cardiac:
Relieves wheezing and chest oppression, especially noticeable while walking.
Eases anxious, short respiration during episodes of cardiovascular strain.
Used in angina pectoris with furious heart pounding triggered even by slight motion.
Skin & Extremities:
Useful in herpes zoster with burning, sensitive skin eruptions.
Prunus spinosa treats anasarca and morning lassitude after unrefreshing sleep.
Soothes itching on the fingertips, often described as if they were frostbitten.

name: PRUNUS VIRGINIANA
indications:
Heart & Circulation:
Treats weak, irregular, or deficient heart impulse—particularly in the right side of the heart.
Supports heart health in conditions like hypertrophy, mitral stenosis, or following chronic bronchitis.
Soothes irritability of the heart and cough with scanty expectoration.
Especially indicated when heart symptoms are accompanied by cough or breathing trouble.
Cough & Respiratory Complaints:
Prunus virginiana is useful for persistent coughs that begin in cold weather and worsen at night or on lying down.
Addresses spasmodic and asthmatic coughs with wheezing or whistling in the trachea and bronchi.
Useful in post-influenza coughs that linger long after the acute stage.
Relieves soreness under the sternum and dry, irritating coughs that resist other treatments.
Digestive Troubles:
Manages slow digestion with acidity and loss of appetite.
Supports recovery from dyspepsia, anorexia, and pyrosis (burning in the esophagus or stomach).
Especially useful in elderly individuals with weak or sluggish digestion.
Heaviness & General Sensation:
Prunus virginiana addresses dull, heavy sensation in the head—similar to other medicines in the Prunus group—often linked to digestive or circulatory sluggishness.

name: PSORALEA CORYLIFOLIA
indications:
Skin Eruptions and Pigmentation:
Psoralea corylifolia is known for its efficacy in treating various skin conditions, especially those involving dark pigmentation and spots. It helps in reducing skin blemishes and can be beneficial for conditions like vitiligo, where there are white patches on the skin.
Psoriasis and Eczema:
This remedy is particularly effective for psoriasis and eczema with dry, scaly patches. The skin may be itchy and inflamed, and Psoralea corylifolia helps in reducing scaling and redness. It also assists in healing ulcers, cracked and fissured skin.
Antibacterial Properties:
Prevents or inhibits the growth of harmful bacteria.
Helps in wound healing and reduces infection risks.
Antioxidant:
Reduces oxidative stress, which can contribute to aging and disease.
Help protect against chronic diseases like cancer and tumors.
Leucorrhea:
Effective in treating leucorrhea, a condition characterized by excessive vaginal discharge. Psoralea corylifolia helps in reducing the itching around genitals and alleviating associated discomfort.
Immune System Support:
Psoralea corylifolia has immune-boosting properties that can help strengthen the body’s defense mechanisms and improve overall resistance to infections.
No description available.
Psoralea corylifolia:

name: PSORINUM
indications:
Chronic Skin Conditions
Psorinum is useful for eczema, acne rosacea, herpetic eruptions, and indolent ulcers.
Relieves intolerable itching, especially worse from warmth in bed.
Manages oily skin due to overactive sebaceous glands.
Respiratory Complaints
Useful in chronic asthma, especially when symptoms worsen while sitting up and improve when lying down.
Assists recurring coughs, especially in winter or after suppressed skin eruptions.
Aids in hay-fever with irregular seasonal recurrence.
Debility and Lack of Vitality
Addresses extreme weakness and lack of stamina, particularly after prolonged illness or acute disease.
Useful in cases of fatigue with no apparent organic cause.
Recurrent Infections
Aids in immunity and helps prevent frequent colds, coughs, and quinsy.
Chronic catarrh with post-nasal drip and foul discharges.
Gastrointestinal Disorders
Assists offensive eructations (like bad eggs), nausea, and abdominal pain after eating.
Helpful in mucous, bloody, excessively fetid stool, and constipation in scrofulous children.
Emotional and Mental Symptoms
Deep melancholy with hopelessness and suicidal thoughts.
Religious despair and persistent depression.
ENT Conditions
Psorinum helps in chronic ophthalmia, blepharitis, and conjunctivitis.
Eczema with fetid discharge around ears; chronic otorrhea with brownish pus.
Gynecological Issues
Fetid, lumpy leucorrhoea with backache and debility.
Painful and swollen breasts; skin eruptions over mammary glands.
Joint and Muscular Weakness
Weakness of joints, as if they might give way.
Eruptions and pustules near fingernails.
Sleep Disorders
Psorinum assists in sleeplessness from constant itching; frequent startling during sleep.

name: PTELEA TRIFOLIATA
indications:
Liver & Abdominal Disorders
Aids in conditions marked by soreness and swelling of the liver, particularly with pain aggravated when lying on the left side and relieved by lying on the right.
Supports liver function in cases of abdominal retraction, fullness, and right-sided heaviness.
Ptelea trifoliata helps treat sensitive, painful liver, especially when accompanied by digestive disturbances and a coated tongue.
Gastric & Stomach Complaints
Treats atonic stomach states with symptoms such as fullness, griping in the epigastrium, and burning sensations.
Aids in relieving nausea, vomiting, and eructations.
Useful when the stomach feels empty immediately after eating, despite having just consumed food.
Helps support cases with dry mouth, acidity, excessive salivation, and corrosive sensations in the stomach.
Headache & Mental Symptoms
Helps in managing dullness, heaviness, and a stupid feeling in the head.
Frontal headaches that extend to the root of the nose, worse from noise, motion, night, or eye rubbing.
Relieves pressing pains in the temples, described as if the temples were being squeezed together.
Intense, throbbing headache with a bursting or splitting sensation, worsened by mental effort or concentration.
Mouth & Tongue
Aids in reducing excess saliva with a dry, bitter taste.
Treats awhite or yellow-coated tongue, often described as rough, swollen, with red, prominent papillae.
Supports oral health in digestive disturbances with accompanying mouth symptoms.
Respiratory & Cardiac Region
Helps relieve dyspnea and asthmatic breathing, especially when worse lying on the back.
Aids in addressing the sensation of pressure or suffocation in the lungs, and cramp-like chest pain near the heart.
Sleep & Dreams
Supports restful sleep in individuals plagued by nightmares, restless sleep, and frightful dreams.
Ptelea trifoliata is useful in those who wake up feeling weak, languid, and unrefreshed.

name: PULSATILLA NIGRICANS
indications:
Dyspepsia:
It helps in cases of dyspepsia, characterized by a feeling of great tightness after meals, necessitating loosening of clothing.
There is aversion to fat and warm foods, along with eructations that leave alingering taste of food.
Patients may experience heartburn, flatulence, and bitter taste in the mouth. Vomiting of food consumed long before is also common.
Stomach pains, resembling those of subcutaneous ulceration, may appear an hour after eating.
There is also a feeling of weight, particularly in the morning upon waking, and a gnawing, hungry sensation.
Hoarseness and Cough:
It helps in cases of capricious hoarseness that fluctuates. Patients experience dry coughs in the evening and at night, compelling them to sit up in bed for relief.
Coughs in the morning are loose, with copious mucous expectoration.
There is chest pressure, soreness, and significant epigastric soreness.
Urination may occur simultaneously with coughing. Chest pain, resembling that of an ulcer, is also present.
Expectoration is bland, thick, bitter, and greenish. Shortness of breath, anxiety, and palpitations worsen when lying on the left side. A suffocating feeling may develop while lying down.
Menstrual irregularities:
In women, Pulsatilla addresses menstrual irregularities such as amenorrhea and suppressed menses. The condition may result from wet feet, nervous debility, or chlorosis.
Menses may arrive late, with flow that is scanty, thick, dark, clotted, changeable, or intermittent. Symptoms include chilliness, nausea, downward pressure, and intermittent flow with pain during menses.
Leucorrhea may also be present, characterized by acrid, burning, and creamy discharges. There is often associated back pain and fatigue.
Diarrhea may occur during or after menses.
Musculoskeletal pain:
Patients may experience drawing and tensive pain in their thighs and legs, accompanied by restlessness and chilliness.
Limb pain may shift rapidly and end abruptly. There may also be numbness around the elbow, painful hip joints, swollen knees with tearing and drawing pains, and a boring heel pain that worsens toward evening, particularly if the affected limb is allowed to hang down.
Veins in the forearms and hands may swell, and the feet may become red, inflamed, and swollen.
The legs may feel heavy and weary.
Skin complaints:
Patients may develop urticaria following rich meals, with aggravation from diarrhea or delayed menstruation and exacerbated by undressing.
The remedy may also be used for conditions such as measles and acne during puberty and varicose veins.
Fever and Temperature Sensitivities:
Patients may experience apersistent sense of chilliness, even in warm environments, without any accompanying thirst.
Chills may be associated with localized pain, worsening towards the evening, particularly around 4 pm. At night, heat may become intolerable, accompanied by distended veins and alternating feelings of heat and cold in different parts of the body.
Sweating may occur on one side of the body, with pain during this period.
After fever, patients may experience headaches, diarrhea, loss of appetite, and nausea.
Changeable moods:
It is often indicated for individuals with a mild, gentle, yielding disposition who are emotionally sensitive and easily moved to tears.
These individuals may cry readily, especially when talking. They exhibit changeable moods and contradictions in behavior or symptoms. Seeking sympathy and comfort, they prefer open air despite feeling chilly.
They may experience religious melancholy, fearfulness in the evening, and morbid dread, particularly to the opposite sex.
Highly emotional, they swing between extremes of pleasure and pain, exhibiting amentally unstable or unpredictable temperament.
Headache:
Wandering stitches around the head that extend to the face and teeth. Patients often complain of frontal and supra-orbital pains.
Neuralgic pains may begin in the right temporal region, accompanied by scalding lachrymation on the affected side.
Headaches worsen with overwork and are alleviated by exposure to the open air.
Patients may also experience vertigo and pressure on the vertex.
Ear and Eye infections:
Sensation as if something is being forced outward from the ears, with difficulty in hearing as if the ear were stuffed.
Otorrhea (discharge from the ears) is common, characterized by thick, bland discharge with an offensive odor.
External ear inflammation with swelling and redness can occur, along with otalgia (ear pain), which worsens at night.
Conjunctivitis (pink eye) with subacute inflammation and dyspepsia, exacerbated in warm rooms.
Itching, burning, and profuse discharge of mucus from the eyes, along with inflamed and agglutinated eyelids.
Coryza:
Coryza (runny nose) with right nostril blockage and pressing pain at the root of the nose.
Loss of smell, discharge of large green fetid scales.
Nasal bone soreness.
Facial neuralgia:
Facial neuralgia may be right-sided, with profuse lachrymation and swelling of the lower lip, which may crack in the middle.
Facial pain (prosopalgia) worsens towards evening and midnight, accompanied by chills.
Mouth and Dental Issues:
Greasy taste in the mouth, dryness without thirst, and a frequent need to lick dry lips.
A crack may appear in the middle of the lower lip, and the tongue may be yellow or white with a tenacious mucus coating.
Toothache, especially relieved by holding cold water in the mouth, offensive odor, and alternations in taste (bitter, bilious, greasy, salty, foul) are also common.
Food, especially bread, may taste bitter, and there may be an excess of sweet saliva.

name: PYROGENIUM
indications:
Septic Fevers and Infections
Pyrogenium is highly useful in septicemia, especially puerperal sepsis and post-operative infections.
Indicated in typhoid, typhus, influenza, and chronic malaria with a septic character.
Useful after miscarriage or abortion with signs of infection.
Offensive Discharges
All discharges— menstrual, lochial, diarrhoea, vomit, sweat, and breath e—are extremely fetid.
Addresses coffee-ground vomiting, carrion-like stools, and horribly offensive menses.
Cardiovascular Symptoms
Heart symptoms include palpitations, a tired feeling, and the sensation that the heart is too full.
Pulse is rapid and disproportionate to the fever.
Useful in threatening heart failure during septic states.
Digestive and Abdominal Complaints
Vomits water as soon as it becomes warm in the stomach.
Diarrhoea:
Painless, involuntary, brown-black and extremely offensive.
Severe tenesmus of bladder and rectum; bloated, sore abdomen.
Female Reproductive Disorders
Useful in septic conditions following childbirth, miscarriage, or abortion.
Addresses uterine hemorrhages, pelvic inflammation, and puerperal peritonitis.
Fever during menses due to latent pelvic infection.
Musculoskeletal and Skin Conditions
Pyrogenium assists in aching in limbs and bones; bed feels too hard.
Weakness and soreness relieved by motion.
Rapid formation of decubitus ulcers in septic states.
Small injuries become inflamed, swollen, and discolored.
Nervous and Mental Symptoms
Marked restlessness; feels as though body is crowded with limbs.
Delusions of wealth, insane notions, loquacity.
Cannot distinguish between dreams and reality.
Fever and General State
Begins with chill in the back, followed by rapid rise in temperature.
Profuse hot sweating does not lower the fever.
Overall feeling of dryness, debility, and early morning exhaustion.
Sleep Disorders
Semi-sleep with constant dreaming.
Pyrogenium helps in disturbed, unrestful sleep due to mental and physical restlessness.

name: QUASSIA AMARA
indications:
Fever & Intermittent Conditions
Aids in managing intermittent fever, especially with chilliness and coldness running down the back.
Helps with constant yawning, stretching of limbs, and internal cold sensations.
Quassia amara supports the body’s response during early stages of fevers with muscular restlessness.
Gastrointestinal Complaints
Treats nausea, qualmishness, and the peculiar sensation of a stomach full of hot water.
Aids in relieving drawing and sticking abdominal pains, especially between the umbilicus and stomach.
Supports digestion in individuals suffering from hard, difficult stools followed by pasty or watery evacuations.
Helps manage a Heart-burn and gastralgia with regurgitation of food and a sensation of emptiness or retraction in the abdomen, often worsened by deep breathing.

Aids in relieving sticking or dull aching pain in the hepatic region.
Helps with abdominal hardness, bloating, and distension.
Supports nervous or circulatory symptoms like pulsating or beating sensations across the abdomen and into the limbs.

Supports the urinary system by promoting urine secretion, though with reduced solid content—indicating utility in cases of functional weakness or detox support.

Quassia amara treats mental dullness and lack of concentration, especially in individuals waking at 1 a.m. with anxiety and restlessness.
Helps with drawing pains in the neck and calf muscles, easing musculoskeletal discomfort.
Aids in restoring mental clarity and reducing nervous fatigue.
General State & Fatigue
Supports overall well-being in cases of general discomfort and low vitality, particularly during feverish conditions.
Quassia amara helps treat physical and mental exhaustion, restoring the ability to engage in mental labor and daily tasks.

name: QUILLAYA SAPONARIA
indications:
Upper Respiratory Tract Infections
Aids in treating the onset of colds and coryza, especially when symptoms begin with sneezing and throat irritation.
Helps in relieving dryness and burning in the throat, particularly when the cold begins with a sore sensation.
Supports mucosal health by checking catarrhal inflammation before it progresses to full-blown infection.
Useful for sore throat with heat, dryness, and for scratchiness.

Treats dry, irritating cough with difficult expectoration, often seen in the early stages of bronchial irritation.
Helps loosen mucus, easing chest discomfort from inuseful or scanty expectoration.
Quillaya saponaria may support chronic cough relief by reducing surface irritation of the bronchi.
Skin Conditions
Aids in managing squamous skin eruptions and dryness of the skin surface.
Supports gentle detoxification and may help alleviate irritable conditions of the skin.

name: R.N.A
indications:
