R.N.A is indicated for profound indifference and apathy toward everything.
Patient may shriek, scream, or shout at trifles, reacting disproportionately to minor irritations.
A strong sense of weariness of life, coupled with a careless, escapist attitude toward responsibilities.
Marked difficulty concentrating and poor learning abilities in children and adults alike.
Digestive Disturbances
Characterized by a nibbling appetite — the patient eats small amounts frequently but never feels satisfied.
Aversion to pickles but a craving for sweets, vinegar, and warm food.
Colic pains leading to diarrhoea that worsens during bouts of abdominal pain.
Sleep Disorders
Disturbed sleep with notable sleeplessness after midnight, typically between 3 a.m. and 4 a.m.
Sexual Sphere
An increased sexual desire often accompanies the state of physical debility and mental dullness.
Neurological Conditions
Indicated for epileptic convulsions, especially when preceded or accompanied by emotional instability, poor mental focus, and general systemic weakness.

name: RADIUM BROMATUM
indications:
Mind and Emotions
Helps in apprehension and depression, especially fear of being alone in the dark.
Desire for company, emotional tiredness, and irritability.
Headaches and Nervous System
Supports in reducing vertigo and heaviness of the head, especially occipital and vertex pains linked to lumbar aching.
Radium bromatum relieves severe pain over the right eye spreading to the back of the head, better in open air.
Aids in violent trifacial neuralgia and aching in the jaw angle.
Mouth and Nose Symptoms
Treats dryness of the mouth with a metallic taste.
Prickling sensation on the tongue's tip and dryness/itching of nasal cavities, improved in fresh air.
Digestive Issues
Empty or warm sensation in the stomach.
Aversion to sweets and ice-cream; nausea with belching.
Treats abdominal pain, violent cramps, bloating, rumbling, and alternating constipation and diarrhoea.
Helps in flatulence, pain over McBurney's point, and pruritus ani with piles.
Urinary Disorders
Increased solid elimination (especially chlorides).
Treats renal irritation with albuminuria, granular and hyaline casts.
Helps in nephritis linked to rheumatic symptoms; enuresis (bed-wetting).
Female Health
Useful in pruritus vulvæ and delayed, irregular menstruation with associated backache.
Aching over the pubic area during menstruation.
Manages soreness in the right breast, relieved by hard rubbing.
Respiratory Complaints
Persistent dry, spasmodic cough with tickling in the suprasternal fossa.
Helps in dry, constricted feeling in the throat and soreness of chest.
Back and Spine
Aching in the neck, cervical pain & lameness worsened by dropping head forward, better by standing, or sitting erect.
Useful for lumbar and sacral backache, better from continued motion.
Aids in backache between shoulders and in the lumbar-sacral region, relieved after motion.
Extremities and Joints
Treats severe, sharp pains in all joints, notably knees, ankles, shoulders, hands, and fingers.
Sensation as if bones in arms, legs, and neck are hard, brittle and could break.
Useful for heavy arms, cracking shoulders, sore hip joints, calf pain, and popliteal space discomfort.
Aids in trophic changes in the fingernails and dermatitis of the fingers.
Helps in chronic rheumatic arthritis, aching pain worse at night and soreness of leg and hip muscles.
Skin Conditions
Helps in small pimples, erythema, dermatitis with itching, burning, redness, and swelling.
Useful for necrosis, ulceration, and burning sensations as if the skin were on fire.
Indicated for epithelioma (epithelial cancer).
Sleep Disturbances
Restlessness at night, sleepiness with daytime lethargy.
Vivid, busy dreams, often involving fire.
Fever and Circulatory States
Treats internal coldness, chattering of teeth until midday.
Radium bromatum manages internal chilliness followed by skin heat, often accompanied by bowel movements and flatulence.

name: RANUNCULUS BULBOSUS
indications:
Chest, Pleura, and Respiratory Difficulty
Treats sharp, cutting, and burning pains in chest muscles and pleura, worsened by movement and touch.
Pain as if from adhesions of the lungs after pleurisy.
Manages oppression of breathing, desire for deep inspiration, worse after emotional grief or in open air.
Helps in rheumatic pain localized to small spots on the chest and ribs, sometimes mistaken for heart trouble.
Sensation of cold wet cloths applied to chest while outdoors, disappearing on coming inside.
Ranunculus bulbosus helps in burning pressure and lancinations in chest and liver region.
Skin and External Tissues Irritation
Vesicular eruptions resembling burns, with burning, lancinating, and itching.
Treats ulcers that are flat, corrosive, with burning and lancinating pains.
Chilblains and horny excrescences; tetters over the whole body.
Aids in deep-blue grouped vesicles with thick scabs and intense itching.
Trembling and Muscles Ache
Useful in tearing, spasmodic, and jerking pains in limbs and muscles, especially in weather changes.
Helps in rheumatic and contusive pains in trunk and limbs, < by touch, stretching, or change of position.
Trembling of limbs after emotional excitement.
Weak Memory & Anxiety
Reduces anxiety and fear of ghosts in the evening; unwilling to be alone.
Morning irritability, quarrelsomeness, and easily frightened with tendency to weep.
Treats weakness of memory; vanishing of thoughts while reflecting.
Headache and Vertigo
Helps in vertigo with staggering while passing from indoors to open air.
Neuralgic headaches, semilateral, especially above the eyes, associated with sadness and nausea.
Manages sensation of head being puffed, too large or distended.
Supports when crawling, creeping, or burning sensations in the scalp.
Nasal Congestion & Neuralgia
Burning, sore, and smarting sensations in eyes; mistiness and night blindness (nyctalopia).
Treats hay fever, nasal congestion worse indoors, with painful tingling and excoriation of nostrils.
Burning vesicular eruptions on face, especially around chin and nose; feels scalded.
Helps in neuralgic whirling spasmodic pains in face and jaws.
Digestive Ailments
Burning and excoriating pains in stomach, especially sensitive to touch.
Useful in pinching colic alternating with chest pains; bruised and ulcerated feeling on abdominal pressure.
Frequent expulsion of fetid flatus.
Treats bitter, empyreumatic taste after dry food; thirst in the afternoon.
Urinary and Sexual Troubles
Helps in frequent urging to urinate; urine becomes cloudy quickly.
In women, acrid, gnawing leucorrhea, and ovarian neuralgia sensitive to atmospheric changes.
Frequent erections and emissions toward morning in men.
Rheumatism
Aids in rheumatic pains, tearing and jerking in arms, wrists, hands, and fingers, especially worse when writing or moving.
Pain and stitches in heels and toes; sore pain between the toes; sensitive corns.
Weakness
Treats lassitude and painful as from being beaten.
Symptoms worsened by temperature changes, stretching, touch, or alcohol.
Aggravations especially after meals, in the morning or evening, and during weather transitions.
Sleep disturbed and Fever
Sleeplessness from oppression of the chest; anxious dreams.
Ranunculus bulbosus aids in fever after meals or in evening, characterized mainly by chilliness and heat confined to the face, especially on the right side.
Helps in scanty perspiration only upon waking in the morning.

name: RANUNCULUS SCELERATUS
indications:
Mind and Emotional Health
Induces mental dullness, indolence, and aversion to work, especially in the morning.
Sadness, melancholy, and emotional heaviness in the evening.
Anxiety with heat and thirst, leading to restless sleep and frightful dreams (of corpses, serpents, etc.).
Headaches and Vertigo
Aids in vertigo with momentary loss of consciousness.
Constrictive headaches, as if head is compressed in a vice.
Helps localized gnawing and dull pressure at the vertex or temples.
Sensation of scalp contraction, smarting, and itching.
Eyes, Ears, and Nose Issues
Relieves burning, gnawing, and smarting pains in the eyes, especially at the corners.
Lachrymation and occasional convulsive movement of the eyeballs.
Treats sharp otalgia (ear pain) with associated pulling sensations in teeth.
Prickling and tingling sensations in the nose, frequent sneezing, and serous nasal discharge.
Helps ulceration or large sores on the right side of the nose.
Facial and Dental Complaints
Sensation as if cobwebs cover the face.
Helps in facial twitchings, quivering around lips (risus sardonicus).
Drawing, spasmodic, and shooting pains in the face and teeth.
Swelling and easy bleeding of the gums.
Mouth, Throat, and Appetite Disturbances
Useful in dryness of mouth with frothy salivation.
Tongue coated white; burning, shooting, and inflammation with desquamation.
Burning and constrictive throat sensations, worse on eating bread.
Sweetish taste in the morning; diminished appetite; strong thirst during fever.
Digestive Ailments
Sour, rancid eructations especially in the evening.
Nausea after midnight or in the early morning, sometimes leading to fainting.
Helps burning, gnawing, and constrictive pains in the stomach, worse with pressure.
Dull aching in hepatic region worsened by deep inspiration.
Useful in pinching, cutting, and twisting pains in the abdomen; frequent soft stools or serous, fetid diarrhea.
Urinary and Sexual Health
Treats strangury with burning after urination.
Dribbling of urine after micturition.
Helps in sensations of crawling or tickling at the urinary meatus.
Ranunculus sceleratus treats male sexual issues including frequent emissions and lancinating pains in the genital region.
Chest, Heart, and Respiratory Support
Small, dry, infrequent cough with deep, obstructed respiration.
Manages chest pains as if beaten, oppressive pressure, and pinching around the heart area.
Stitches in chest and intercostal muscles; painful drawing in pectoral muscles.
Aids in heart symptoms include blunt pressure, stitches, and pinching tightness affecting breathing.
Back and Limb Pains
Beneficial in bruised or paralytic feelings in the loins.
Treats gnawing, boring, tingling pains in limbs, particularly toes and fingers.
Useful in swelling and shooting pains in joints; arthritic affections prominently affecting the right side.
Skin Eruptions and Ulcers
Treats vesicular eruptions with acrid, thin yellowish discharge.
Itching, gnawing, biting, and boring sensations worse in the evening.
Large isolated blisters that may burst and form obstinate ulcers (pemphigus-like eruptions).
General Weakness and Sensitivity
Faintness and syncope accompanying pains.
Helps in convulsive jerking or twitching of limbs, especially in the evening or at night.
Aggravations occur mainly before midnight and on the right side of the body.
Sleep Disturbances and Fever
Ranunculus sceleratus helps in sleeplessness after midnight with restlessness and heat.
Fever characterized by dry heat at night, violent thirst, and quick, full but soft pulse.
Perspiration mainly occurs towards morning, especially on the forehead.

name: RAPHANUS SATIVUS
indications:
Mind and Emotional Health:

Intense itching of genital organs worse at night.

Breast tenderness and pains, particularly in the left breast before menses.
Vaginal soreness during menstruation.

Coated, dry tongue, and excessive salivation.
Aids in burning pain in the throat, especially with vomiting.

indications:

Sourness in Children:
Children affected by acidity might exhibit sour-smelling stools and perspiration.

Useful for women experiencing abnormally high sexual desire.
Vaginal Discharge:
Effective for treating acrid and foul-smelling vaginal discharge.
Intermenstrual Bleeding:

Genital Herpes:
Indicated for herpetic sores on the vagina and vulva.

indications:

indications:

indications:

Enlargement of lymphatics and abnormal secretions.

Pressive, tearing and shooting pains in the spine, with back pain causing an inward bend.

Red, shining swelling of the great toe with boring and lancinating pain.

aids in balancing body temperature, addressing cold hands and feet, while supporting comfort during hot flashes and night sweats.

indications:

1. Addresses frequent urination with strong odor and white sediment.

Skin & Nutritional Disorders
1. Supports cases of scurvy, rickets, and pale, blotchy skin.

3.
Saccharum offcinalis aids in treating ulcers, old herpes, and dry or suppressed skin conditions.

1. Aids in calming irritability, violent temper, and hypochondriacal moods.

1. Relieves hoarseness, especially from short reading or catarrhal voice.

1. Useful in intermittent fever, especially when chill starts in the back, followed by vomiting and headache.

1. Manages severe headaches, especially periodic ones and those associated with fever or chill.

Rheumatism & Muscular Issues
1. Eases rheumatic pains in the heart and limbs.
2.
Saccharum offcinalis supports muscle emaciation, tingling in limbs, jactitation, and edema
—especially in hands, arms, and calves.
Reproductive Health
1. In males: Helps with scrotal swelling, frequent involuntary emissions, and increased desire.

indications:

Soothes lower back pain, especially in the sacral or coccyx region, often paired with a need to pass stool.
For heaviness in the legs, especially in those feeling tired or sluggish.
Sleep & Vivid Dreams:
Sinapis alba can help people who sleep easily during the afternoon, especially after meals.
Known for vivid, unusual dreams, often of death, dead people, or adventurous foreign places.
Fever & Circulation:
For people who feel chilled on movement, with cold hands and feet, and gassy eructations.
Pulse tends to feel full and hard.
Tendency to perspire easily, especially with digestive upset or chills.

name: SINAPIS NIGRA
indications:
Headache & Mental Distress:
Sinapis nigra alleviates dull, pressing headaches, especially in the frontal region, over the bridge of the nose and around the eye sockets.
Headaches are often better while eating or resting, but worsen after meals or while thinking about them.
Indicated in head heaviness, vertex emptiness, and scalp sensations as if the skin were stuck to the skull.
Elderly individuals suffering from vertigo and Violent pain with hearing difficulty after eating rich or fatty foods.
Useful for hot scalp, itching, and sweating over the forehead and upper lip.
Nasal & Hay Fever Complaints:
Sinapis nigra helps in dry nasal passages, with alternating nostril blockage and acrid discharge.
Eases sneezing, lachrymation, and symptoms worsened by cold air, but improved while lying down.
For patients experiencing cold mucus from posterior nares, or a sense of dry heat inside the nose.
Throat & Respiratory Issues:
Relieves dry, hacking cough, often worse in the evening and cold air, but better from lying down or briefly from eating.
Eases scalding throat sensation, barking cough, and soreness
—especially on the left side or extending from right to left.
Beneficial in pharyngitis, hoarseness, and throat inflammation with difficult expectoration of sticky white mucus.
Supports breathing in pituitous asthma and rough respiration, particularly at the base of the left lung.
Digestive Complaints:
Useful in burning sensations in the stomach, rising up to the esophagus and mouth, often accompanied by canker sores.
For sour eructations, onion-like bad breath, and colicky pains worsened when bent forward, but relieved when sitting upright.
Nausea is better when sweating appears.
Frequent Urination:
Helps with frequent urination:
—copious both day and night—with bladder pain, especially in the morning.
Urine is typically pale and straw-colored, with no sediment.
Musculoskeletal & Back Pain:
Relieves rheumatic and pulsating back pains, especially in the intercostal and lumbar muscles.
Sinapis nigra addresses restlessness at night due to intense back and hip pain, often relieved by motion.
Eases dull, heavy aching in limbs, cramps in calves, and fatigue in legs.
Dull shoulder pain, especially on the left, and constant ache in ankles and calves.

name: SOL
indications:
Nervous and Emotional Sensitivity:
Useful in excitability, nervous trembling, and spasmodic activity, especially triggered by exposure to sunlight.
Addresses heightened anxiety, fear of people approaching, and easily startled states.
Helpful in cases of internal trembling felt in the stomach-pit and heart.
Headache & Sun Effects:
Relieves intense headaches that begin at the vertex and spread to the forehead, often triggered by direct sun exposure.
Alleviates stitching brain pains, great prostration, and burning or scalding sensation on the scalp.
Severe pain in forehead with a feel as if the forehead will crush down upon the eyes.
Headaches are > by applying water compress to the stomach-pit.
Eye & Vision Sensitivity:
Helps reduce photophobia, swelling sensation in eyes, and light-induced discomfort.
Eyes feel as though they will bulge out of sockets; pupils may be affected by solar stimuli.
Ear, Nose, and Mouth:
For sharp shooting ear pain, especially radiating to the nose.
Addresses sun-induced sneezing, sore throat, and rigid jaw (trismus-like symptoms).
Alters taste perception, with preference for food/water exposed to sunlight.
Gastrointestinal Disturbances:
Relieves heat and faintness in stomach, empty or sinking sensation in stomach-pit.
Assists with nausea, vomiting, and distension in abdomen, sometimes mimicking pregnancy sensations.
Helpful in constipation and reduced stool and urine output during sun exposure.
Female Health:
Useful in early or premature menses, often with backache and emotional disturbances.
Cardiac and Respiratory:
Aids in heart weakness, faintness, and general prostration linked to sunlight exposure.
Useful in cases of chill and congestion from sun after consuming cold water.
Skin and Limb Sensations:
Alleviates sun-induced dermatitis, cold extremities, and neuralgic limb pain.
Helps in joint tenderness, especially when linked to sun exposure or weather sensitivity.
Relieves itchy eruptions and hypersensitivity of skin to sun-exposed stick.
Sleep and Dream Disturbances:
Indicated in insomnia with overactive mental state, c ould not sleep for hours.
May cause nightmares or disturbed sleep, but followed by deep sleep when nervous tension resolves.
Fever and Temperature Sensation:
Treats sun-induced chills with alternating feelings of heat and internal coldness.
For conditions where sunlight paradoxically causes asensation of cold spreading through limbs.
Relieves perspiration from stomach-pit and general discomfort from sun-induced fevers.

name: SOLANUM NIGRUM
indications:
Nervous System and Brain Complaints
Useful in ergotism, with stiffness, spasms, and mania.
Meningitis and brain irritation, especially in children.
Helps in restlessness, night terrors, and violent convulsions.
Treats apoplectic states, with stupor, flushed face, and irregular pulse.
Addresses complete cessation of mental faculties with coma or delirium.
Headache & Amaurosis
Provides relief in congestive and throbbing headaches, especially above the eyes and temples.
Treats vertigo on rising, stooping, or moving about, with nausea and dizziness.
Eye pain, sensitivity to light, and floating spots before eyes.
Helpful in alternate dilation and contraction of pupils, with weak sight and flickering.
Soothes burning, red, swollen, and sore eyes and lids.
Coryza & Bloated Face
Relieves acute coryza, with profuse watery discharge from the right nostril.
Treats nasal blockage and burning with chills and alternating heat.
Face may appear bloated, swollen, or red, with painful skin or blackened patches.
Manages sharp neuralgic pain from jaw to ear and dry, blistered lips.
Respiratory Difficulty
Solanum nigrum helps in chest constriction, difficult breathing, and tickling cough.
Useful in thick yellow expectoration and cutting pain in the chest, especially left side.
Helps in cases of scarlet fever with respiratory and skin symptoms.
Digestive and Abdominal Complaints
Treats loss of appetite, nausea, and vomiting of blackish or greenish fluid.
Alleviates burning pain in the stomach, colic, and ineffectual urging.
Helps in abdominal distension, knife-like pains, and urge to lie down.
Pressure in stomach either constant or in paroxysms.
Stool and Bowel Issues
Manages diarrhea, yellow watery stools, and burning sensation after passing stool.
Relieves constipation with hard, dry stools.
Musculoskeletal and Limb Pains
Wandering pains moving from shoulders to arms, then lower limbs. Severe limb pain, especially in the evening. Drawing pains in arms and feet.
Solanum nigrum aids in crawling and compression in the calf, swelling of feet with soreness in legs when walking, as if bruised.
Unsteady gait with trembling in thigh muscles; general weakness and soreness, especially on the left.
Treats sharp and shooting pains in left arm and wrist; discoloration of palms and fingertips with vesicular eruptions.
Skin Disorders
Useful in scarlet fever-like rashes, itching, burning, and painful eruptions.
Treats vesicles, blisters, and black or desquamated patches on extremities.
Aids healing in ulcers, crusty eruptions, and sloughing skin.
Fever and Inflammation
Indicated in high fever with profuse sweat, alternating chills and heat.
Useful in burning, dry heat, flushes across the face, and disturbed sleep.
Fever with pain in the upper chest or upper belly area, a swollen or bloated abdomen, sometimes screams or grabs at their stomach.
Heart and Circulation
Helps in irregular pulse, rapid or faint heartbeat, and anxious feeling in chest.
Solanum nigrum is useful in circulatory sluggishness and varicose veins.

name: SOLANUM XANTHOCARPUM
indications:
Respiratory Symptoms:
Hoarseness with cough, helping to clear the throat and reduce inflammation.
Treats bronchitis, pneumonia, asthma and other respiratory diseases with aphonia, supporting better respiratory function.
Fever:
Helps manage fever, particularly when associated with thirst, aversion to food, and a burning sensation and pain all over the body.
Urinary System:
Stricture, retention, or suppression of urine.
Useful in managing conditions like urinary stones.

name: SOLIDAGO VIRGAUREA
indications:
Kidney and Urinary Disorders
Traditionally recognized as a powerful kidney medicine that aids in flushing out toxins.
Helps in relieving pain and soreness in the kidney region, especially on pressure.
Scanty, reddish-brown urine with thick sediment or mucous particles.
Solidago virgaurea supports the elimination of albumen, blood, epithelial cells, or phosphatic sediments in urine.
Useful in Bright’s disease, difficult, scanty, and gravel.
Helps in reducing the need for catheterization in some cases of urinary retention.
Dysuria:
(difficult and painful urination) and supports overall urinary health.
Digestive and Abdominal Complaints
Useful for flat ulcers in the mouth and throat with a persistent bitter taste, disturbing sleep.
Aids in improving coated tongue conditions, particularly when linked to kidney dysfunction.
Helps in managing abdominal pain, especially around the navel and hypochondria, with flatulence and bloating.
Chronic catarrh of the bowels, dysentery, and diarrhea with dark, scanty urine.
Respiratory Complaints
Supports respiratory function in chronic catarrh of the lungs with heavy, purulent, or blood-streaked expectoration.
Useful in asthma and continuous dyspnea, especially when worse at night and associated with urinary issues.
Aids in relieving croup, especially when accompanied by skin blotches and diminished urination.
Breathing in the pollen can cause bleeding from the lungs in people with TB. It helps with repeated colds in tuberculosis, especially when there's weakness and chills that come and go with heat.
Musculoskeletal and Rheumatic Complaints
Intercostal rheumatism with pain in the chest muscles.
Supports relief from backache, especially when due to congested kidneys.
Useful in rheumatic pains of the thighs and legs; helps in cases of dragging or limping gait.
Aids in reducing muscle weakness, where legs feel lame on vertical movement.
Skin Rashes
Solidago virgaurea treats scrofulous rashes, itchy blotches on hands and feet.
Helps in managing stubborn itching eruptions, often associated with kidney dysfunction.
Supports skin in cases of eruptions on lower limbs with urinary irregularities, dropsy, or gangrene risk.
Female Health Issues
Aids in conditions of uterine enlargement and fibroid tumors pressing on the bladder.
Chronic leucorrhea accompanied by watery urine and sediment of urinary tubules.
Mental and Sleep Disturbances
Useful in addressing insomnia related to persistent bitter taste and systemic discomfort.
Solidago virgaurea helps in restoring restfulness, especially in cases linked to urinary or toxic buildup.
Fever and Inflammation
Rheumatic fever marked by frequent pulse and high temperature.
Supports relief from eye irritation, stinging, watering, and nasal congestion with sneezing.

name: SPARTEINUM SULPHURICUM
indications:
Heart & Circulation:
Aids in regulating heart rhythm in weak, irregular, or failing heart action, especially following infections or grippe.
Helps treat:
"tobacco heart", angina pectoris, and heart strain from emotional or nervous excitement.
Useful for myocardial degeneration, failing compensation, and Cheyne-Stokes respiration.
Supports the heart in water-logged, dropsical conditions—especially in cases where lying down is uncomfortable.
Helps sustain heart function after withdrawal from morphine dependence.
Used palliatively in arterial hypertension and arteriosclerosis.
Indicated when the muscles and nerves of the heart are primarily affected.
Urinary & Kidneys:
Sparteinum sulphuricum acts as a diuretic, increasing urine flow and easing the burden on the heart.
Aids in treating nephritis and albuminuria, especially when linked to cardiac weakness.
Helps relieve burning sensations along the urinary tract or in the pudendum.
Supports kidney function and helps eliminate fluid, relieving stress on the cardiovascular system.
Stomach & Digestion:
Sparteinum sulphuricum is useful in gas-related heart rhythm disturbances, especially in nervous, hysterical patients.
Helps relieve mental depression linked to gas accumulation in the gastrointestinal tract.
Notably, it does not disturb digestion, making it safe for longer use.

name: SPIGELIA ANTHELMIA
indications:
Mental & Emotional Complaints:
Marked fear of pointed objects such as pins and needles.
Helps in Sadness, restlessness, and brooding thoughts; sits in silence, absorbed in thought.
Beneficial in suicidal melancholy, particularly in the evening, with bodily chilliness.
Difficulty concentrating, poor memory, and aversion to intellectual activity.
Headache & Vertigo:
Violent, semi-lateral headaches, especially left-sided, often involving the eye.
Sensation of a tight band around the head or as if skull would burst.
Spigelia anthelmia helps in neuralgic pains that shift rapidly from one location to another.
Vertigo with a drunken feeling, worse on looking down or with sudden movement.
Headaches aggravated by noise, touch, or even slight motion; better lying with head elevated or washing with cold water.
Neuralgia & Soreness of Eyes:
Neuralgic and rheumatic eye pain, deep in the sockets; soreness from even light touch.
Treats dilated pupils, photophobia, and visual illusions—sees sparks or rays of light.
Burning, dry heat in the eyes; lids drooping as if paralyzed.
Lachrymation with acrid, smarting tears; rheumatic ophthalmia.
Sensation of hairs or feathers brushing the eye on movement.
Facial Neuralgia:
Prosopalgia (facial pain), often left-sided, radiating to eyes, cheek, and temple.
Addresses periodic neuralgia worse from touch, noise, or slightest motion.
Swelling and distorted appearance of facial muscles in the morning.
One-sided facial pain, with chest anxiety and intense fury.
Rheumatic Heart Affections:
Spigelia is a key medicine in pericarditis and rheumatic heart affections.
Violent palpitations, visible and audible, often with anxiety and breathlessness.
Pain and tightness in the praecordial region; sensation as if heart is squeezed or crushed.
Must lie on the right side with head elevated; left side feels sore and weak.
Heartbeat and pulse don’t match; trembling and irregular rhythm.
Dryness of Nose & Mouth:
Treats dryness of the nose with posterior discharge of bland mucus.
Offensive mouth odor, noticeable to others.
Burning vesicles on tongue and palate; cracked tongue with soreness.
Frothy, white saliva and foul taste with lancinating dryness in mouth on waking.
Digestive Support & Worms:
Child points to the navel as the center of pain; common in worm-related complaints.
Itching and crawling sensation in rectum with discharge of ascarides or lumbrici.
Diarrhea alternating with constipation; mucus discharge without stool.
Ineffectual urging and nodular stools with mucus and violent pressure.
Fever & Circulation:
Supports when chilly on slightest motion; chilliness alternating with heat or perspiration.
Cold sweat at night, with clammy or putrid odor.
Pulse often slow, trembling, or irregular.
Thirst for beer during heat phases with flushes of heat at night.
Limbs & Joint Pains:
Trembling, heaviness, and numbness in arms and hands.
Lancinating, shooting pains in joints, especially elbows, knees, and feet.
Painful stiffness of joints and tensive with walking or sudden movement.
Drawing, tearing, twitching pains in limbs and joints with great exhaustion
Spigelia anthelmia helps in hard nodules in hands and warts on toes.

name: SPIGELIA (S.MARILANDICA)
indications:
Mental & Emotional Complaints:
Aids in treating sudden and complete mental derangement—fits of laughing and crying, wild talk, and erratic behavior.
Helps manage marked distortion of facial expression, similar to effects seen in Stramonium.
Supports those experiencing restlessness, running, skipping, and inability to sit still.
Strabismus:
Useful in strabismus (crossed eyes), especially right-sided.
Aids in relieving wild, fixed, or staring expression with dilated pupils.
Helps with pain around the eyes and stiffness in eyelids.
Supports coordination issues by addressing involuntary, irregular movements of the eye muscles.
Flushed Face:
Aids in reducing swelling around the eyes and face.
Useful in cases with a flushed, heated facial appearance.
Supports tongue steadiness when pointed and tremulous.
Irregular Pulse:
Helps regulate afast or irregular pulse.
Useful in treating sensations of inner agitation with outward signs of heat and exhaustion.
Nervous Trembling & Drowsiness:
Aids in managing sudden trembling on attempting to stand, followed by exhaustion.
Supports feverish states with hot, dry skin.
Helps reduce general drowsiness and sluggishness after mental excitement.

name: SPIRANTHES AUTUMNALIS
indications:
Female Health & Reproductive Support:
Assists in promoting milk-flow, especially in left breast, with associated tenderness.
Aids in managing pruritus of the vulva, with redness, dryness, and burning in the vaginal region.
Useful in painful coition with burning sensation.
Supports conditions with bloody or yellowish leucorrhoea and pressing uterine pain.
Musculoskeletal & Sciatic Pain:
Provides relief in lumbago and sciatica, especially on the right side.
Helps in joint pains, particularly in shoulders, knees, and malleoli.
Addresses swelling of veins in hands and general muscular weakness.
Useful in trembling limbs, rigidity of forearms, and pain in all joints of the hands.
Nervous System & Emotional State:
Alleviates symptoms of mental confusion, melancholia, and sobbing.
Helps patients with indolence, low motivation, and emotional ennui.
Useful in vertigo, especially when rising from bed or when sitting still.
Indicated in sudden weakness, faintness, and sensation of intoxication.
Digestive Disturbances:
Useful in acidity and burning in the esophagus, with frequent eructations.
Assists in nausea after meals, regurgitation, and vomiting of ingested food.
Relieves distension and pain in the epigastrium and umbilical region.
Supports those with piercing abdominal pain, especially upon becoming erect.
Helps in cases of constipation or sour-smelling diarrhoea in children.
Urinary & Renal Support:
Eases burning and cramp-like pain in the kidneys, especially at night.
Useful in bladder irritation, with painful urination and post-waking burning.
Manages abundant or scanty urination with rapidly decomposing urine and red gelatinous sediment.
Chest Oppression:
Provides relief in dry, hacking cough especially at night, and burning in throat or larynx.
Supports breathing in cases of dyspnoea and precordial oppression on exertion.
Useful in pleuritic and intercostal pain, particularly on the left side.
Alleviates burning sensations in the breast, especially the left, and pain on lifting the breast.
Itching Eruptions & Fever:
Addresses burning, itching eruptions on groin, axillae, and limbs.
Helpful in jaundice, yellow patches, and vesicular eruptions with purulent discharge.
Manages intermittent fever, flushes of heat, and cold sweats on palms.
Aids in managing night fevers and morning perspiration, especially on hands.
Inflammatory Troubles:
Relieves dim vision, lacrimation, and burning pain in the eyes.
Aids in painful, bleeding gums and toothache worse at night.
Helpful in sore, burning throat with globus sensation and constant urge to clear mucus.
Manages acid reflux-like symptoms with incarceration of air in the esophagus.
Insomnia & Weakness:
Supports restful sleep in infants and adults with frequent yawning and drowsiness.
Useful in sleeplessness due to physical pains or emotional distress.
Beneficial in general prostration with pulsations across the body and unilateral heat.

name: SPIRITUS QUERCUS GLANDIUM
indications:
Mental & Nervous Complaints:
Supports individuals suffering from nervousness, emotional dullness, and sadness with a tendency to weep easily.
Indicated in those who are withdrawn, uncommunicative, and unable to express their condition clearly.
Beneficial in managing restlessness, disturbed gait, and nervous trembling.
Headache & Vertigo:
Spiritus quercus glandium provides relief from wheeling vertigo, often accompanied by a sensation similar to intoxication.
Vertigo is frequently associated with spleen disorders, especially affecting the left side.
Fear of movement due to apprehension of sudden attacks of giddiness or apoplexy.
Useful in gouty eruptions on the scalp and head pressure due to liver or alcohol-related complaints.
Deafness:
Puffiness under the eyes with a yellowish hue.
Indicated in cases of partial deafness and persistent buzzing or noises in the head.
Oral & Breath Issues:
Helps reduce foul, stercoraceous (fecal-like) breath and a coated, offensive tongue.
Often used in individuals with digestive disorders related to chronic alcohol intake.
Digestive Support:
Useful in removing the craving for alcohol in individuals with dependency.
Gnawing sensations at the pit of the stomach and improves flatulent dyspepsia.
Relieves abdominal pain, particularly in the hypochondriac region, aggravated by stooping.
Enlarged Liver & Spleen:
Supports the management of enlarged liver and spleen.
Conditions like leucocythæmia splenica, splenic pain, and ascites
(fluid accumulation).
Helps in treating chronic alcohol-related liver and spleen dysfunction.
Diarrhoea & Fistula:
Aids in eliminating diarrhea that eases accompanying symptoms without weakening the patient.
Useful in chronic constipation and fistula, especially in individuals with a history of alcoholism.
Helps maintain regular bowel movements in sluggish digestive states.
Urinary Troubles:
Increases urine output and aids in reducing water retention.
Chest Tightness:
Helps relieve chest tightness, especially in the region over the heart (praecordia).
Indicated in cases of fluttering, irregular heartbeat and nervous palpitations, particularly in alcohol-related conditions.
Limbs & Skin Conditions:
Useful in treating gouty eczema, especially on the backs of the hands and scalp.
Spiritus quercus glandium helps manage trembling of the hands and instability while walking (tottering gait).
Beneficial in lower limb dropsy and varicose veins due to fluid overload or circulatory issues.

name: SPONGIA TOSTA
indications:
Respiratory Affections:
Great dryness of all air-passages; hoarseness; larynx feels dry, burns, and constricted.
Short, panting, difficult respiration; sensation of a plug in the larynx.
Treats dry, barking, croupy cough; larynx sensitive to touch.
Croup worse during inspiration and before midnight.
Helps in weakness of chest, can scarcely talk.
Wheezing, asthmatic cough exacerbated by cold air.
Profuse expectoration and suffocation; worsens lying with head low and in a hot room.
Heart Complaints:
Rapid and violent palpitations with dyspnea; worsens lying down.
Feels best resting in a horizontal position.
Helpful for angina, faintness with sweating and hypertrophy of heart.
Anxiety:
Anxiety and fear exacerbate cough symptoms.
Sleep:
Awakens in a fright with a sensation of suffocation.
Male Complaints:
Treats swelling of spermatic cord and testicles, accompanied by pain and tenderness.
Orchitis and epididymitis with heat and sensitivity in the affected parts.
Mesntrual Complaints:
Helps in pain in sacrum, increased hunger, and palpitations before menses.
During menses, wakes with suffocative spells, absence of menses with asthma symptoms.
Thyroid Complaints:
Swollen thyroid gland; burning and stinging sensations in the throat.
Symptoms worsen after consuming sweet foods.
Laryngitis:
Larynx dry, constricted; throat feels stitched and dry.
Cough triggered by tickling; constant throat clearing.
Fever:
Aids in periodic attacks of heat accompanied by anxiety.
Face becomes red and feels hot; sweating occurs during fever episodes.

name: SQUILLA
indications:
Respiratory & Bronchial Complaints:
Helpful in chronic bronchitis, especially in older adults with thick mucus rales, shortness of breath (dyspnea), and profuse expectoration.
Supports relief in cases of spasmodic cough with salty, slimy mucus and involuntary spurting of urine or sneezing.
Useful when cough is triggered by deep breathing, cold drinks, physical exertion, or temperature changes; often accompanied by sore throat and sneezing.
Recommended in cases of cough related to measles or intense respiratory irritation.
Urinary Disturbances:
Squilla helps for frequent urges to urinate, especially at night, with passage of large quantities of pale or watery urine.
Supports involuntary urination during coughing or sneezing, particularly helpful for individuals with weakened pelvic muscles.
Digestive & Abdominal Discomfort:
Relieves sensations of heaviness and pressure in the stomach, described as "like a stone."
Issues involving contraction of abdominal muscles due to chest pain or coughing fits.
Eye Irritation:
Helps soothe irritable eyes in children, especially when they instinctively rub or press them with their fists due to discomfort.
Alleviates the sensation of eyes being submerged in cold water or appearing as if vision is swimming.
Cardiac Support:
Squilla acts as a gentle cardiac stimulant, influencing the peripheral blood vessels and coronary arteries.
Useful in managing symptoms associated with weak circulation or stress on the heart due to chronic respiratory ailments.
Skin & Eruptive Conditions:
Squilla is helpful in cases of red, prickly skin eruptions with sensitivity or discomfort.
Musculoskeletal & Extremities:
Relieves persistent, dull rheumatic pains across the body.
Useful for icy cold hands and feet, even when the rest of the body remains warm.
Supports relief from sore, tender feet due to prolonged standing—particularly helpful for individuals such as shop girls or those working on their feet all day.

name: STANNUM IODATUM
indications:
Respiratory & Pulmonary Complaints:
Indicated in chronic lung diseases, particularly phthisis, with weakness, oppression, and productive cough.
Aids in cases with persistent tickling in the throat that triggers acough—often felt at the root of the tongue or shifting spots in the throat.
Supports weak, initially dry coughs that evolve into stronger bouts with pale yellow, copious expectoration.
Helpful in conditions where coughing is followed by chest dryness, increased breathlessness, and a sensation of fatigue or weakness in the chest.
Particularly suited to cases that “hang fire”—not improving despite treatment—and require agentle but beneficial action.
General Weakness& Constitutional Suitability:
Especially beneficial for individuals with a fair, clear complexion, long eyelashes, and rapidly progressing respiratory conditions.
Recommended in smokers with chronic throat-origin coughs, often misattributed to smoking, where deeper lung involvement is suspected.
Supports in cases with lung consolidation and middle-lobe involvement, especially where there is weakness after exertion or prolonged coughing.
Tissue Changes:
Helps in resolution in cases with plastic tissue changes in the lungs and chronic respiratory tract irritation.
Acts as a restorative in post-illness lung conditions where structural changes have impaired function.

name: STANNUM METALLICUM
indications:
Respiratory & Pulmonary Conditions:
Supports relief in chronic bronchitis and pulmonary tuberculosis, especially with deep, rattling coughs and yellow-green mucus that is difficult to expectorate.
Particularly helpful when the cough grows more violent the longer it lasts, leaving the chest sore and the patient profoundly weak.
Stannum metallicum aids in managing weak voice or hoarseness, especially in singers, actors, and auctioneers who become exhausted from speaking or reading aloud.
Recommended in cases of shortness of breath on slight exertion and soreness or hollow feeling in the chest, especially when lying on the right side.
Voice Fatigue & Nervous Exhaustion:
Useful in conditions involving loss of voice or speech weakness, particularly from overuse or illness.
Beneficial for those with extreme weariness in the limbs, chest, and back, often feeling too weak to talk, move, or even think clearly.
Helps alleviate paralytic sensations, trembling, and weakness that worsen with slightest exertion.
Headache and Facial Pain:
Aching in the temples and forehead, with a sensation of pressure inward, as if constricted by a band.
Pain worsens with motion and is aggravated by jarring, such as from walking.
Drawing or pulling pains in the malar (cheek) bones and around the eye sockets (orbits).
Digestive & Abdominal Complaints:
Relieves hollow, empty feelings in the abdomen or stomach, often linked with nausea or vomiting from smell of food.
Helps in cases where pressure on the abdomen gives relief, especially in chronic digestive disturbances or abdominal cramping pain.
Useful in constipation and violent shooting pain at the base of rectum extending to anus with burning and constant itching.
Emotional & Mental Troubles:
Stannum metallicum supports mental states of sadness, discouragement, and anxiety, especially when the person feels worse in company but better when alone.
Particularly suited for emotional lowness before menses, with significant improvement once menstruation begins.
Addresses astate of feeling deeply troubled, with constant agitation and restlessness.
Urinary Urge and Sensation Disturbances:
Supports in managing frequent urge to urinate with little urine passed, or no urge at all—only a sense of bladder fullness signals the need.
Pressure and sensitivity in the bladder neck and urethra after urination, with a feeling that more urine will follow; a few drops may pass with pressure. Retention of urine or difficulty initiating urination.
Helps in dull, inward-stabbing pain in the kidney region.Blister on the edge of the urinary meatus.
Muscular Soreness:
Stannum metallicum relieves muscular heaviness and paralytic weakness, especially when pain comes on gradually and leaves the same way.
Helps in spasmodic twitching of muscles of forearm and hand. Treats nerve inflammation with rheumatic shooting pain in joints.

name: STAPHYLOCOCCINUM
indications:
Inflammatory Conditions:
Useful in inflammation of the parotid glands:
(salivary glands near the jaw), petrous bone:
(part of the skull near the ear), conjunctiva:
(eye lining), and lachrymal glands:
(tear glands).
Helps in managing inflammation of internal organs like the kidneys, heart
(endocardium and pericardium), blood vessels, and bones, including the spine (vertebrae).
Skin Affections:
Staphylococcinum is useful in treating acne, boils, carbuncles
(deep skin infections), and impetigo:
(a contagious skin infection).
Aids in conditions like ecthyma:
(ulcerative skin infection) and osteitis:
(bone inflammation).
Supports treatment in recurrent skin eruptions or slow-healing infections.

name: STAPHYSAGRIA
indications:
Bladder complaints:
Inflammation of the bladder, especially in lying-in patients and newly married women.
Complaints of the bladder (bladder prolapse), indicated by pressure on the bladder and sensation as if it did not empty. Urinary difficulties after severe labor.
Painful or difficult urination, with symptoms like burning in the urethra during micturition and sensation as if urine is continuously rolling i.e., frequent urination.
Urging to urinate and pain after lithotomy (surgical procedure for stones).
Sexual Weakness & prostatitis:
Inflammation of the prostate gland, with symptoms like pain from anus to urethra, frequent urination, burning in the urethra, and discomfort.
Piles associated with enlarged prostate.
Involuntary seminal emissions with weakness, backache, and guilt.
Treats impotence, spermatorrhoea, sexual excesses led to weakness.
Gingivitis & Pyorrhoea:

Pyorrhoea.
Teeth are black and crumbling, associated with toothache during menses.
Styes & Iritis:
Recurrent styes on the eyelids.
Recurrent chalazae (swellings on the eyelids), indicating chronic eye conditions.
Inflammation of the iris of the eye, with symptoms like bursting pain in eyeballs and affections of the angles of the eye (strabismus).
Treats photophobia.

Colic with pelvic tenesmus (straining), incarcerated flatus (trapped gas).
Helpful for nausea and severe pain following an abdominal operation.

Pedunculated fig- warts.

Vaginal discharge with irritation and sensitivity.
Absence of menstrual periods caused by emotional stress or anger.
Increased sexual desire but painful coition.

Pain in the legs, (crural neuralgia) dull aching extending to the hip-joint and small of back.
Arthritic nodes and inflammation of phalanges (finger bones), indicating joint pain and stiffness.
Backache worse in the morning before rising, muscles (especially calves) feel bruised.
General Complaints:
Sweating profusely at night, possibly associated with the skin symptoms and general weakness. Sleepy all day.

name: STELLARIA MEDIA
indications:
Rheumatism and Muscular Pain
Stellaria media alleviates rheumatic pains especially in the right side of the body.
Pain worsens with movement and is accompanied by stiffness and soreness.
Relieves darting, shooting pains in joints and limbs.
Liver Disorders
Useful in cases of hepatic inflammation with sensations of fullness or enlargement.
Relieves burning and dragging pain in the liver region.
Soreness and tenderness around the liver and abdomen.
Gout
Supports management of gouty pains, especially when aggravated by movement.
Eases joint stiffness and soreness in extremities.
Psoriasis and Skin Affections
Used in cases of dry, flaky, itchy skin eruptions.
Stellaria media soothes irritated skin with associated heat or sweat.
Applicable in both acute and chronic dermatoses.
Neuralgia and Facial Pains
Indicated for neuralgic pains, especially on the right side of the face.
Burning sensations and soreness of lower lips.
Digestive Complaints
Aids in nausea and bilious states with eructations and abdominal dragging.
Alleviates soreness and wandering pain around the navel and liver.
Useful for dark brown loose stools and sensitivity in the kidney region.
Respiratory Discomfort
Relieves dry, tickling coughs from upper chest irritation.
Soothes hawking of thick, salty mucus and respiratory tightness.
Headache and Eye Strain
Helps in rheumatic or neuralgic pain over the right side of the head.
Dull frontal headache worse in morning with sleepiness.
Eases darting pains in the right eye with dim vision or soreness.
Addresses flushes of heat around the eyes and lids.
Back and Limbs
Useful for dull, aching pain under the right scapula and stiffness in the lower back.
Stellaria media manages limb stiffness, soreness, and bruised sensations on exertion.
Especially useful for rheumatic pains in hips, knees, calves, and feet.
Sleep and Fever
Sleepiness with a feeling of being unrefreshed on waking.
Raised pulse with normal temperature in fever.

name: STICTA PULMONARIA
indications:
Respiratory Tract Infections & Dry Cough
Sticta pulmonaria is highly useful for dry, spasmodic cough that worsens at night or with deep inspiration.
Aids in clearing mucus stuck in the trachea or behind the nose and throat.
Especially useful after measles, influenza, or whooping cough, where alingering cough remains.
Addresses tickling sensation in the larynx and trachea causing persistent irritation.
Sticta pulmonaria soothes dry, raw, inflamed mucous membranes of the respiratory tract (as in clergyman's sore throat).
Coryza, Sinusitis & Hay Fever
Manages early symptoms of a cold: heaviness in the forehead, burning eyes, and fullness at the root of the nose.
Indicated in hay fever with intense dryness, sneezing fits, and a constant urge to blow the nose with no relief.
Helps dissolve thick nasal crusts and dry secretions in atrophic rhinitis.
Reduces nasal obstruction and facial pressure, particularly on the right side.
Mental Excitability & Nervous Restlessness
Characterized by excessive talkativeness, excitement, and a desire to “fly away” or “float.”
Suited for patients who cannot sit still, constantly moving, kicking, or talking.
Indicated in states of mental confusion where focus and clarity are difficult.
Often used in neurological complaints with physical symptoms, such as chorea or jerky limb movements.
Rheumatism & Joint Inflammation
Treats rheumatic pain and swelling in joints, especially shoulders, wrists, knees, and ankles.
Pains are severe, drawing, and darting, often migrating across limbs.
Aids in Housemaid’s knee and similar joint afflictions with redness, swelling and painful.
Symptoms often worsen at night and improve during the day.
Headaches Linked to Catarrhal States
Relieves dull, heavy, pressive headaches associated with sinus or nasal issues.
Pain may extend deep into the brain, with a sensation as if the skull is being lifted and dropped.
Accompanied by burning in the eyes, tightness of the scalp, and nausea.
Digestive and Urinary Involvement
Used in morning diarrhea that is profuse and frothy.
Addresses acid reflux, rumbling, and dull, burning sensations in the stomach and liver regions.
Sticta pulmonaria provides relief from urinary irritation and soreness and aching in the bladder area.
Feeling as if the stomach is full of yeast, with a fermenting or rumbling sensation.

name: STIGMATA MAYDIS
indications:
Urinary Retention and Suppression
Helps in incomplete or painful urination.
Useful when urine is suppressed or very scanty, especially with discomfort.

Cystitis and Bladder Infections
Soothes the inflamed bladder in acute and chronic cystitis.
Eases tenesmus (straining), and urgency after urination.
Beneficial in catarrhal conditions of the bladder with mucous discharge.
Kidney Disorders and Renal Colic
Supports relief in nephritic colic (pain from kidney stones).
Indicated in renal lithiasis with blood or red sand in urine.
Helps reduce kidney inflammation and improves urine flow.
Enlarged Prostate
Useful in managing urinary difficulties due to prostate enlargement in elderly men.
Relieves dribbling, weak stream, and incomplete emptying of the bladder.
Chronic Gonorrhea
Helps in chronic cases of gonorrhea with persistent discharge.
Assists in clearing phosphatic or uric acid-type discharges.
Edema and Heart Weakness
Supports in dropsy (swelling) of legs due to heart failure.
R educes fluid buildup and improves urination in such cases.

name: STILBOESTROLUM
indications:
Female Reproductive & Menstrual Disorders:
Menorrhagia, metrorrhagia, and uterine bleeding due to hormonal imbalance.
Aids in amenorrhoea or delayed menstruation linked with deficient ovarian activity.
Helpful in climacteric complaints: hot flushes, nervousness, and irregular bleeding.
Supports cases of sterility associated with estrogenic deficiency.

Stilboestrolum acts on pituitary–ovarian axis, balancing irregular estrogen function.
Indicated in underdevelopment of secondary sexual characteristics due to hormonal insufficiency.
Supports management of certain glandular enlargements and endocrine weakness.
Pregnancy & Lactation Complaints:
Helpful in threatened abortion linked with deficient hormonal support.
Aids in insufficient lactation from hormonal imbalance.
Supports uterine tone in women with recurrent miscarriage tendency.
General Weakness & Nervous Irritability:
Helpful in nervous irritability, restlessness, and mood fluctuations related to endocrine imbalance.
Aids in weakness, easy fatigue, and loss of vitality associated with menstrual or menopausal states.
Stilboestrolum assists in insomnia, anxiety, and depressive states connected with estrogen deficiency.

name: STILLNGIA SYLVATICA
indications:
Bone & Joint Conditions:
Stillingia sylvatica helps in periostitis, bone nodes, and swellings of the skull, tibia, and joints.
Relieves sharp, darting bone pains, worse in the evening and from exposure to cold.
Useful in hip-joint disease, enlarged tibia, and painful elbows and limbs.
Suited for syphilitic and gonorrheal sciatica with deep-seated aching.
General soreness of muscles as if from cold or overexertion.
Persistent weakness, exhaustion, and malaise with long-lasting symptoms.
Depression & Mental Dullness:
Persistent low mood with gloomy forebodings and a sense of hopelessness.
Dullness of intellect, reduced concentration, and slow mental processing.
Chronic Skin Disorders:
Treats chronic, indolent ulcers, venereal eruptions, and scrofulous skin diseases.
Helpful in psoriasis, leprous conditions, and elephantiasis.
Itching and burning of the legs, worse from air exposure.
Supports rapid healing of pustular eruptions.

Dull pain in the vertex and forehead with a sensation of heavy pressure.
Sharp darting pains in occiput and under the cheekbones.
Swelling of bones in head and face.

Chronic catarrh with muco-purulent discharge, followed by nasal ulcers or abscesses.
Inflamed throat with burning, stinging, rawness, and difficulty swallowing.
Stillingia sylvatica Indicated in syphilitic laryngitis, hoarseness, and public speakers’ sore throat.
Digestive & Liver Affections:
Loss of appetite or increased hunger with nausea, pyrosis, and vomiting.
Liver torpidity with jaundice, depression, and constipation.
Cramping and colicky pain in hypochondria and abdomen.
Bowels irregular with piles, burning pain in rectum, and tenesmus.
Urinary & Reproductive Disorders:
Retention, burning, and painful urination, often with mucus or blood in urine.
Relief in gonorrhea, urethral inflammation, and testicular pains.
For female complaints like painful ovaries and thick, mucopurulent leucorrhea.
Respiratory Conditions:
Used in dry, hoarse, spasmodic coughs worse in the evening or on waking.
Stillingia sylvatica soothes laryngeal irritation in singers or public speakers.
Useful in early stages of tuberculosis or chest affections in scrofulous individuals.
Chest pain with raw sensation along the sternum and short hacking cough.

Weak, irregular pulse with boring pain in heart region.
Helpful in circulatory weakness with general emaciation and fatigue.
Fever and Sleep Disturbances:
Fever at night, especially around 1 a.m., followed by profuse sweating.
Sleepiness during the day, especially after meals.
Heat in the face and restlessness during catarrhal fevers.

name: STRAMONIUM
indications:
Mental & Emotional Disturbances:
Indicated in cases of delirium tremens, mania, hallucinations, and emotional instability with rapid alternations between joy and sadness.
Suited to people who are loquacious, garrulous, and exhibit behaviors such as laughing, praying, swearing, rhyming, or even talking with imaginary beings.
Strong fear of being alone or in the dark, with a need for constant light and company.
Exhibits religious delusions, identity confusion (believing abody part is missing or oneself to be double or extremely tall).
Used in puerperal mania, particularly where loquacity and inappropriate behavior appear post-delivery.
Gastric Troubles:
Stramonium helps in managing loss of taste, where food may seem like sand or straw.
It aids in relieving nausea and vomiting, often of sour or greenish mucus, and helps in burning or pressing stomach pain.
Abdominal bloating and tenderness, and aids in managing tearing or cramping pains around the navel, sometimes of a hysterical nature with swelling of inguinal (groin) glands.
Constipation with inuseful urging, and aids in controlling foul, loose stools passed unconsciously—especially in mentally disturbed states.

In convulsions, particularly post-scarlatina or during fever, with associated delirium and twitching.

Associated with auditory hallucinations, and hypersensitivity to visual stimuli—particularly glittering objects or water, which can trigger spasms.
The patient may frequently raise the head from the pillow due to restlessness.
Marked intoxicated or staggering sensation, especially worse in darkness; may fall backward or to the left. Accompanied by clouded vision, red face, colicky pain, or diarrhea.
Sensation of stupefaction, with temporary loss of vision and hearing, convulsive head movements, and a distressing feeling of lightness or emptiness in the head.
Headaches may cause giddiness, clouded sight, incoherent speech, and are often relieved by rest; useful in cerebral anemia of the elderly.
Eyes & Vision:
Eyes appear staring, wide open, with dilated pupils and a desire for light.

Strabismus (crossed eyes) and feelings of parts of the body being swollen or distorted.

Supports breathing issues like shortness of breath, suffocative episodes, asthma (worse at night), and dyspnea on waking, especially worsened by cold air.
Aids in chest tightness, pressure (worse on speaking), muscle spasms, and a turning sensation in the chest, sometimes with red rash.

Stammering, chewing motions, and expressions like risus sardonicus (a fixed, grin-like expression).
Aversion to water despite violent thirst.
Urinary & Sexual Symptoms:
Marked urinary suppression, with empty bladder despite restlessness and internal urge.
In males, increased sexual desire, often with indecent speech or actions.
In females, indicated in metrorrhagia (abnormal bleeding) accompanied by mental symptoms like singing, praying, and mania
Sleep & Fever:
Disturbed sleep with screaming or waking in fright, deep snoring, or being unable to sleep despite fatigue.
In fever states: profuse sweating without relief, violent heat, and delirium.
Suppressed Eruptions:
Shiny, reddened skin often linked with suppressed eruptions, especially in post-scarlatina cases where mental and neurological symptoms develop.

name: STREPTO COCCINUM
indications:
Infections & Complications:
Used in cases of repeated tonsillitis, throat infections, and lingering sore throats. These situations often indicate an overburdened immune system or incomplete recovery from prior infections, especially bacterial ones like streptococcus.
Supports the immune system in post-streptococcal conditions, especially when symptoms return often or don’t resolve fully. This includes fatigue, low-grade inflammation, or recurring discomfort that persists after standard antibiotic treatment.
Helps manage symptoms of rheumatic fever, especially after untreated or recurrent strep throat. By calming inflammation and supporting immune regulation, it can aid in controlling joint pain and assist in reducing further complications.
Can be considered in chronic cases where streptococcal infections are suspected to be the root cause. Long-term immune stress from hidden or recurring strep presence may trigger subtle or ongoing health issues that benefit from targeted support.

name: STREPTOMYCINUM

indications:

Excessive forgetfulness with dullness and heat in face.

Pain and boring in malar bones, face redness with burning heat.

Sleeplessness from vascular congestion and restless nights.
Strontium hydroxide aids in general debility, poor reaction, and senile weakness.

Restlessness and disturbed sleep due to heart palpitations or pressure sensations.

Flushed face with scarlet lips, often accompanying fever or gastric distress.

Dryness of tongue and fauces, sometimes with choking after meals.

Nausea, hiccough, and vomiting after eating; loss of appetite and repugnance to alcohol.

Diarrhea with violent colic, burning, and tenesmus.

Marked reduction in urine output post-dose; kidneys become hyperemic.

Shortness of breath with heart strain or emotional exertion.

Feeling of being lifted from bed during naps; undulating body sensations.
Aids in muscular strength and prolongs contractions in weak patients.
Fever and Temperature Regulation:
Temperature may rise with dry skin and flushed face.
Strophanthus hispidus is beneficial in cold extremities with profuse sweat following febrile episodes.
Helps in restlessness and twitching may accompany fever.

name: STRYCHNINUM

For restlessness, mental over-irritability, and sudden nervous agitation.

Relieves spasms of the esophagus and violent itching in roof of mouth.

For laryngeal muscle spasms, sharp constrictive chest pain, and excessive dyspnea.

For jerking, twitching, and sharp shocks felt deep in the spine.

Profuse perspiration, notably astreaming sweat over head and chest.
Coldness in lower extremities, despite internal heat.

Generalized itching, most marked on the nose and face.
Strychninum noted for icy cold sensations and skin hypersensitivity during convulsions or spasms.

name: STRYCHNINUM ARSENICICUM
indications:

Addresses long-standing diarrhoea accompanied by weakness.

Soothes irritation, promotes healing, and supports nervous system function.

Urinary Disorders
Strychninum arsenicicum assists in managing urinary issues like glycosuria of nervous origin.
Floating Kidney
Used in cases of nephroptosis with accompanying general weakness or systemic symptoms.

name: STRYCHNINUM NITRICUM
indications:
Alcoholism and Dipsomania
Useful in treating alcohol dependency and withdrawal symptoms.
Aids in cases of delirium tremens and extreme excitement and violent behavior, due to alcohol consumption
(:
Mania-a-potu).
Helps reduces craving for alcoholic beverages.

Aids in managing degeneration of the optic nerve, improving visual function where possible.

Strychninum nitricum addresses symptoms of exhaustion, fatigue, and enervation.

name: STRYCHNINUM PHOSPHORICUM
indications:
Nervous and Muscular System:
Deep action on muscles via the cerebro-spinal system, leading to twitching, stiffness, and general weakness.

Strychninum phosphoricum is s uitable in nervous breakdowns where mental inertia or emotional disconnection is prominent.

Cold, clammy feet and perspiration on hands and in axillae, reflecting poor nervous and vascular regulation.

name: STRYCHNINUM VALERIANICUM
indications:
Mental Dullness and Sluggishness
Alleviates difficulty in thinking, slow comprehension, and lack of mental clarity.
Supports cognitive function and alertness.
Nervous Exhaustion
Strychninum valerianicum helps in conditions involving depletion of brainpower due to overwork or emotional strain.
Especially beneficial for women with high nervous sensitivity.
Nervous Irritability
Helps calm heightened nervous activity, restlessness, and emotional sensitivity.

name: SULFONAMIDE
indications:
Convalescence (Post-Influenza)
Aids recovery after influenza, especially when fatigue and weakness persist.
o:

Seminal Emissions o Especially useful for nocturnal emissions that occur after 1 a.m.
Prostate Gland Disorders o Helpful in cases of cancerous tumours of the prostate.

Skin Conditions (Pemphigus)
